sec: Introduction (A Introduction, B Limitation of Inline Styles)

cards.en:
Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) is a stylesheet language used to control the appearance and presentation of HTML elements on a web page: colours, fonts, spacing and layout.

HTML and CSS have different jobs. HTML defines the structure, elements and content of a page (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables). CSS defines how those elements look. This idea is called separating the presentation from the content.

Because of this separation, the same HTML document can be shown with different CSS: the content and structure stay identical while the look and layout change completely. A designer can restyle a whole site without touching its HTML, and a content writer can edit text without breaking the design.

Key sentence to memorise: CSS controls the appearance and presentation of HTML elements, separating the presentation from the content.
cards.zh:
Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) 是一种 stylesheet language，用来控制 HTML 元素在网页上的 appearance and presentation（颜色、字体、间距、布局）。

分工：HTML 定义 structure, elements and content（标题、段落、列表、表格）；CSS 决定这些元素长什么样。这就是 separating the presentation from the content（把外观与内容分开）。

因为分开了，同一份 HTML 可以配不同的 CSS：内容和结构完全一样，但外观、布局可以完全不同。设计师改整个网站外观不必改 HTML；写内容的人改文字也不会弄坏设计。

考试要背：CSS controls the appearance and presentation of HTML elements, separating the presentation from the content.

ex.q: A school has one HTML page of news. It wants a 'dark mode' version with white text on black. Explain how CSS makes this easy.
ex.a:
Keep the HTML (content and structure) unchanged.
Write a second stylesheet, e.g. 
body { background-color: black; color: white; }
Load this stylesheet instead of the normal one. Because CSS separates presentation from content, only the presentation changes; the text, headings and links stay the same.
ex.az: HTML 不动，只换一份 CSS（背景黑、文字白）。因为 CSS 把外观与内容分开，只有外观改变。

cards.en:
The book uses four words to describe a web page. Learn the exact meaning of each:
  • Content: the actual information on the page: texts, images and links.
  • Style: the visual appearance of an element (its colour, font, border...).
  • Layout: how the content is arranged on the page (alignment, spacing, size of boxes).
  • Structure: how HTML elements are nested inside each other. For example <li> must be inside <ul> or <ol>; <th> and <td> are inside <tr>; <tr> is inside <table>.
HTML is responsible for content and structure; CSS is responsible for style and layout. In exam questions that show two screenshots of the same page, the content and structure are usually the same, and you must say which style/layout properties changed.
cards.zh:
课本用四个词描述网页，要分清：
  • Content：网页上的实际信息，texts, images and links。
  • Style：某个元素的视觉外观（颜色、字体、边框等）。
  • Layout：内容在页面上如何排列（对齐、间距、框的大小）。
  • Structure：HTML 元素如何互相嵌套，如 <li> 在 <ul>/<ol> 内，<th>/<td> 在 <tr> 内，<tr> 在 <table> 内。
HTML 负责 content 和 structure，CSS 负责 style 和 layout。考题常给同一页面的两张截图：内容和结构一样，你要说出改了哪些 style/layout property。

ex.q: Classify each change: (i) a paragraph is moved from left-aligned to centred; (ii) a photo is replaced by another photo; (iii) a heading turns red; (iv) a <li> is moved from a <ul> into an <ol>.
ex.a:
(i) Layout (arrangement, text-align).
(ii) Content (images are content).
(iii) Style (visual appearance of an element).
(iv) Structure (how elements are nested).
ex.az: (i) 布局 (ii) 内容 (iii) 样式 (iv) 结构。

ex.q: Write an inline style so that a <h2> 'Sports Day' has an orange background and right-aligned text.
ex.a:
<h2 style="background-color: orange; text-align: right">Sports Day</h2>
Two declarations inside the style attribute, separated by a semicolon.
ex.az: 在 style 属性里写两条声明，用分号隔开。

cards.en:
Inline styles work, but the book lists three limitations. Learn the names exactly:
  1. Lack of code reusability: an inline style applies to one element only. If 12 <li> items with girls' names must all be red and underlined, the same style must be copied into every element.
  2. Reduced maintainability: if the colour later changes from red to pink, you must edit every element by hand, and it is easy to miss one.
  3. Entangled code: style and structure are mixed together. Long inline styles make the HTML hard to read, and it becomes hard to see the page's structure.
Using CSS selectors in a stylesheet avoids most of these problems: write the rule once, apply it to many elements, change it in one place.
cards.zh:
Inline style 可以用，但课本列出 三个缺点（名称要背）：
  1. Lack of code reusability：只作用于一个元素。12 个女生名字的 <li> 都要红色加下划线，就要每个复制一次。
  2. Reduced maintainability：颜色由红改粉时，要逐个手动修改，容易漏。
  3. Entangled code：样式和结构混在一起，长的 inline style 让 HTML 难读，看不清页面结构。
改用样式表里的 CSS selector 可避免大部分问题：写一次、用于多个元素、改一处即可。

ex.q: A page lists 30 products; 10 of them are 'on sale' and use style="color:red; font-weight:bold". Give two problems and a better method.
ex.a:
Problems: (1) Lack of code reusability: the same style is repeated 10 times. (2) Reduced maintainability: changing the sale colour needs 10 edits. (Also entangled code.)
Better: 
.sale { color: red; font-weight: bold; }
and write class="sale" on the 10 items.
ex.az: 问题：不能复用、难维护。改为定义 .sale class，再给 10 个元素加 class="sale"。

cards.tz: 网页用户体验设计 Web UX
cards.en:
Web User Experience (UX) Design (Application & Career box) is about creating digital environments that are visually appealing, easy to navigate and functional. It focuses on usability, accessibility and performance.

UX work is a team effort: UI designers, developers, content creators and data analysts work together.

Two principles:
  • User-centred design: decisions are based on the needs of the real users.
  • Universal design: the site should be usable by people with different abilities.
Methods: user research, iterative testing (test, improve, test again) and following web accessibility guidelines. CSS is the main tool a web developer uses to turn a UX design into a real page.
cards.zh:
Web User Experience (UX) Design（Application & Career）：打造美观、易导航、功能好的数字环境，重视 usability, accessibility, performance。

需要团队合作：UI designers, developers, content creators, data analysts。

两个原则：
  • User-centred design：以真实用户需要为中心做决定。
  • Universal design：让不同能力的人都能使用。
方法：user research、iterative testing（测试→改进→再测试）、遵守 web accessibility guidelines。CSS 是开发者把 UX 设计变成真实网页的主要工具。

ex.q: A bank's website uses light grey text on a white background. Which UX principle does this break, and how would you fix it?
ex.a: It breaks universal design / accessibility: users with weak eyesight cannot read low-contrast text. Fix: use a dark text colour, e.g. color: #222;, and test with real users (iterative testing) against web accessibility guidelines.
ex.az: 违反 universal design / accessibility：视力弱的人看不清。改用深色文字，并按无障碍指引测试。

cards.en:
When a browser renders a page, it treats every HTML element as an invisible box. The element's content (usually text) is displayed inside this box. This is the CSS box model.

Each box has many style properties that can be controlled, for example its border, colour and margin; padding, height and width are covered in 1.2.

From the inside out a box is: content → padding → border → margin. By default the border is invisible, so you only 'see' the box when you give it a border or a background colour.

Thinking in boxes helps explain layout: headings and paragraphs are boxes stacked from top to bottom, and the gaps between them are margins.
cards.zh:
浏览器渲染网页时，把每个 HTML 元素都当成一个看不见的 box，元素内容（通常是文字）显示在 box 里，这就是 CSS box model。

每个 box 有很多可控的 style properties，例如 border、colour、margin（padding、height、width 见 1.2）。

由内到外：content → padding → border → margin。border 默认看不见，所以加了边框或背景色才“看到”这个 box。

用 box 来想布局：标题、段落是一个个从上到下排列的 box，之间的空隙就是 margin。

ex.q: A <p> has padding: 10px; border: solid 2px; margin: 20px;. Its text is 100px wide. How wide is the area from the outer edge of the left border to the outer edge of the right border (CSS default box sizing)?
ex.a: Content 100 + padding 10×2 + border 2×2 = 124px. The margin (20px each side) is outside the border, so it is not included.
ex.az: 100+20+4=124px；margin 在边框外，不计。

cards.en:
Every element has many style properties that decide how it looks when rendered: colour, font, alignment, border and so on.

If no CSS or inline style is written, the browser uses the default value of each property. That is why an unstyled <h1> is still big and bold, a <p> is black text on a white page, and boxes have no visible border.

To change the appearance, we assign a different value to a style property, e.g. change color and text-decoration, or background-color and font-family. The power of CSS is that one set of values can be applied to one or many elements at once.

Exam tip: if a question asks for the colour of text that no rule touches, the answer is the default, normally black.
cards.zh:
每个元素都有很多 style properties，决定它渲染时的样子：颜色、字体、对齐、边框等。

没写 CSS 或 inline style 时，浏览器用每个 property 的默认值 (default value)。所以没设样式的 <h1> 仍然又大又粗，<p> 是白底黑字，box 没有可见边框。

要改外观，就给 style property 赋另一个值，如改 color 和 text-decoration，或 background-color 和 font-family。CSS 的厉害之处是一组值能一次用于一个或多个元素。

考试提示：没有任何规则影响的文字，颜色就是默认值，一般是黑色。

ex.q: CSS: .cheap { border: solid red 2px; }. HTML: <p class="cheap">Vietnam</p>. What colour is the text 'Vietnam'?
ex.a: No rule sets color for this element, so the browser uses the default value: black. (The border is red, but border colour is not text colour.) [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q3]
ex.az: 没有规则设 color，用默认值黑色；红色的是边框不是文字。

cards.t: CSS syntax: selector and declaration block
cards.tz: CSS 语法：选择器与声明块

ex.q:
Find and correct the errors: 
p (
  color = blue,
  font-size: 14px
)
ex.az: 圆括号→花括号；= →冒号；逗号→分号。

cards.t: Where to put CSS: internal vs external (overview)
cards.en:
CSS rules (selectors with declaration blocks) must be written somewhere the browser can find them. There are two ways:
  • Internal Style Sheet: CSS is written inside the same HTML file, between <style> and </style>, normally inside <head>.
  • External Style Sheet: CSS is written in a separate .css file and connected to the page with a <link> element.
Together with inline styles, that gives three places where styling can come from. The examples in 1.1 to 1.3 use internal style sheets so that everything fits in one file; section 1.4 compares the two methods in detail (advantages, disadvantages, relative/absolute paths, frameworks).
cards.zh:
CSS 规则要写在浏览器找得到的地方，有两种：
  • Internal Style Sheet：CSS 写在同一个 HTML 文件里的 <style>…</style> 中，一般在 <head>。
  • External Style Sheet：CSS 写在独立的 .css 文件，用 <link> 元素连到网页。
加上 inline style，样式共有三个来源。1.1–1.3 的例子都用 internal style sheet 方便放在一个文件；1.4 详细比较两者（优缺点、相对/绝对路径、框架）。

ex.q: Name the three places where the style of <p id="a"> could come from.
ex.a: (1) Inline style in its style attribute; (2) an internal style sheet in <style> in the same file; (3) an external style sheet (.css file) linked with <link>.
ex.az: inline style、internal style sheet、external style sheet。

cards.en:
Selectors solve the main weakness of inline styles: one declaration block can be applied to many elements. The syllabus needs three kinds:
  1. Element-wise selector (also called type selector): an HTML element name with no symbol in front, e.g. p, h1, tr. Applies to all elements of that type.
  2. ID selector: starts with #, e.g. #name. Applies to the one element with that id.
  3. Class selector: starts with . (dot), e.g. .girl. Applies to every element with that class.
Reading the first character of a selector tells you its type instantly: letter = element, # = ID, . = class.
cards.zh:
Selector 解决 inline style 的最大缺点：一个声明块可用于多个元素。课程要三种：
  1. Element-wise selector（又叫 type selector）：HTML 元素名，前面没有符号，如 p、h1、tr，作用于所有该类元素。
  2. ID selector：以 # 开头，如 #name，作用于该 id 的那一个元素。
  3. Class selector：以 . 开头，如 .girl，作用于所有带该 class 的元素。
看第一个字符就知类型：字母=element，#=ID，.=class。

ex.q: Identify the type of each selector: tr, .senior, #intro, img, .sci-teacher.
ex.a: tr: element-wise; .senior: class; #intro: ID; img: element-wise; .sci-teacher: class.
ex.az: tr、img 是 element；.senior、.sci-teacher 是 class；#intro 是 ID。

cards.zh:
Element-wise selector（type selector）最简单：必须是合法 HTML 元素名，前面没有符号：p、ul、li、table、img、tr…

其声明块作用于文档中所有该类元素。
<style>
  p {
    color: purple;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
</style>
所有 <p> 变紫并加下划线，<h1>、<li> 不受影响。

适合全站统一外观（如所有段落用 Arial）。它的 specificity 最低，特殊元素可用 class、ID 或 inline style 覆盖。

ex.q: CSS: h1 { text-decoration: underline; }. The page has one <h1> 'Future energy sources...' and four <li> items. Which text is underlined?
ex.a: Only the <h1> text 'Future energy sources to combat climate change', since the type selector h1 matches only <h1> elements. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.1(a)]
ex.az: 只有 <h1> 的文字有下划线。

cards.t: The id attribute and ID selector
cards.tz: id 属性与 ID 选择器

ex.q: Make the paragraph with id 'para1' have a solid border and width 250px, and the heading with id 'title' red and right-aligned.
ex.a:
#title { color: red; text-align: right; }
#para1 { border: solid; width: 250px; }
Method: decide which property gives each change, then put it in that element's ID selector. (Book Example 1.1)
ex.az: 先找出对应 property，再写进该元素的 ID selector。

cards.t: Class selector and the class attribute
cards.tz: 类选择器与 class 属性
cards.zh:
Class selector = . + class 名，作用于 class 属性含该名称的任何元素（不论元素类型）。
.girl   { color: pink; }
.senior { text-decoration: underline; }
在 HTML 用 class attribute 加 class；一个元素可有多个 class，用空格分隔：
<li class="senior">James He (F5, Boy)</li>
<li class="girl senior">Sandy Huang (F5, Girl)</li>
Sandy 同时得到粉色和下划线。

命名规则：class 名不能有空格（空格表示两个 class），多个单词用 hyphen（sci-teacher）或 underscore（sci_teacher）。class 适合表示一组元素。

ex.q: CSS: .benefit{color:green} .threat{color:red}. HTML: Nuclear Power (no class), Natural Gas (threat), Hydro Power (benefit), Solar Power (benefit). (a) Which text is green? (b) Edit one line so Nuclear Power looks like Natural Gas.
ex.a:
(a) Hydro Power and Solar Power.
(b) 
<li class="threat">Nuclear Power</li>
(Book's version wrote colour; real CSS needs color.) [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.1]
ex.az: (a) Hydro Power 和 Solar Power；(b) 给 Nuclear Power 加 class="threat"。

cards.en:
ID selectorClass selector
Symbol#.
HTML attributeidclass
Elements matchedone unique element per pageany number of elements
Per elementone idcan have many classes (space-separated)
Specificityhigherlower
When to use which: use an ID for one special element (the page title, a unique banner). Use a class for a group of elements sharing a look (all senior students, all 'locker' locations). If you find yourself wanting the same id on two elements, you need a class instead.
cards.zh:
ID selectorClass selector
符号#.
HTML 属性idclass
匹配页内唯一一个元素任意多个元素
每个元素一个 id可有多个 class（空格分隔）
Specificity较高较低
怎样选：一个特别元素（网页标题、唯一横幅）用 ID；一组同样外观的元素（所有高年级生、所有 locker 地点）用 class。想把同一 id 给两个元素时，就该改用 class。

ex.q: A page shows 8 news items; 3 are 'urgent' and should have a red border; the single page logo needs a fixed width. Which selector for each? Write the CSS.
ex.a:
Urgent items = a group → class; logo = one element → ID.
.urgent { border: solid red 2px; }
#logo { width: 150px; }
ex.az: 一组用 class，唯一元素用 ID。

cards.t: Which elements a property applies to
cards.en:
Section 1.2 lists the commonly used style properties. Before learning them, note that not every property works on every element:
  • Some properties apply to almost all elements, for example margin and padding (every element is a box).
  • Some apply only to particular elements, for example list-style only affects <ul> and <ol> (it changes the bullets or numbers).
Writing a property on an element it does not apply to is not an error; the browser simply ignores it.

The properties are grouped in the Chapter Summary as font-related (color, font-family, font-weight, font-size, text-decoration) and layout-related (text-align, border, padding, margin, height, width), plus background-color.
cards.zh:
1.2 介绍常用 style properties。先要知道：不是每个 property 都适用于所有元素：
  • 有些几乎所有元素都可用，如 margin、padding（每个元素都是 box）。
  • 有些只对特定元素有效，如 list-style 只影响 <ul>、<ol>（改项目符号或编号）。
把 property 写在不适用的元素上不算错，浏览器会忽略。

Chapter Summary 把它们分成字体相关（color, font-family, font-weight, font-size, text-decoration）和布局相关（text-align, border, padding, margin, height, width），另加 background-color。

ex.q: Will p { list-style: square; } change a paragraph? What about ul { list-style: square; }?
ex.a: No visible change for <p>: list-style applies only to lists (<ul>/<ol>). For <ul> the bullets become squares.
ex.az: p 无变化；ul 的项目符号变成方块。

cards.en:
color sets the text colour of an element. A colour value can be written in three ways:
  • Name-colour (HTML colour name): red, orange, coral, darkslategrey, LightSeaGreen (names are not case-sensitive).
  • Hexadecimal RGB value: # + 6 hex digits, two each for red, green, blue (00 to FF), e.g. #ff8833, #FFFFFF = white, #000000 = black.
  • Three-part RGB value with the rgb() function, each part 0 to 255: rgb(144,3,20).
The same three formats are used by background-color and the colour part of border.

Spelling warning: the property is color (American). colour is ignored by browsers.
cards.zh:
color 设置元素的文字颜色。颜色值有三种写法：
  • Name-colour（HTML 颜色名）：red、orange、coral、darkslategrey、LightSeaGreen（不分大小写）。
  • Hexadecimal RGB value：# + 6 位十六进制，红绿蓝各两位（00–FF），如 #ff8833；#FFFFFF=白，#000000=黑。
  • Three-part RGB value，用 rgb()，每部分 0–255：rgb(144,3,20)。
background-color 和 border 的颜色部分也用这三种格式。

拼写注意：property 是 color（美式），写 colour 会被浏览器忽略。

ex.q: Convert #FF8833 to the rgb() form. Also, what colour is h1 { color: #FFFFFF; }?
ex.a:
FF = 255, 88 = 8×16+8 = 136, 33 = 3×16+3 = 51 → rgb(255,136,51).
#FFFFFF means red, green and blue all at maximum → white. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q2(b)]

cards.en:
• font-family sets the typeface: font-family: Arial; Arial is the most common because almost every OS has it. Names with spaces need quotes: "Courier New". You may list several fonts; the browser uses the first one that is installed or downloadable. Enrichment: end the list with a fall-back generic family: serif, sans-serif, monospace, cursive, fantasy, e.g. font-family: Georgia, serif;
  • font-weight sets the weight/boldness: font-weight: bold;
  • font-size sets the size, usually in px (pixels), the common CSS length unit: font-size: 12px;. Relative keywords smaller / larger make it smaller/larger than the default.
Default: <h1> is large and bold, <p> is normal weight, about 16px.
cards.zh:
• font-family 设字体：font-family: Arial; Arial 最常用，几乎所有 OS 都有。含空格的名字要加引号："Courier New"。可列多个，浏览器用第一个已安装或可下载的。Enrichment：最后放 fall-back generic family：serif, sans-serif, monospace, cursive, fantasy，如 font-family: Georgia, serif;
  • font-weight 设粗细：font-weight: bold;
  • font-size 设大小，常用 px（pixel）：font-size: 12px;；也可用 smaller / larger（比默认小/大）。
默认：<h1> 大而粗，<p> 正常粗细约 16px。

ex.q: Write CSS so all paragraphs use Courier New (falling back to any monospace font), bold, 18px.
ex.a:
p {
  font-family: "Courier New", monospace;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 18px;
}
Quotes because the name has a space; monospace is the fall-back.
ex.az: 名字有空格要加引号，monospace 作后备。

cards.en:
• text-decoration adds decoration lines to text, e.g. text-decoration: underline;. (Other values: none, line-through, overline. none is often used to remove the underline from links.)
  • text-align sets the horizontal alignment of the text inside an element: left, right, center, justify (lines stretched to fill the width).
Book correction: the Chapter Summary table prints p { font-decoration: underline; }. There is no such property; it must be text-decoration. Some figures also write centre; the real value is center.
text-align is a layout property: it changes arrangement, not the text itself.
cards.zh:
• text-decoration 给文字加装饰线：text-decoration: underline;（其他值：none、line-through、overline；none 常用来去掉链接下划线）。
  • text-align 设元素内文字的水平对齐：left、right、center、justify（两端对齐）。
课本更正：Chapter Summary 印了 font-decoration: underline，没有这个 property，应是 text-decoration。有些图写 centre，真正的值是 center。
text-align 属于布局 property。

ex.q: Screenshot 1: 'The Peak' heading plain, left-aligned, white background. Screenshot 2: heading underlined, centred, with a coloured background. Which properties changed?
ex.a: text-decoration (underline), text-align (centred), background-color. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.2(a)]
ex.az: text-decoration、text-align、background-color。

cards.en:
background-color sets the colour behind the content of an element's box. It accepts the same three colour formats as color: name-colour (lightblue), hex (#ffb804) and rgb (rgb(80,135,6)).

The background fills the content and the padding area (inside the border), but not the margin. So padding makes a coloured box look bigger, while a margin leaves a gap of the parent's colour.

Setting it on <body> colours the whole page, e.g. <body style="background-color: aliceblue;">.

Design trap: text colour and background colour must contrast. White text (color: white) on a white <p> background is invisible. This exact point appears in the textbook exercises.
cards.zh:
background-color 设元素 box 内容后面的颜色，值的格式与 color 相同：颜色名（lightblue）、hex（#ffb804）、rgb(80,135,6)。

背景会填满 content 和 padding 区域（border 以内），不包括 margin。所以 padding 让色块变大，margin 则留出父元素颜色的空隙。

设在 <body> 上会改整页背景，如 <body style="background-color: aliceblue;">。

设计陷阱：文字颜色与背景色要对比。白字放在白色背景的 <p> 上会看不见（课本习题考过）。

ex.q: p { background-color: white; }. Mary wants .popular { color: white; } for <p class="popular"> items. What problem arises?
ex.a: The text colour equals the paragraph's background colour, so the text with class popular cannot be seen. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q3(c)]
ex.az: 文字与背景同为白色，看不见。

cards.en:
Every element's box has a border, but by default it is invisible. The border property makes it visible:
  • border: solid; → solid line (default thin, black/current colour)
  • border: dashed; → dashed line
  • border: solid red 2px; → style, colour and width written together (shorthand; order is flexible but this is the book's form).
The border sits between padding and margin in the box model.

To change only one part of a border, edit that word: e.g. to make a 'cheap' item's border light blue, change border: solid red 2px; to border: solid lightblue 2px;. Borders are also used with height/width so you can see the size of a box.
cards.zh:
每个 box 都有边框，但默认看不见。用 border 显示：
  • border: solid; 实线
  • border: dashed; 虚线
  • border: solid red 2px; 样式、颜色、宽度一起写（简写）。
在 box model 中，border 位于 padding 和 margin 之间。

只改一部分就改那个词，例如把边框改浅蓝：border: solid lightblue 2px;。border 也常配合 height/width 让你看出 box 的大小。

ex.q: .cheap { border: solid red 2px; font-family: Arial; } is on line 24–25. 'Taiwan' and 'Vietnam' have class cheap. Modify ONE line so both get a solid light blue border.
ex.a:
Line 24: 
border: solid lightblue 2px;
Both elements share the class, so one change updates both. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q3(b)]
ex.az: 改第 24 行为 border: solid lightblue 2px;

cards.en:
• padding: the space between the element's content (usually text) and its border. Each side can be set separately: padding-top, padding-bottom, padding-left, padding-right, e.g. padding-top: 20px;
  • margin: the distance between elements (top/bottom margin) or between an element and the edge of the web page (left/right margin). Sides: margin-top, margin-left...
  • height and width: the height and width of the element's box, e.g. height: 50px; width: 150px;. Usually shown with border: solid so the size is visible.
Order from inside out: content → padding → border → margin. Padding is inside the border (gets the background colour); margin is outside (transparent).
cards.zh:
• padding：内容（通常是文字）与边框之间的距离。四边可分开设：padding-top / -bottom / -left / -right，如 padding-top: 20px;
  • margin：元素之间（上下）或元素与网页边缘（左右）的距离。也可分边：margin-top、margin-left…
  • height / width：box 的高与宽，如 height: 50px; width: 150px;，常配合 border: solid 才看得出。
由内到外：content → padding → border → margin。padding 在边框内（会涂上背景色）；margin 在边框外（透明）。

ex.q: Screenshot 2 of a Tom Hanks page shows: a box line around the paragraph, the text moved away from the left box line, and text in a different colour. Which properties?
ex.a: border (box line), padding / padding-left (gap between text and border), color. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.2(b)]
ex.az: border、padding(-left)、color。

cards.en:
Some textbook figures and checkpoints (e.g. Checkpoint 1.1 and 1.3) write colour: green; and text-align: centre; in British spelling. Real CSS only accepts the American spelling:
  • color, background-color
  • text-align: center
A browser silently ignores a declaration it does not understand, so colour: red; would leave the text black. No error message appears, which makes this bug hard to spot.

In the exam, always write color and center in code. In English sentences you may still write 'colour'. Similarly, the summary's font-decoration is a misprint for text-decoration.
cards.zh:
课本部分插图和 Checkpoint（如 1.1、1.3）用英式拼法 colour: green;、text-align: centre;。真正的 CSS 只认美式：
  • color、background-color
  • text-align: center
浏览器遇到不认识的声明会静默忽略，所以 colour: red; 文字仍是黑色，且不会报错，很难发现。

考试写代码一律用 color 和 center；英文句子里写 colour 没问题。同样，Summary 的 font-decoration 是 text-decoration 的印刷错误。

ex.q: p { colour: blue; text-align: centre; font-size: 20px; }. Describe the paragraph in a real browser.
ex.a: Both colour and centre are invalid and ignored. The text is the default black, left-aligned, but 20px (the valid declaration still applies).
ex.az: colour 和 centre 无效被忽略：黑色、左对齐，但 20px 生效。

cards.en:
Sometimes two or more declarations try to set the same style property of the same element. Example: p { color: blue; } and #intro { color: red; } both target <p id="intro">. The text cannot be both colours.

Specificity is the set of rules the browser uses to decide which selector is the most relevant to the element, and therefore which declaration is applied.

Summary of the rules in this chapter:
  1. Inline style beats everything.
  2. Among selectors: ID > class > element-wise.
  3. Same specificity: the declaration defined later in the CSS wins.
  4. Only the conflicting property is overridden; other declarations still apply.
This 'falling through' of rules is the 'Cascading' in CSS.
cards.zh:
有时两条或以上声明想设置同一元素的同一 property，如 p { color: blue; } 和 #intro { color: red; } 都选中 <p id="intro">，文字不可能两种颜色。

Specificity 是浏览器判断哪个 selector 与元素最相关、应用哪条声明的规则。

本章规则总结：
  1. Inline style 压倒一切。
  2. Selector 之间：ID > class > element-wise。
  3. 同级：CSS 中较后定义的胜。
  4. 只覆盖冲突的 property，其他声明照样生效。
这种层层叠加就是 CSS 里的 “Cascading”。

ex.q: Is there a specificity conflict between p { color: blue; } and .note { border: dashed; } on <p class="note">?
ex.a: No. They set different properties (color vs border), so both apply: blue text with a dashed border. Specificity only matters when the same property is set twice.
ex.az: 没有冲突：设置不同 property，两者都生效。

cards.en:
If a property is set both in an inline style and in CSS (internal or external), the browser always uses the inline style's value. The inline style is the 'closest' to the element.
#intro { color: red; border: solid; }

<p style="color: LightSeaGreen" id="intro">...</p>
Result: text is LightSeaGreen (inline wins for color), but border: solid still applies, because the inline style says nothing about border.

This is why changing ONE line to add an inline style is a common exam answer: it changes one element without affecting others. E.g. to make only one of many <p>s green: <p style="color: green">.
cards.zh:
同一 property 同时在 inline style 和 CSS（internal/external）中设置时，浏览器一定用 inline style 的值，它最“接近”元素。
#intro { color: red; border: solid; }

<p style="color: LightSeaGreen" id="intro">...</p>
结果：文字 LightSeaGreen，但 border: solid 仍然生效，因为 inline style 没设 border。

所以考试常见答案是“改一行加 inline style”：只改一个元素、不影响其他元素，如只让某个 <p> 变绿：<p style="color: green">。

ex.q: p { color: blue; font-size: 15px; } and <p style="background-color: lightblue; font-size:30px;">Hi everyone, my name is Tom.</p>. State the font colour and size.
ex.a: Colour: blue (only set by p, no conflict). Size: 30px (inline style overrides 15px). [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q1(a)]
ex.az: 颜色蓝（无冲突）；大小 30px（inline 覆盖）。

ex.q: CSS: #description{background-color:lightgray;font-size:25px} p{background-color:white;font-size:10px} .locker{background-color:lightblue}. HTML: <p id="description">Locations</p>. Font size and background of 'Locations'?
ex.a: Matching rules: #description (ID) and p (element). ID wins both conflicts → 25px, lightgray. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q4(a)]
ex.az: ID 胜 element：25px，lightgray。

cards.t: Equal specificity: the later rule wins

ex.q: .popular{color:goldenrod;font-family:Arial} .cheap{border:solid red 2px;font-family:Arial}. <p class="popular cheap">Taiwan</p>. Text colour and border?
ex.a: color is set only by .popular → goldenrod. Border from .cheap → solid red 2px. font-family conflicts but both are Arial. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q3(a)(i)]
ex.az: 颜色 goldenrod；边框红色实线 2px。

cards.en:
Wrong idea: class="intro highlight" and class="highlight intro" give different results, because the last class name 'wins'.

Correct: the order of class names in the class attribute has no effect. When two class selectors conflict, only the order in which the declarations are defined in the CSS matters.
.intro { color: green; }
.highlight { color: red; }
Both <p class="intro highlight"> and <p class="highlight intro"> are red.

To make them green you would have to move the .intro rule after .highlight in the stylesheet, or use a higher-specificity selector (ID or inline style).
cards.zh:
错误想法：class="intro highlight" 与 class="highlight intro" 结果不同，最后的 class 名胜出。

正确：class 属性里 class 名的顺序没有影响。两个 class selector 冲突时，只看 CSS 中声明定义的先后。
.intro { color: green; }
.highlight { color: red; }
<p class="intro highlight"> 和 <p class="highlight intro"> 都是红色。

想变绿要把 .intro 规则移到 .highlight 后面，或用更高 specificity 的 selector（ID 或 inline）。

ex.q: CSS: .a{color:blue} .b{color:orange}. What colour are <span class="b a"> and <span class="a b">?
ex.a: Both orange: .b is defined later in the CSS; attribute order is irrelevant.
ex.az: 两者都是橙色，看 CSS 定义次序。

cards.t: Changing the element tag and specificity

ex.q: In the code above, change one line so 'Sapientia et Virtus' (a plain <p>) is green without changing anything else.
ex.a:
Change its opening tag to 
<p style="color: green">
The inline style overrides p's blue for this element only; other paragraphs stay blue. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.3(b)]
ex.az: 加 inline style color: green，只影响这一段。

cards.zh:
Internal style sheet：CSS 写在 HTML 文件内的 <style>…</style>。理论上可放任何位置，但最佳做法是放在 <head>：提高可读性，避免和 <body> 的 HTML 纠缠。
<head>
  <style>
    .girl { color: pink; }
  </style>
</head>
优点：CSS 和 HTML 在同一文件，小项目方便；加载较快，不用另外请求 .css 文件。
缺点：reusability 有限，其他 HTML 文件用不了；网页多时每页各有一份，难维护。
现代做法：大部分 CSS 放 external，internal 只放某页特有的样式。

ex.q: A one-page birthday invitation uses 5 CSS rules. Internal or external? Why?
ex.a: Internal: it is a single small page, so keeping CSS and HTML in one file is convenient, and it loads faster because no extra .css request is needed. Reusability is not needed.
ex.az: 单页小项目用 internal：方便、加载快，无需复用。

cards.t: External style sheet and the <link> element
cards.en:
An external style sheet is a separate file with extension .css that contains only CSS (no <style> tags). It is connected to a page with the <link> element in <head>:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
  • rel="stylesheet" tells the browser the linked file is a CSS style sheet.
  • href gives the path of the CSS file (relative or absolute).
  • Several <link> elements can load several CSS files.
Advantages: one style sheet can be used by many HTML files → consistent style across pages; change one file and every page updates (easy maintenance); in large projects CSS can be developed in parallel with HTML, improving collaboration.
Disadvantage: the browser must make an extra request for the .css file, so loading is slightly slower.
cards.zh:
External style sheet 是扩展名 .css、只含 CSS（不写 <style>）的独立文件，用 <head> 里的 <link> 连接：
<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
  • rel="stylesheet"：告诉浏览器链接的是 CSS 样式表。
  • href：CSS 文件路径（相对或绝对）。
  • 可用多个 <link> 引入多个 CSS 文件。
优点：一份样式表可用于多个 HTML 文件 → 各页风格一致；改一个文件所有页面更新（易维护）；大项目中 CSS 可与 HTML 并行开发，改善协作。
缺点：浏览器要额外请求 .css，加载稍慢。

ex.q: Write the line that links css/main.css (folder css next to the HTML file) and explain each attribute.
ex.a:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/main.css">
rel="stylesheet": the linked file is a CSS style sheet. href: the (relative) path to it. Put it inside <head>.
ex.az: rel 说明是样式表；href 是相对路径；放在 <head>。

cards.en:
The href of <link> can be a relative or absolute path.
  • Relative path: used when the CSS file is in the same root directory or on the same domain / web server as the HTML. The path is relative to the HTML file's location: href="style.css", href="css/style.css".
  • Absolute path: gives the exact location like a URL, which may be on the local machine, network storage or the Internet. Often used for third-party CSS libraries on another domain: href="https://www.bootbelt.net/coolStyle.css".
With an absolute path, after loading the HTML the browser fetches the CSS from that location and applies it. Relative paths keep working when the whole site folder is moved to another server; absolute paths break if the remote file is moved or the site is offline.
cards.zh:
<link> 的 href 可用相对或绝对路径。
  • Relative path：CSS 与 HTML 在同一 root directory 或同一 domain / web server，路径相对 HTML 所在位置：href="style.css"、href="css/style.css"。
  • Absolute path：像 URL 一样给出确切位置，可在本机、网络存储或 Internet。常用于其他 domain 的第三方 CSS 库：href="https://www.bootbelt.net/coolStyle.css"。
用绝对路径时，浏览器载入 HTML 后到该位置取 CSS 并应用。整个网站文件夹搬到别的服务器时相对路径仍可用；远程文件搬走或离线时绝对路径会失效。

ex.q: Classify: (i) style.css (ii) https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/bootstrap.min.css (iii) ../theme/dark.css
ex.a: (i) relative; (ii) absolute (full URL on another domain); (iii) relative (one folder up, then theme).
ex.az: (i)(iii) 相对；(ii) 绝对。

cards.tz: 内部与外部样式表比较
cards.en:
InternalExternal
Where<style> in <head> of the HTML fileseparate .css file, linked with <link>
Reusabilitylimited, one page onlyshared by many pages
Consistencypages may drift apartconsistent style
Maintenancehard with many pagesedit one file
Loadingfaster, no extra requestextra request for .css
TeamworkCSS mixed in HTML fileCSS developed in parallel
Exam answers: when asked how a multi-page site should organise CSS, answer external style sheet and give a benefit (consistency / maintainability). For a single small page, internal is acceptable.
cards.zh:
InternalExternal
位置HTML 的 <head> 里 <style>独立 .css，用 <link>
复用有限，只限一页多页共用
一致性各页可能不一致风格一致
维护页数多时困难改一个文件
加载较快多一次请求
协作CSS 混在 HTML 文件可并行开发
考试：问多页网站怎样组织 CSS，答 external style sheet 并写一个好处（一致性/易维护）。单个小页面用 internal 也可。

ex.q: Kenny wants every paragraph with class note on 20 pages to turn red. Suggest how to organise the CSS and give one benefit.
ex.a: Put the rules in an external style sheet linked to all 20 pages with <link rel="stylesheet" href="site.css">; change .note { color: red; } once. Benefit: one edit updates every page / consistent style / easier maintenance.
ex.az: 用 external style sheet，改一处所有页面更新。

cards.en:
Writing all CSS from scratch takes time, so developers often use third-party CSS frameworks. A framework provides predefined styling for common elements such as buttons, tables and lists. The CSS is already written and stored in files on the Internet. Popular examples: Bootstrap and W3.CSS. The predefined looks are called components.

How to use one:
  1. Link the framework's style sheet with <link> (usually an absolute path to a CDN).
  2. Add the specified class names to your elements.
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/bootstrap.min.css">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
Benefits: saves time, professional and consistent look. It is just an external style sheet with class selectors, so all the specificity rules still apply.
cards.zh:
从零写 CSS 费时，所以常用 third-party CSS framework：为按钮、表格、列表等提供预设样式 (predefined styling)，CSS 已写好放在网上。常见：Bootstrap、W3.CSS；预设外观叫 components。

用法：
  1. 用 <link> 引入框架样式表（通常是 CDN 的绝对路径）。
  2. 给元素加指定的 class name。
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/bootstrap.min.css">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
好处：省时、外观专业一致。它本质上是带 class selector 的 external style sheet，specificity 规则照样适用。

ex.q: You linked Bootstrap and wrote <button class="btn btn-primary">. You also have your own <button style="background-color: green">-style override on it. What colour is it?
ex.a: Green: the inline style has higher specificity than Bootstrap's class selectors, so it overrides only the background colour; the other button styles from the framework remain.
ex.az: 绿色：inline style 高于框架的 class selector，只覆盖背景色。

cards.en:
Section 1.5 is about concepts of user-interface design; you are not required to implement them fully in CSS.

There are no rigid rules, but a good UI should be:
  • Consistent: the same kind of control looks and behaves the same everywhere.
  • Easy to navigate: users can quickly reach common functions.
  • Clear to users: users can see what they selected and what the results mean.
Typical exam question: you are given a scenario and must draft a user interface (a sketch of a browser window with labelled controls). Marks go for choosing suitable input controls and clearly showing results. Always label each control and include a search/submit button.
cards.zh:
1.5 讲用户界面设计的概念，不需要用 CSS 完整实现。

没有死板规则，但好的 UI 应该：
  • Consistent：同类控件在各处外观、行为一致。
  • Easy to navigate：用户能快速到达常用功能。
  • Clear to users：看得清自己选了什么、结果是什么。
常见考题：给一个情境，要你草拟用户界面（画浏览器窗口并标注控件）。得分点是选合适的输入控件并清楚显示结果。每个控件要加标签，要有 search/submit 按钮。

ex.q: Tom's blog has many posts. Draft a UI to search posts by date and keywords.
ex.a: Suggested answer: browser window with title 'Search posts'; Date: a calendar picker (or drop-downs for day/month/year, or a from/to date range); Keywords: a text box; a Search button; results shown as a list with post title, date and first line. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q1(c)]
ex.az: 日期用 calendar picker，关键词用 text box，加 Search 按钮，结果用列表显示。

cards.tz: 例子：图书馆设施预约系统
cards.en:
The book's first UI example is a library facility booking system. Good design elements:
  • Navigation bar: quick access to common functions (home, my bookings, login).
  • Drop-down menus: to choose search criteria such as branch and facility type, so users pick from valid options.
  • Search button: to submit the search.
  • Clear search results: clearly shows which room and which time slot is available to book.
Why it works: limited choices prevent typing mistakes, the navigation bar keeps the site easy to navigate, and the result table makes the booking decision clear.
cards.zh:
课本第一个 UI 例子是图书馆设施预约系统，好的设计元素：
  • Navigation bar：快速进入常用功能（首页、我的预约、登录）。
  • Drop-down menu：选择分馆、设施类型等搜索条件，只能选有效选项。
  • Search button：提交搜索。
  • Clear search results：清楚显示哪间房、哪个时段可预约。
为什么好：有限选项避免打错字；导航栏易导航；结果表让预约决定清晰。

ex.q: Why use a drop-down menu for 'branch' instead of a text box?
ex.a: Users choose from the list of valid branches, so they cannot make a typo (a misspelt branch in a text box would return no results); it is also faster and consistent.
ex.az: 防止打错字导致没有结果，也更快。

cards.en:
The second example is an online shop product catalogue. Good design elements:
  • Filtering criteria: filter products by category, and clearly show the currently selected category.
  • Login status shown clearly in the navigation bar.
  • Each product shows a thumbnail image plus product name and price.
  • A search function.
These match the two requirements often asked in exams: (1) clearly display information of products (image, name, price), and (2) allow users to choose products of different categories (category filter with checkboxes or a drop-down / tabs).
cards.zh:
第二个例子是网店产品目录，好的设计元素：
  • Filtering criteria：按类别筛选，并清楚显示当前所选类别。
  • Login status 清楚显示在导航栏。
  • 每件产品有 thumbnail image 及名称、价格。
  • 搜索功能。
对应考试常见的两个要求：(1) 清楚显示产品资料（图片、名称、价格）；(2) 让用户选择不同类别的产品（用 checkbox、drop-down 或标签页筛选）。

ex.q: Jimmy's store sells football, basketball and table-tennis items. Draft a UI that clearly displays products and lets users choose categories.
ex.a: Suggested answer: navigation bar with logo, search box and login status; left panel with category checkboxes (Football, Basketball, Table tennis), selected ones highlighted; main area a grid of product cards, each with thumbnail, name and price. [Textbook Ch1 Exercise Q2(d)]
ex.az: 导航栏+类别 checkbox+产品网格（图片、名称、价格）。

cards.en:
Choosing the right control is the most tested UI skill:
  • Limited predefined options, more than one may be chosen → checkboxes (several districts, several facility types). A drop-down that allows only one choice would stop users searching more than one district.
  • Choose exactly one → drop-down menu or radio buttons.
  • Date → calendar picker, or drop-downs / number fields for day, month, year.
  • Free text (keywords, names) → text box.
Replace a text box with a drop-down or checkboxes whenever the options are known, to avoid typos that return no results. If the list of results or options is very long, add a filter or search instead of making the user scroll through a huge list.
cards.zh:
选对控件是最常考的 UI 技能：
  • 有限预设选项、可多选 → checkboxes（多个地区、多种设施）。只能单选的 drop-down 会让用户无法查多个地区。
  • 只选一个 → drop-down menu 或 radio buttons。
  • 日期 → calendar picker，或日/月/年的 drop-down / number field。
  • 自由文字（关键词、名字）→ text box。
选项已知时用 drop-down 或 checkbox 代替 text box，避免打错字导致没有结果。结果或选项很长时，加 filter / search，不要让用户滚动长列表。

ex.q: Mia's sports facility search needs: type of sports, date, district. Suggest an input control for each.
ex.a: Type of sports: checkboxes / drop-down menu. Date: calendar menu / drop-downs or number fields for year, month, day. District: checkboxes / drop-down menu. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.4(a)]
ex.az: 运动类型：checkbox/下拉；日期：日历；地区：checkbox/下拉。

cards.en:
Search results can be shown in two layouts:
  • List layout: one item per row. Advantage: more information about each item can be shown (description, opening hours, address).
  • Grid layout: items in rows and columns of cards. Advantage: more items can be shown at the same time on one screen; good when users browse mainly by pictures (products, photos).
Many sites let users switch between the two. In exam answers, give one advantage for each, using these exact phrases.
cards.zh:
搜索结果有两种布局：
  • List layout：每行一项。优点：每项可显示更多资料（介绍、开放时间、地址）。
  • Grid layout：一格格卡片排成行列。优点：同一画面可显示更多项目，适合靠图片浏览（产品、相片）。
很多网站让用户切换两种。考试各写一个优点，用上面的句子。

mc.e: The part before { } is the selector.
