chs.t: Introduction to Server Side Scripting (PHP I)
chs.tz: 服务器端脚本简介（PHP I）

cards.t: Learning objectives and the backend web developer
cards.tz: 学习目标与后端开发者
cards.en:
This chapter moves from the client side (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to the server side. By the end you should be able to:
  • explain the roles of the client and the server in a web application;
  • describe the difference between requesting an HTML file and a PHP file;
  • use PHP variables of different data types;
  • write server side scripts with basic constructs (echo, operators, strings);
  • use control structures (if, while, for, foreach);
  • use arrays and associative arrays, following good programming practice.
A backend web developer builds the server side of a website: the database, the server and the application logic. They handle user requests, manage data and generate dynamic content, using languages such as PHP, Ruby, Python or JavaScript. They are also responsible for the website's security and work with front-end developers so both sides fit together.
cards.zh:
本章由 client side（HTML、CSS、JavaScript）转到 server side。学完要能：
  • 解释 web application 中 client 与 server 的角色；
  • 说出请求 HTML file 与请求 PHP file 的分别；
  • 使用不同 data types 的 PHP 变量；
  • 用 echo、operators、strings 写 server side scripts；
  • 使用 control structures（if、while、for、foreach）；
  • 使用 arrays 与 associative arrays，并遵守 good programming practice。
Backend web developer 负责网站的 server side：database、server 和 application logic。他们处理 user requests、管理 data、generate dynamic content，常用 PHP、Ruby、Python、JavaScript；同时负责网站 security，并与 front-end developers 合作。

ex.q: A news website shows each logged-in reader a list of articles from the topics they follow. Which part of this work is done by a backend developer?
ex.a: The backend developer writes the server side logic: receive the request, look up the reader's followed topics in the database, choose the matching articles and generate the HTML dynamically before sending it back. The front-end developer styles how the list looks in the browser.
ex.az: 后端开发者写 server 端逻辑：收 request、查 database 中读者关注的主题、选文章并动态生成 HTML 回传；外观样式属 front-end。

cards.en:
A client is a device or application software that uses a service over the Internet, e.g. an email client or a video conference client. In a web application the client is usually the browser. A server provides a service: an email server manages accounts and delivers mail. Every website needs a web server, which stores the files (e.g. home.html) that make up the website. The HTML files live on the web server; when the client asks for a file, the server finds it and sends it back in a response.

Misconception: the client is not the user. The client is the browser (application software used to access web pages); the user is the person using the browser. In exam answers write "the browser (client) sends a request", not "the user sends a request".
cards.zh:
Client：透过 Internet 使用服务的 device 或 application software，例如 email client、video conference client。在 web application 中 client 通常就是 browser。Server：提供服务，如 email server 管理帐户、派送邮件。每个网站都要有 web server，它 stores the files（如 home.html）。Client 请求某个文件，server 找到后放在 response 里送回。

常见误解：client 不是 user。Client 是 browser（软件）；user 是使用 browser 的人。答题时写 "the browser (client) sends a request"，不要写 user 发 request。

ex.q: Identify the client and the server when Amy opens her school's eClass page on her iPad using Safari.
ex.a:
Client: Safari, the browser on the iPad (application software that requests the page).
Server: the school's web server that stores the eClass files and sends them back.
Amy herself is the user, not the client.
ex.az: Client 是 iPad 上的 Safari；server 是学校储存 eClass 文件的 web server；Amy 是 user，不是 client。

cards.en:
Every time a web page is loaded, the same request-response cycle happens:
  1. The user types a URL in the address bar or clicks a link.
  2. The browser (client) sends an HTTP request (method GET) to the server.
  3. The server receives the request and looks up the requested file in its directory.
  4. The server sends back an HTTP response containing the file.
  5. The client receives the response and renders the HTML in the response body into a web page.
  6. The user sees the page on the screen.
This cycle has hardly changed for twenty years; it has just become much faster (from seconds to under 0.1 s). Learn the steps in order with the key words request, look up, response, render: they are a common 3–4 mark question.
cards.zh:
每次载入网页都会发生 request-response cycle：
  1. User 在 address bar 输入 URL 或按 link；
  2. Browser（client）向 server 发出 HTTP request（method 为 GET）；
  3. Server 收到 request，在 directory 中 look up 所请求的文件；
  4. Server 回传含该文件的 HTTP response；
  5. Client 收到 response，把 response body 里的 HTML render 成网页；
  6. User 在屏幕看到网页。
二十年来这个流程几乎没变，只是由几秒变成少于 0.1 秒。按次序记住关键字 request、look up、response、render，常考 3–4 分。

ex.q: A user clicks a link to https://mysite.net/news.html. Describe what happens until the page appears. (4 marks)
ex.a:
1. The browser sends an HTTP GET request with request URL https://mysite.net/news.html to the web server. [1]
2. The web server looks up news.html in its directory. [1]
3. The server returns an HTTP response with status code 200, content type text/html and the file in the response body. [1]
4. The browser renders the HTML and the page is displayed. [1]
ex.az: 四步：GET request → server look up 文件 → 回传 response（200、text/html、文件在 body）→ browser render。

cards.en:
An HTTP request carries two key pieces of information:
ItemMeaning
Request URLwhich file on the server the client wants, e.g. https://mysite.net/helloWorld.html
Request MethodGET is used when typing a URL or clicking a link (POST is in Chapter 3)
An HTTP response carries three:
ItemMeaning
Status Codea 3-digit number showing whether the request was handled correctly
Content Typethe type of data in the body; for a web page it is text/html
Response Bodythe requested file itself, if successful
You can see these in the browser's developer tools (Network tab). Don't mix them up: the method belongs to the request, the status code to the response.
cards.zh:
HTTP request 有两项关键资料：Request URL（要 server 上哪个文件）和 Request Method（输入 URL 或按 link 用 GET；POST 在第 3 章）。
HTTP response 有三项：Status Code（3 位数字，表示 request 是否处理成功）、Content Type（body 的数据类型，网页为 text/html）、Response Body（成功时就是所请求的文件）。
在 browser 的 developer tools（Network 分页）可以看到这些资料。别混淆：method 属于 request，status code 属于 response。

ex.q: State which of the following belong to the HTTP request and which to the HTTP response: (i) GET (ii) 404 (iii) text/html (iv) https://a.com/x.php
ex.a:
(i) GET: request method → request.
(ii) 404: status code → response.
(iii) text/html: content type → response.
(iv) the URL: request URL → request.
ex.az: GET、URL 属 request；404、text/html 属 response。

cards.en:
The status code in the response tells the client what happened to its request. The codes you must know:
CodeMeaning
200Successfully processed (OK)
403Forbidden: the client has no permission to access the file
404Not found: the file does not exist on the server
500Internal server error, e.g. the server-side script crashed
503Server overload error (service unavailable)
Codes starting with 2 mean success, 4 means a problem with the client's request, 5 means a problem on the server. In scenario questions, match the description: "file was deleted / URL mistyped" → 404; "private folder" → 403; "too many users at ticket release" → 503.
cards.zh:
Response 中的 status code 告诉 client request 的结果。必背：
Code意思
200处理成功 (OK)
403Forbidden：client 无权限存取该文件
404Not found：server 上没有该文件
500Internal server error，如 server script 出错
503Server overload
2 字头＝成功，4 字头＝client 请求有问题，5 字头＝server 出问题。情境题：文件被删／URL 打错 → 404；私人文件夹 → 403；放票时太多人 → 503。

ex.q: Concert tickets go on sale at 10:00. Thousands of fans open the booking page at once and some get an error. Another fan mistypes the URL as /bookng.php. Which status codes do they likely get?
ex.a:
Fans during the rush: 503, server overload, because the server cannot handle so many requests.
The fan with the typo: 404, not found, because /bookng.php does not exist on the server.
ex.az: 人多挤爆 → 503；URL 打错文件不存在 → 404。

cards.en:
A static web page uses only HTML and CSS, so its content is the same no matter who requests it or when. A dynamic web page shows different content according to predefined programming logic, for example search results based on the user's input, or "Good morning" / "Good afternoon" depending on the time.

The book's welcomePage example: the owner wants the greeting to change at noon. With a static page someone would have to edit the HTML by hand every day at 12:00, which is impossible. Instead, when the server receives the request it should:
  1. check whether the request arrived in the AM or PM;
  2. output "Good Morning" or "Good Afternoon" into the HTML accordingly;
  3. return the HTML file to the client as usual.
Running logic like this on the server is exactly what server side scripting (PHP) is for.
cards.zh:
Static web page 只用 HTML 和 CSS，content is the same no matter who requested it or when。Dynamic web page 按 predefined programming logic 显示不同内容，例如按 user 输入显示搜索结果，或按时间显示 Good morning／Good afternoon。

课本 welcomePage 例子：问候语要在中午转换。用 static page 就要每天 12:00 人手改 HTML，不可能。应该让 server 收到 request 时：
  1. 检查收到 request 的时间是 AM 还是 PM；
  2. 据此在 HTML 中输出 "Good Morning" 或 "Good Afternoon"；
  3. 照常把 HTML 回传 client。
在 server 上执行这类逻辑，正是 server side scripting（PHP）的用途。

ex.q: Classify each page as static or dynamic: (a) a school's 'About us' page; (b) an online shop's search results; (c) a page showing today's date.
ex.a:
(a) Static: the same content for everyone at all times.
(b) Dynamic: the content depends on the keywords the user entered.
(c) Dynamic: the content changes depending on when it is requested.
ex.az: (a) static；(b) dynamic，按输入；(c) dynamic，按时间。

cards.t: Server side scripting, PHP and .php files
cards.tz: Server side scripting、PHP 与 .php 文件
cards.en:
Server side scripting allows web developers to implement computational logic on a server, so the server can return different content dynamically. PHP stands for Hypertext Preprocessor; it is a programming language that runs on the server.

PHP code must be written in a file with the extension .php; to get a dynamic page the client requests a .php file instead of a .html file. Unlike a .py or .cpp file, a .php file can contain two kinds of code:
  • PHP code: must be placed between <?php and ?>; it is executed by the server to generate the page.
  • Non-PHP code (usually HTML): anything outside those tags; it is copied directly into the output.
cards.zh:
Server side scripting allows web developers to implement computational logic on a server，令 server 能 return different content dynamically。PHP = Hypertext Preprocessor，是在 server 上执行的 programming language。

PHP code 必须写在扩展名 .php 的文件中；要 dynamic 网页，client 请求的是 .php 而不是 .html。与 .py、.cpp 不同，一个 .php 文件可同时有两种代码：
  • PHP code：放在 <?php 与 ?> 之间，由 server 执行以生成网页；
  • Non-PHP code（通常是 HTML）：tag 以外的全部内容，会被直接复制到输出。

ex.a: Only echo "Hi"; (between <?php and ?>) is PHP code; it is executed. Everything else (<html>, <body>, <h1>My page</h1>, closing tags) is non-PHP code and is copied directly to the resulting HTML.
ex.az: 只有 echo "Hi"; 是 PHP code（会执行）；其余 HTML 是 non-PHP code，直接复制。

cards.t: The PHP interpreter and requesting a .php file
cards.tz: PHP Interpreter 与请求 .php 的流程
cards.en:
The PHP Interpreter is software installed on the web server. Its input is a PHP file and its output is an HTML file:
  • non-PHP code is copied directly to the output;
  • PHP code is executed (e.g. echo writes text into the output).
The resulting file contains only HTML, and that is what the server sends back. So the client never sees the PHP source code.

Requesting helloWorld.php:
  1. The web server receives the request for helloWorld.php.
  2. It looks up the file in its directory.
  3. The PHP Interpreter executes the PHP code and produces the resulting HTML file.
  4. The server returns the resulting HTML file; the browser renders it.
The difference from requesting a .html file is step 3: an HTML file is sent back as it is, a PHP file is processed on the server first.
cards.zh:
PHP Interpreter 是装在 web server 上的软件：input 是 PHP file，output 是 HTML file。
  • Non-PHP code → copied directly；
  • PHP code → executed（例如 echo 把文字写进输出）。
输出文件只有 HTML，server 回传的就是它，所以 client 永远看不到 PHP source code。

请求 helloWorld.php：
  1. Web server 收到 request；
  2. 在 directory 中 look up 该文件；
  3. PHP Interpreter 执行 PHP code，生成 resulting HTML file；
  4. 回传 resulting HTML，browser render。
与请求 .html 的分别在第 3 步：HTML 文件原样送回，PHP 文件要先在 server 上处理。

ex.q: A student right-clicks a PHP page and chooses 'View Page Source'. He cannot find any <?php tags. Explain why.
ex.a: The PHP code was executed by the PHP interpreter on the web server. Only the resulting HTML file (non-PHP code plus what echo produced) was sent in the HTTP response. The browser only ever receives HTML, so the source it shows contains no PHP code.
ex.az: PHP 在 server 执行，回传的只有 resulting HTML，所以 page source 没有 PHP。

cards.zh:
写 PHP 要记住：
  • PHP code 放在 <?php 和 ?> 之间；
  • Every statement must end with a semicolon ;（漏了就 syntax error）；
  • Non-PHP code 直接复制到 resulting HTML；
  • PHP 没有 indentation／换行要求（与 Python 不同），一句可跨多行，但仍应缩进以便阅读；
  • PHP code 可放在文件任何位置，可有多段 <?php ?>，甚至放在 HTML 元素内容里。
上例两段 PHP 放在 HTML 元素之内，interpreter 会把每段换成它 echo 出来的内容。

ex.q:
Find the errors:
<?php
  echo "Line one"
  echo "Line two";
ex.a:
1. The first echo statement is missing a semicolon: it should be echo "Line one";
2. The PHP block is not closed with ?> (needed when HTML follows; a file containing only PHP may omit it, but the book always closes it).
ex.az: 第一句漏分号；PHP 段落没用 ?> 关闭。

cards.t: echo: output to the resulting HTML
cards.en:
echo outputs the string after it into the resulting HTML file. Only the content of the string is output, not the quotation marks. The string can contain HTML tags: the interpreter outputs them as text and the browser then renders them, so PHP can dynamically produce both text and layout.
<?php echo "<h1>PHP is fun!</h1>"; ?>
<p>
<?php
  echo "To start learning:<br>";
  echo "<u>Click here</u>";
?>
</p>
Resulting HTML: <h1>PHP is fun!</h1><p>To start learning:<br><u>Click here</u></p> (line breaks in the HTML don't matter).
When an exam asks for the resulting HTML, write exactly what is echoed plus the copied HTML; when it asks what is displayed on the page, give the rendered text.
cards.zh:
echo 把其后的 string 输出到 resulting HTML file。输出的只是 string 的内容，没有引号。String 可以含 HTML tags：interpreter 原样输出，browser 再 render，所以 PHP 能动态产生文字和 layout。
上例 resulting HTML 为 <h1>PHP is fun!</h1><p>To start learning:<br><u>Click here</u></p>。
考题问 resulting HTML 时，写出 echo 的内容加复制过来的 HTML；问网页显示什么时，写 render 后的文字。

ex.a:
<h2> Hello World! </h2>
The <h2> tags are non-PHP code copied directly; the echo outputs Hello World! without the quotation marks.
ex.az: h2 tag 直接复制，echo 输出 Hello World!（无引号）。

cards.t: Misconception: echo does not create a new line
cards.tz: 误解：echo 不会自动换行
cards.en:
Unlike print in Python, echo does NOT create a new line. Also, line breaks inside an HTML file are not shown on the web page (the browser collapses whitespace). So the outputs of several echo statements appear on the same line, joined with no space. To start a new line on the page you must output a <br> tag (or wrap the text in block elements such as <p>).
echo "1"; echo "2";       // page shows: 12
echo "1<br>"; echo "2";   // page shows 1 and 2 on two lines
Other common slips: forgetting the semicolon; writing the quotation marks of echo into the resulting HTML; forgetting the spaces you need inside the strings.
cards.zh:
与 Python 的 print 不同，echo does NOT create a new line。而且 HTML 文件里的换行不会在网页上显示（browser 把空白合并）。所以几个 echo 的输出会在同一行连在一起，中间也没有空格。要在网页换行，必须输出 <br>（或用 <p> 等 block 元素）。
其他常见错误：漏分号；把 echo 的引号写进 resulting HTML；忘了在 string 里加需要的空格。

ex.a:
Line 1: Goodbye (no space, no new line between the first two echoes).
Line 2: See you (the <br> makes the browser start a new line).
ex.az: 第一行 Goodbye，第二行 See you（因 <br>）。

cards.en:
To run PHP you need a web server with a PHP interpreter. XAMPP provides local hosting: your computer acts as both the client and a local testing server (use PHP 7 or above).
  1. Download and install XAMPP from apachefriends.org (Windows default folder C:/xampp) and start Apache.
  2. Open the htdocs folder in the installation directory; it is the root directory of your local website.
  3. Create a sub-folder, e.g. demo, and save helloWorld.php in it.
  4. In the browser open localhost/demo/helloWorld.php.
Double-clicking a .php file does not run the PHP: the browser would open the file directly without any server, so the PHP code is not executed. It must be requested through the server (http://localhost/...).
cards.zh:
执行 PHP 需要装有 PHP interpreter 的 web server。XAMPP 提供 local hosting：你的电脑同时是 client 和 local testing server（建议 PHP 7 或以上）。
  1. 从 apachefriends.org 下载安装（Windows 默认 C:/xampp），启动 Apache；
  2. 打开安装目录的 htdocs 文件夹，它就是本地网站的 root directory；
  3. 建立子文件夹如 demo，把 helloWorld.php 放进去；
  4. 在 browser 打开 localhost/demo/helloWorld.php。
直接双击 .php 不会执行 PHP，因为没有经过 server；必须经 http://localhost/... 请求。

ex.q: A file is saved at C:/xampp/htdocs/shop/cart.php. What URL should be typed in the browser to run it, and why not just open the file?
ex.a:
URL: localhost/shop/cart.php (htdocs is the root directory, so it is not part of the URL).
Opening the file directly bypasses the web server, so the PHP interpreter never executes the code; the request must go to the server.
ex.az: 输入 localhost/shop/cart.php；直接开文件不会经 server，PHP 不会执行。

cards.en:
A PHP variable name must follow three rules:
  • it starts with $;
  • the first character after $ must be an underscore _ or a letter (not a digit);
  • after that, any letters, digits and underscores.
ValidInvalid (reason)
$name, $_date, $id1, $_2022ndms (no $), $21count (digit after $), $class@22 (symbol @), $my-name (hyphen)
Variable names are case-sensitive: $a and $A are different variables. Avoid names of superglobals such as $_GET and $_POST (used in Chapter 3). Choose meaningful names like $numStudent rather than $x.
cards.zh:
PHP 变量名三条规则：
  • 以 $ 开头；
  • $ 后第一个字元必须是 underscore _ 或英文字母（不可是数字）；
  • 之后可接任意字母、数字、underscore。
Valid：$name、$_date、$id1、$_2022；Invalid：ndms（无 $）、$21count（$ 后是数字）、$class@22（有 @）、$my-name（有 -）。
变量名 case-sensitive：$a 和 $A 是不同变量。别与 superglobals（如 $_GET、$_POST，第 3 章）同名。用有意义的名字，如 $numStudent。

ex.q: Which are valid PHP variable names? $total_2, $2total, total, $_ , $Total$
ex.a: $total_2: valid. $2total: invalid, digit after $. total: invalid, no $. $_: valid (underscore allowed as first character). $Total$: invalid, $ is not allowed inside the name.
ex.az: 有效：$total_2、$_；无效：$2total、total、$Total$。

cards.t: Assignment and the four data types
cards.en:
Values are stored with the assignment operator =. A variable should be initialised (given a first value) when it is first declared. PHP has no type declaration: the type comes from the value.
TypeExamples
Integer0, 1, -2, 1000
Floating point (real)1.23, -2.0, 14.5
BooleanTrue, False (no quotes, otherwise it becomes a string)
String"Hello World" (a sequence of characters in double quotes)
$numStudent = 4;          // integer
$height = 181.2;          // floating point
$valid = True;            // Boolean
$message = "Welcome to my page";  // string
Note "True" and "4" in quotes are strings, not a Boolean or an integer.
cards.zh:
用 assignment operator = 储存数值；第一次 declare 时应 initialise。PHP 不用声明类型，类型由值决定：Integer（0、-2、1000）、Floating point（1.23、-2.0）、Boolean（True、False，不可加引号，加了就变 string）、String（"Hello World"，用双引号）。
注意 "True" 和 "4" 加了引号就是 string。

ex.q: State the data type of each value: (a) -7 (b) 3.0 (c) "3" (d) False (e) "False"
ex.a: (a) Integer (b) Floating point, it has a decimal point (c) String, it is in quotes (d) Boolean (e) String, quotes make it a string.
ex.az: (a) integer (b) float (c) string (d) Boolean (e) string。

cards.t: Comments in PHP vs HTML comments
cards.en:
Comments explain code or mark places to change later; the PHP interpreter ignores them.
  • Single-line: // or #
  • Multi-line: /* ... */
<?php
  //$id stores the user id
  $id = "A1121";
  /* Future code goes
     here when needed */
  echo $id;
?>
<!-- Add table here in future -->
PHP comments are ignored and do not appear in the resulting HTML. An HTML comment <!-- --> outside <?php ?> is non-PHP code, so it is copied to the resulting HTML; the browser does not display it, but a user who views the page source can read it. So never put secrets in HTML comments.
cards.zh:
Comment 用来解释代码或标记日后要改的地方，PHP interpreter 会忽略。单行：// 或 #；多行：/* ... */。
PHP comments 被忽略，不会出现在 resulting HTML。<?php ?> 以外的 HTML comment <!-- --> 属 non-PHP code，会被复制到 resulting HTML；browser 不显示，但查看 page source 就能看到。所以别把秘密写在 HTML comment 里。

ex.q: Write the resulting HTML of the code above.
ex.a:
A1121<!-- Add table here in future -->
Both PHP comments are removed; echo outputs A1121; the HTML comment is copied unchanged.
ex.az: PHP comments 消失，输出 A1121，HTML comment 照样复制。

cards.en:
With $a = 9; $b = 4;:
OperatorOperationResult
+Addition13
-Subtraction5
*Multiplication36
/Division2.25 (not integer division)
%Modulo (remainder)1
**Exponentiation94 = 6561
Normal precedence applies: ** first, then * / %, then + -; use brackets to be clear.
PHP's / gives a decimal when not exact. For floor division (round the quotient down) use the built-in function floor(): floor(9 / 4) gives 2.
cards.zh:
设 $a = 9; $b = 4;：+ 得 13，- 得 5，* 得 36，/ 得 2.25（不是整数除法），% (modulo) 取余数得 1，** (exponentiation) 94 = 6561。
优先次序：** 先，再 * / %，最后 + -；用括号最清楚。
PHP 的 / 不整除时会有小数；要 floor division（商向下取整）就用 built-in function floor()：floor(9 / 4) 得 2。

ex.q: You have $178. You buy 5 bananas at $12 each. How many $8 oranges can you buy with the rest? Write the PHP and the output.
ex.a:
$balance = 178; $banana = 12; $orange = 8;
echo floor(($balance - $banana * 5) / $orange);
178 − 60 = 118; 118 / 8 = 14.75; floor gives 14.

cards.en:
Combined assignment operators are short forms (called syntactic sugar):
OperatorExampleSame as
+=$a += $b;$a = $a + $b;
-=$a -= $b;$a = $a - $b;
(Also *=, /=, %= and .= for appending a string.)
PHP also has increment/decrement operators, which Python does not: $a++; means $a = $a + 1; and $a--; means $a = $a - 1;. They are commonly used as the afterthought of a for loop. When tracing, update the variable table line by line.
cards.zh:
Combined assignment operators 是简写（syntactic sugar）：$a += $b; 等于 $a = $a + $b;；$a -= $b; 等于 $a = $a - $b;（另有 *=、/=、%=，以及接 string 的 .=）。
PHP 有 Python 没有的 increment/decrement operators：$a++; 即加 1，$a--; 即减 1，常用作 for loop 的 afterthought。Trace 时逐行更新变量表。

点号 . 把多个 string 接成一个，可赋值给变量或直接 echo。要点：
  • PHP 中 + 不能接 string（与 Python 不同）；
  • 空格不会自动加，要写进 string 里；
  • .= 可在后面追加：$s .= "!";
课本 Example 2.1 的 resulting HTML 只写 echo 出来的内容，不写引号和点；网页显示两行（因 <br>）。

ex.q: $first = "Chan"; $last = "Tai Man"; Write one echo statement using concatenation to output: Name: Chan Tai Man
ex.a:
echo "Name: " . $first . " " . $last;
The middle " " supplies the space between the two names.
ex.az: 中间要接 " " 才有空格。

cards.en:
Some characters inside a double-quoted string must be preceded by a backslash \ to be output correctly; this is escaping.
CharacterEscapeExampleOutput
"\"echo "That is \"great\"";That is "great"
\\\echo "Choose A\\B";Choose A\B
$\$echo "Cost: \$56.8";Cost: $56.8
Why: in echo "My favourite robot is "Marvin""; the inner " makes the interpreter think the string has ended, so it cannot tell where the string starts and ends → syntax error. A $ inside double quotes is read as the start of a variable, so write \$ to show a dollar sign. The output contains only the character, not the backslash.
cards.zh:
在双引号 string 里，有些字元前面要加 backslash \ 才能正确输出，叫 escaping：\" 输出 "，\\ 输出 \，\$ 输出 $。
原因：echo "My favourite robot is "Marvin""; 内里的 " 会令 interpreter 以为 string 已结束，分不清开始和结束 → syntax error。双引号内的 $ 会被当成变量开头，要显示美元符号就写 \$。输出里只有字元，没有 backslash。

ex.q: $tie = 40; Write a statement that outputs: The tie costs $40 and is "cheap"
ex.a:
echo "The tie costs \${$tie} and is \"cheap\"";
\$ prints a literal dollar sign, then {$tie} inserts 40, and \" prints the quotation marks. (Concatenation also works: echo "The tie costs \$" . $tie . " and is \"cheap\"";)
ex.az: \$ 输出 $，{$tie} 插入 40，\" 输出引号。

cards.t: Variable parsing and single vs double quotes
cards.en:
Variable parsing: put a variable inside a double-quoted string, wrapped in braces { }, and it is replaced by its value. This is easier to read and less error-prone than a long chain of dots.
$name = "Emily";
$day = "Tuesday";
echo "Welcome {$name}, today is {$day}";
// Welcome Emily, today is Tuesday
Simple parsing "Welcome $name" works too; complex parsing "Welcome {$name}" is recommended always, because it is required for associative array elements ({$user["name"]}) and separates the variable from following letters ("{$n}s").
Single quotes also make strings, but the book recommends always using double quotes: single-quoted strings do not support (most) character escaping or variable parsing: echo 'Hi {$n}'; outputs Hi {$n} literally.
cards.zh:
Variable parsing：在双引号 string 中用 { } 包住变量，就会被换成其值，比一长串点号易读又少错。
Simple parsing（"Welcome $name"）亦可；建议一律用 complex parsing（"Welcome {$name}"），因为 associative array 元素必须用 { }（{$user["name"]}），而且能分隔变量和后面的字（"{$n}s"）。
单引号也能建 string，但课本建议一律用双引号：single-quoted strings 不支持（大部分）escaping 和 variable parsing，echo 'Hi {$n}'; 会原样输出 Hi {$n}。

ex.q:
Rewrite using variable parsing, then add quotation marks around the captain's name:
echo "<li>".$team_01." Team: ".$captain_01."</li>";
ex.a:
echo "<li>{$team_01} Team: {$captain_01}</li>";
echo "<li>{$team_01} Team: \"{$captain_01}\"</li>";
With $team_01 = "Aquatics" and $captain_01 = "Bruce", the second gives <li>Aquatics Team: "Bruce"</li>.
ex.az: 用 {} 插入变量；名字加引号要写 \"。

cards.t: Numeric strings and Python vs PHP
cards.tz: Numeric string 与 Python/PHP 对照
cards.en:
Numeric string (Enrichment): a string containing only a number, e.g. "22". When it is used in arithmetic or compared with a number, PHP automatically converts it (type juggling): $s = "22"; $m = $s * 2; gives 44. Python would raise an error. This is why date("Y") - 1993 works even though date() returns a string.

Quick comparison for students who know Python:
PythonPHP
variableage = 18$age = 18;
comment#// # /* */
insert variablef'Hi {food}'"Hi {$food}"
join strings+.
else ifelifelseif
blockindentation{ }
forfor i in range(10)for($i=0;$i<10;$i++)
append / lengthappend / len$a[] = x; / count($a)
dictionary{"k": v}$a["k"] = v;
outputprintecho
cards.zh:
Numeric string（Enrichment）：只含数字的 string，如 "22"。用于运算或与数字比较时，PHP 会自动转成数字（type juggling）：$s = "22"; $m = $s * 2; 得 44，Python 则会报错。所以 date("Y") - 1993 可以直接计算。

Python 与 PHP 对照：变量要 $ 和分号；comment 用 // # /* */；插入变量 "Hi {$food}"；接 string 用 . 不是 +；elif 写 elseif；block 用 { } 不用缩进；for 写成 for($i=0;$i<10;$i++)；append 用 $a[] = x，长度用 count($a)；dictionary 对应 associative array；print 对应 echo。

ex.q:
Convert this Python to PHP:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
print(f"Sum is {total}")
ex.a:
$total = 0;
for ($i = 1; $i < 6; $i++) {
  $total += $i;
}
echo "Sum is {$total}";
Output: Sum is 15. range(1, 6) means 1 to 5, so the condition is $i < 6.
ex.az: range(1,6) 即 1 到 5，故条件 $i < 6，输出 Sum is 15。

cards.en:
A Boolean expression always evaluates to True or False. Relational operators compare two values; with $x = 13; $y = -5;:
OperatorMeaning$x ? $y
==EqualFalse
!= or <>Not equalTrue
<Less thanFalse
>Greater thanTrue
<=Less than or equalFalse
>=Greater than or equalTrue
== and != / <> also work on strings: "Hi mom" == "Hey dad" is False. String comparison is case-sensitive: "abc" == "ABC" is False. Boolean expressions are used as the conditions of if statements and loops.
cards.zh:
Boolean expression 的值只会是 True 或 False。Relational operators（设 $x = 13，$y = -5）：== 相等（False）、!= 或 <> 不等（True）、<（False）、>（True）、<=（False）、>=（True）。
== 和 != / <> 亦可比较 strings："Hi mom" == "Hey dad" 为 False；大小写有分别。Boolean expressions 用作 if 和 loop 的 condition。

ex.q: With $p = 7 and $q = "7", $r = 10, evaluate: (a) $p <> $r (b) $p * 2 >= $r + 4 (c) $p == $q
ex.a:
(a) 7 ≠ 10 → True.
(b) 14 >= 14 → True.
(c) "7" is a numeric string, so == compares 7 with 7 → True.
ex.az: (a) True (b) 14>=14 True (c) numeric string，True。

cards.en:
Logical operators combine Boolean values:
OperationPHP$a = True, $b = False
ANDand or &&$a && $b → False
ORor or ||$a || $b → True
NOT!!$a → False
AND is True only if both are True; OR is True if at least one is True; NOT flips the value.
Enrichment: && and || have higher precedence than and and or (which are even lower than =), so mixing them can give unexpected results. E.g. $r = true and false; stores true in $r, while $r = true && false; stores false. Use && / || and brackets to be safe.
cards.zh:
Logical operators 组合 Boolean：AND 写 and 或 &&（两者都 True 才 True）；OR 写 or 或 ||（至少一个 True 就 True）；NOT 写 !（反转）。
Enrichment：&&、|| 的 precedence 高过 and、or（后两者甚至低过 =），混用会出意外：$r = true and false; 令 $r 为 true，而 $r = true && false; 令 $r 为 false。用 && / || 加括号最安全。

ex.q: A cinema gives a discount if age < 12 or age >= 65, but not on Saturdays. Write the condition using $age and $day.
ex.a:
if (($age < 12 || $age >= 65) && $day != "Saturday") {
  echo "Discount";
}
The brackets around the OR part are needed so the Saturday test applies to both age groups.
ex.az: OR 部分要加括号，再 && 非星期六。

cards.en:
$price = 20;
if ($price > 25) {
  echo "Too expensive!";
} else {
  echo "It is acceptable.";
}
  • The condition must be a Boolean expression or value, in ( ).
  • The True block and False block are wrapped in { }; indentation is only for readability.
Output: It is acceptable.

For more than two cases use elseif (one word; Python uses elif):
if ($role == "Manager") {
  echo "Welcome Manager";
} elseif ($role == "Staff") {
  echo "Welcome Staff";
} else {
  echo "Not Authorised!";
}
Conditions are checked from top to bottom; the first True block runs and the rest are skipped. An elseif is only checked if all earlier conditions were False; else runs only if all are False. So order matters: put the most specific condition first.
cards.zh:
条件放在 ( )，必须是 Boolean expression；True block 和 False block 用 { } 包住，缩进只为可读性。上例输出 It is acceptable.

多于两种情况用 elseif（一个字，Python 是 elif）。由上而下检查，第一个 True 的 block 执行后其余全部跳过；elseif 只在前面全部 False 时才检查；全部 False 才执行 else。所以次序重要：最特定的条件放最前。

ex.q: Write PHP that outputs a grade from $mark: 80 or above A, 65–79 B, 50–64 C, otherwise F.
ex.a:
if ($mark >= 80) {
  echo "A";
} elseif ($mark >= 65) {
  echo "B";
} elseif ($mark >= 50) {
  echo "C";
} else {
  echo "F";
}
Because the first true branch wins, $mark >= 65 is only reached when the mark is below 80, so no upper bound is needed.
ex.az: 由高到低检查，第一个成立就停，所以不用写上限。

cards.en:
if ($role = "Teacher") {   // wrong!
  echo "Welcome Teacher";
}
= is the assignment operator. This line stores "Teacher" into $role, and the value of the whole expression is "Teacher", a non-empty string, which is treated as true. So the block always runs, whatever $role was before, and $role is overwritten. PHP gives no error, which makes the bug hard to find. To compare, use ==: if ($role == "Teacher").
Exam tip: when asked to find the logic error in an if or while condition, check every = first.
cards.zh:
= 是 assignment：这行把 "Teacher" 存入 $role，整个表达式的值是 "Teacher"（非空 string），被当作 true，所以无论原本 $role 是什么，block 永远执行，而且 $role 被改写。PHP 不会报错，所以难以发现。比较要用 ==。
考试找 logic error 时，先检查 condition 中每个 =。

ex.q: $role = "Student"; if ($role = "Admin") { echo "Delete all"; } echo $role; What is output, and why is this dangerous?
ex.a: Output: Delete allAdmin. The assignment sets $role to "Admin" and the condition is true, so a student is treated as an admin. It is dangerous because a normal user gets admin actions, and PHP shows no error.
ex.az: 输出 Delete allAdmin；学生被当成 admin，而且没有错误讯息。

cards.zh: 用 PHP 解决 2.1 的 welcomePage：time() 取当前时间，date('a', time()) 返回 "am" 或 "pm"，两者都是 built-in functions。PHP 段落嵌在 HTML 文字中间，"Good" 和 ", welcome to my website." 是直接复制的 non-PHP code。下午 3 时网页显示 Good afternoon , welcome to my website.（换行被 browser 当成一个空格）。用的是 server 的时钟，因为 PHP 在 server 执行。

ex.q: Modify the page so it says 'Good evening' from 18:00. Hint: date('G') returns the hour 0–23.
ex.a:
<?php
  $h = date('G');
  if ($h < 12) {
    echo "Good morning";
  } elseif ($h < 18) {
    echo "Good afternoon";
  } else {
    echo "Good evening";
  }
?>
Three cases need if-elseif-else; the hour (a numeric string) compares correctly with numbers.
ex.az: 三种情况用 if-elseif-else。

cards.zh:
While loop：只要 loop condition 为 true，就重复执行 loop body。条件在第一次 iteration 前和每次 iteration 后检查；一开始就 False 则一次都不执行。上例输出 17、34、51、68、85 五行（102 不满足）。Body 要 { }；记得更新条件中的变量，否则会 infinite loop。
Loop 可用来生成重复的 HTML，例如平方表的 table rows（10 至 20），日后改范围只需改一个数字。

ex.q: How many rows does the square-table loop above output, and what is the last row?
ex.a: $m takes 10, 11, …, 20 → 11 rows. When $m becomes 21 the condition 21 < 21 is False. Last row: <tr><td>20<sup>2</sup></td><td>400</td></tr>.
ex.az: 10 到 20 共 11 行，最后一行 20 的平方 400。

cards.en:
for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
  echo "<li>{$i}</li>";
}
The header has three parts separated by semicolons:
PartRole
Initialisation $i = 0runs once, before the first iteration
Loop condition $i < 5checked before each iteration; body runs only if True
Afterthought $i++runs after each execution of the body to update the loop variable
Output: list items 0 to 4 (not 5). To include the end value use <=.
Factorial example:
$x = 5;
$ans = 1;
for ($i = 1; $i <= $x; $i++) {
  $ans = $ans * $i;
}
echo "The factorial of {$x} is {$ans}.";   // 120
A running product starts at 1; a running sum starts at 0.
cards.zh:
For loop header 三部分用分号分隔：Initialisation（$i = 0，第一次 iteration 前执行一次）、Loop condition（$i < 5，每次 iteration 前检查）、Afterthought（$i++，每次 body 执行后更新 loop variable）。上例输出 0 至 4（不含 5）；要包括终点用 <=。
Factorial 例子输出 The factorial of 5 is 120.。累乘变量初值为 1，累加初值为 0。

$c % 3 == 0 表示 $c 是 3 的倍数；$num2 % $num1 == 0 表示 $num2 可被 $num1 整除；$n % 2 == 0 表示偶数。
FizzBuzz 关键：同时是 3 和 5 倍数的条件要放最前。若先检查 $i % 3 == 0，15 会先符合，只输出 Fizz，其余 branch 被跳过。

ex.q: What does the loop output for $i = 9, 10, 15 and 16?
ex.a: 9 → Fizz (multiple of 3 only). 10 → Buzz. 15 → Fizz Buzz (first condition). 16 → 16 (else branch).
ex.az: 9 Fizz、10 Buzz、15 Fizz Buzz、16 输出 16。

cards.t: Swapping and linear search with a flag
cards.tz: Swap 与用 flag 做 linear search
cards.zh:
Swap：用 temp 变量交换两数（直接写 $num1 = $num2; $num2 = $num1; 会丢失第一个值）。执行后 $num1 ≤ $num2。
Linear search with a flag：逐个比较，找到就把 $found 设为 true，loop 随即停止。条件 $i < count($users) 令找不到时在 array 尾停下，不会读不存在的 index。最后按 $found 输出欢迎或 The username does not exist.。

ex.q: $users = ["Ben","Jason","Macy"]; $username = "Jason"; Trace the search loop: what is $i at the end?
ex.a:
i = 0: "Ben" ≠ "Jason", i becomes 1.
i = 1: match, $found = true, i becomes 2.
Condition: $found is true → loop stops. Final $i = 2, $found = true, output Welcome Jason!
ex.az: 比较两次后找到，$i 最后为 2。

cards.t: Beyond the book: switch, do-while, break, continue
cards.zh:
以下不在课本，但学校可能会教。
switch：比较同一个值时代替长串 if-elseif。漏了 break 会 fall through 到下一个 case；比较用 ==。
do-while 在 body 之后才检查条件，所以至少执行一次（上例输出 10）。
break：立即跳出 loop；continue：跳过本次余下部分，进入下一次 iteration。

ex.a: i = 1 → 1; i = 2 → 2; i = 3 → skipped by continue; i = 4 → 4; i = 5 → break. Output: 124.
ex.az: 3 被 continue 跳过，5 时 break，输出 124。

cards.en:
An array stores many values in one variable (like a Python list); elements can be of different data types.
$students = [];                              // empty array
$friends = ["Summie", "Cherrie", "Angelina"]; // comma-separated values
Each value is an element; its index gives its position, starting from 0 in insertion order. (The older form array("a", "b") is the same.)
Use the square bracket operator:
echo $friends[1];        // Cherrie
$friends[2] = "Kathy";   // edit the element at index 2
$friends[] = "Ryan";     // empty [] appends to the end
Now $friends has 4 elements and the last index is 3, not 4. Assigning to an existing index replaces, it does not add.
cards.zh:
Array 把多个值存在一个变量里（类似 Python list），元素可以是不同 data types。建立：$students = [];（空 array）或 ["Summie", "Cherrie", "Angelina"]（逗号分隔）。每个值叫 element，index 表示位置，由 0 开始（旧写法 array("a","b") 一样）。
用 square bracket operator：$friends[1] 读取 Cherrie；$friends[2] = "Kathy" 修改；$friends[] = "Ryan"（空方括号）加到最后。之后共 4 个元素，最后 index 是 3 不是 4。给已有 index 赋值是取代而非加入。

ex.q: $a = [5, 8, 2]; $a[] = 7; $a[1] = 0; What are the elements of $a and the value of $a[3]?

cards.t: count() and looping through an array with for
cards.tz: count() 与用 for 走遍 array
cards.en:
count($arr) returns the number of elements. The last index = count($arr) − 1. To visit every element by index:
for ($i = 0; $i < count($a); $i++) {
  echo $a[$i];
}
// or
$n = count($a) - 1;
for ($i = 0; $i <= $n; $i++) { ... }
Using count() instead of a fixed number means the loop still works after elements are added.
Indexed array elements can be put in strings with parsing: "{$team[$i]}".
Parallel arrays (Example 2.4): several arrays use the same index for the same entity:
$team = ["Bridge", "Dance", "Debate"];
$captain = ["Tom", "Neo", "Oscar"];
$num_parti = [8, 22, 13];
for ($i = 0; $i < count($team); $i++) {
  $code = $i + 1;
  echo "<tr><td>T{$code}</td><td>{$team[$i]}</td>";
  echo "<td>{$captain[$i]}</td><td>{$num_parti[$i]}</td></tr>";
}
This outputs one table row per team: T1 Bridge Tom 8, T2 Dance Neo 22, T3 Debate Oscar 13.
cards.zh:
count($arr) 返回元素数目，最后 index = count($arr) − 1。用 for 由 0 走到 count − 1（条件用 < count 或 <= count − 1）。用 count() 而不用固定数字，加了元素 loop 仍然正确。Indexed 元素放进 string 写 {$team[$i]}。
Parallel arrays（Example 2.4）：几个 array 用同一 index 代表同一队，loop 一次输出一行 table row：T1 Bridge Tom 8、T2 Dance Neo 22、T3 Debate Oscar 13。

ex.q: A student wrote for ($i = 0; $i <= count($a); $i++) { echo $a[$i]; } What goes wrong?
ex.a: The condition uses <= so the loop also runs with $i = count($a), an index that does not exist (last index is count − 1). PHP gives an undefined array key warning. Use $i < count($a).
ex.az: <= 会多走一次，读取不存在的 index；应用 <。

cards.en:
foreach goes through an array element by element, in increasing index order, without needing an index:
$class = ["7B", "8C", "10M"];
foreach ($class as $m) {
  echo "{$m}<br>";
}
In each iteration the loop variable $m holds the value of the current element, then moves to the next. Syntax: foreach (array as $loopVariable): the array comes first, and the keyword is foreach, not for.
Supplement: to get both index and value, write foreach ($arr as $key => $value), very useful for associative arrays. Changing $value inside the loop does not change the original array (unless you write &$value).
Use for when you need the index (e.g. parallel arrays); use foreach when you only need each value.
cards.zh:
foreach 按 index 递增次序逐个取出元素，不必理会 index。每次 iteration，loop variable $m 存当前元素的值。语法 foreach (array as $loopVariable)：array 在前，关键字是 foreach 不是 for。
补充：foreach ($arr as $key => $value) 同时取 index 和值，对 associative array 尤其有用。在 loop 内改 $value 不会改原 array（除非用 &$value）。
需要 index（如 parallel arrays）用 for；只要值用 foreach。

ex.q: Use foreach to find the total of $marks = [72, 85, 60, 91]; and output 'Total: 308'.
ex.a:
$total = 0;
foreach ($marks as $mk) {
  $total += $mk;
}
echo "Total: {$total}";
72 + 85 + 60 + 91 = 308.
ex.az: 累加初值 0，foreach 逐个加，得 308。

cards.t: Filtering an array by recording indexes
cards.tz: 记下符合条件的 index 来 filter
cards.zh: 要从 parallel arrays 只显示符合条件的项目：先把符合条件的 index 收集到 $filtered，再用 foreach 走这些 index 输出。str_contains($haystack, $needle)：string 是否含某 substring（PHP 8+，分大小写）。存 index 而不是值，才能同时在每个 parallel array 找到对应资料（名称和价钱）。

ex.q: $items = ["iPad tablet", "pen", "Galaxy tablet"]; What does $filtered contain after the first loop?
ex.a: Index 0 contains "tablet" → added; index 1 does not; index 2 does → added. $filtered = [0, 2].
ex.az: index 0 和 2 含 tablet，$filtered = [0, 2]。

cards.zh:
描述一个 entity 的 attributes（如 user 的 name、password、gender）就是 index-value mapping。Associative array 储存 index-value pairs，index 是 developer 自定的 string（不是连续数字），value 可以是任何 data type，类似 Python dictionary。
$teacher["name"] = "Gloria"; 会建立 array 及第一对；再用新 index 赋值就是加入；用已有 index 再赋值就是修改。Index 是 string，别忘双引号。（补充：亦可用 ["name" => "Gloria"] 一次建立。）

ex.q: After the code above, list every index-value pair in $teacher.
ex.a: name → Gloria, subject → Biology (Chemistry was replaced), age → 24. Three elements in total.
ex.az: name→Gloria、subject→Biology、age→24，共三个。

cards.t: Associative array elements in strings; Example 2.5
cards.tz: Associative array 元素放入 string；Example 2.5
cards.zh:
把 array 元素放进双引号 string 要用 { }。Associative array 的 index 本身有引号，所以必须用 complex parsing { }。
Example 2.5：date("Y") 返回当前 4 位年份（string），因是 numeric string 可直接相减。2026 年输出 Martin Lam is 33 years old.。

ex.q: $p["item"] = "pen"; $p["qty"] = 3; Write one echo using parsing to output: 3 x pen
ex.a:
echo "{$p["qty"]} x {$p["item"]}";
Both elements need braces because their indexes are quoted strings.
ex.az: 两个元素都要 { }。

cards.t: Outputting a table row with a fields array
cards.tz: 用 fields array + foreach 输出 table row
cards.en:
$student_01["name"] = "Winnie";
$student_01["grade"] = "G8";
$student_01["subject"] = "ICT";
$fields = ["grade", "name", "subject"];
echo "<tr>";
foreach ($fields as $f) {
  echo "<td>{$student_01[$f]}</td>";
}
echo "</tr>";
Resulting HTML: <tr><td>G8</td><td>Winnie</td><td>ICT</td></tr>.
Points: the index of an associative array can be a variable ($f); the $fields array decides the column order, so reordering columns only means reordering $fields. The same $fields can be reused for many students, and also to print the header row (<th>). Note that inside the string the element is written {$student_01[$f]}: no quotes around $f because it is a variable, not a literal string index.
cards.zh: Associative array 的 index 可以是变量（$f）。$fields 决定栏目次序，要调动栏目只需改 $fields。同一个 $fields 可用于多个学生，亦可用来输出表头 <th>。上例 resulting HTML：<tr><td>G8</td><td>Winnie</td><td>ICT</td></tr>。

ex.q: Write code to output the header row <tr><th>grade</th><th>name</th><th>subject</th></tr> using $fields.
ex.a:
echo "<tr>";
foreach ($fields as $f) {
  echo "<th>{$f}</th>";
}
echo "</tr>";
ex.az: foreach $fields，每个输出 <th>。

cards.tz: Array 与 Associative array 比较
cards.en:
ArrayAssociative array
Indexconsecutive integers from 0developer-defined strings
Create$a = ["x", "y"];$t["name"] = "G";
Add$a[] = v;$t["newIndex"] = v;
In a string"{$a[0]}" (braces recommended)"{$t["name"]}" (braces required)
Pythonlistdictionary
Typical usemany values of the same kind (a list of names)the attributes of one entity (one user)
Exam-style answer: "Elements of an array are accessed by consecutive integer indexes starting from 0, while elements of an associative array are index-value pairs whose index is a developer-defined string." A whole class can be modelled as an array of students together with parallel arrays, or one associative array per student.
cards.zh:
Array：index 是由 0 开始的连续整数；用 $a[] = v 加入；对应 Python list；用于同类的多个值（名单）。Associative array：index 是自定 string；用 $t["newIndex"] = v 加入；放入 string 必须 { }；对应 dictionary；用于一个 entity 的 attributes（一个 user）。
标准答法：Elements of an array are accessed by consecutive integer indexes starting from 0, while elements of an associative array are index-value pairs whose index is a developer-defined string.

ex.q: Which structure suits each: (a) the names of all 30 students in 5A; (b) one book's title, author, ISBN and price?
ex.a:
(a) An array: many values of the same kind, order by index.
(b) An associative array: attributes of one entity, accessed by meaningful indexes such as $book["isbn"].
ex.az: (a) array；(b) associative array。

cards.en:
Built-in functions used in this chapter: count($a) (number of elements), floor($x) (round down), time(), date('a', time()) ("am"/"pm"), date("Y") (year), str_contains($s, $sub). Useful extras: strlen($s), strtoupper($s), round($x, 2), rand(1, 6), in_array($x, $a), array_sum($a), sort($a), isset($x).
Supplement: user-defined functions
function area($w, $h = 1) {   // $h has a default value
  return $w * $h;
}
echo area(3, 4);   // 12
echo area(5);      // 5
Variable scope: a function cannot see variables outside it (unlike Python, which can read globals). Pass values in as parameters or write global $x; inside. Local variables disappear when the function ends.
cards.zh:
本章用到的 built-in functions：count、floor、time、date('a', time())、date("Y")、str_contains。常用补充：strlen、strtoupper、round、rand(1, 6)、in_array、array_sum、sort、isset。
补充：自定 function：用 function 关键字，可有 default value，用 return 回传。Variable scope：function 看不到外面的变量（与 Python 可读 global 不同），要用 parameter 传入或在 function 内写 global $x;。Local 变量在 function 结束后消失。

ex.q: $rate = 0.1; function tax($p) { return $p * $rate; } echo tax(100); Why doesn't this output 10, and how do you fix it?
ex.a: Inside the function $rate is undefined (outside variables are not visible), so it is treated as null and the result is 0 (with a warning). Fix: pass it in, function tax($p, $rate) { return $p * $rate; } and call tax(100, $rate), or add global $rate; inside the function.
ex.az: function 内看不到 $rate，结果 0；用参数传入或 global。

cards.en:
Habits the book stresses for readable, maintainable PHP:
  • Use meaningful variable names and initialise every variable before use (e.g. $total = 0 before summing).
  • Add comments to explain purpose; PHP comments are not sent to the client.
  • Indent blocks even though PHP does not require it, for readability.
  • Prefer variable parsing to long concatenation chains: fewer missing dots and spaces.
  • Generate repeated HTML (table rows, list items) with arrays and loops instead of hard-coding it, so data changes need no HTML edits.
  • Use count() rather than fixed lengths in loops.
  • Compare with ==, not =.
  • Always use double quotes for strings.
In exam "suggest an improvement" questions, name the practice and say why it helps (readability, maintenance, fewer errors).
cards.zh:
课本强调的习惯：
  • 用有意义的变量名，使用前先 initialise（如累加前 $total = 0）；
  • 加 comments 说明用途（PHP comments 不会送到 client）；
  • 虽然 PHP 不要求，仍要 indent，提高 readability；
  • 多用 variable parsing，少用长串 concatenation，减少漏点号漏空格；
  • 用 arrays + loops 生成重复 HTML，而非硬写；
  • loop 中用 count() 而非固定长度；
  • 比较用 == 不是 =；
  • string 一律用双引号。
考试问 improvement 时，说出做法和原因（易读、易维护、少错）。

ex.q: Suggest two improvements to: $x="Ken";echo "<p>".$x." scored ".$y."</p>";
ex.a:
Suggested answer:
1. Use a meaningful name, e.g. $name instead of $x, so the purpose is clear.
2. Use variable parsing: echo "<p>{$name} scored {$score}</p>";, which is easier to read and avoids missing dots/spaces.
(Also: $y is used without being initialised.)
ex.az: 改用有意义变量名；用 variable parsing 代替 concatenation；$y 未初始化。

mc.q: In a web application, which is the client?
mc.e: The client is the application software (browser) used to access web pages; the person is the user.

mc.q: When a user types https://mysite.net/a.html into the address bar, which request method is used?
mc.e: Typing a URL or clicking a link sends a GET request.
mc.ez: 输入 URL 或按 link 用 GET。

mc.q: A browser receives status code 404. What does it mean?
o: No permission to access the file
The requested file does not exist on the server

mc.q: During a flash sale too many users request the shop page at once. Which status code are they most likely to receive?
mc.e: 503 indicates server overload.

mc.q: Which item is NOT part of an HTTP response?
mc.e: The request method belongs to the HTTP request.

mc.q: What is the content type of a normal web page in an HTTP response?
mc.e: Web pages are sent as text/html.

mc.q: Which of the following is a dynamic web page?

A page showing search results for the user's keywords
A page with an image of the school logo
mc.e: Its content depends on user input via programming logic.
mc.ez: 按 user 输入改变内容就是 dynamic。

mc.q: Put the steps in order: (1) server looks up the file (2) browser renders HTML (3) browser sends an HTTP request (4) server returns an HTTP response
mc.e: Request → look up → response → render.

mc.q: Which statement about a static web page is correct?
o: Its content changes with the time it is requested
It must be written in PHP
Its content is the same no matter who requests it or when
mc.e: Static pages (HTML+CSS) show the same content to everyone.
mc.ez: Static 页面内容对所有人一样。

mc.q: What does PHP stand for?
mc.e: PHP = Hypertext Preprocessor.

mc.q: Where is PHP code executed?
o: On the web server by the PHP interpreter
mc.e: PHP is server side scripting.
mc.ez: PHP 在 server 上执行。

mc.q: Which statement about the PHP interpreter is correct?
o: It sends the .php source to the client
It copies non-PHP code directly and executes PHP code to produce an HTML file
mc.e: Input PHP file, output HTML file.
mc.ez: Non-PHP 直接复制，PHP 执行，输出 HTML。

mc.q: A user views the page source of profile.php in the browser. What will they see?
o: Nothing, PHP pages have no source
mc.e: Only the resulting HTML is sent to the client.

mc.q: Which file extension must a file containing PHP code have?
mc.e: PHP code is written in .php files.

mc.q: What is the resulting HTML of: <h1><?php echo "Hi!"; ?></h1>
mc.e: echo outputs the content without the quotation marks; the h1 tags are copied.
mc.ez: echo 输出不含引号，h1 照样复制。

mc.e: echo adds no space or line break.
mc.ez: echo 不加空格也不换行。

mc.q: Which statement has a syntax error?
mc.e: Every statement must end with a semicolon.

mc.q: Which statement about PHP syntax is correct?
o: PHP code must be indented like Python
A .php file can contain only one <?php ?> block
PHP code can be placed anywhere in the file and there can be several blocks
Non-PHP code is executed by the interpreter
mc.e: PHP blocks can appear anywhere, many times.
mc.ez: PHP 段落可放任何位置、可有多段。

mc.q: A student saves test.php in C:/xampp/htdocs/lab and double-clicks it. The PHP code does not run. What should he do?
mc.e: PHP must be requested through the web server.

mc.q: Which is a valid PHP variable name?
mc.e: Starts with $, then _ or a letter.
mc.ez: $ 后第一字元须为 _ 或字母。

mc.q: Which is NOT a valid PHP variable name?
mc.e: @ is not allowed.

mc.q: What is the data type of $v after $v = "False";?
mc.e: Quotes make it a string.

mc.q: What is the output of: $a = 9; $b = 4; echo $a % $b + $a / $b;
What is the output of: echo 2 ** 3 * 2;
mc.e: ** first: 8, then × 2 = 16.

mc.q: What is the output of: echo floor(17 / 5);
mc.e: 17/5 = 3.4, floor gives 3.
x becomes 6, z = 3, then x = 24.

mc.q: What is the value of $n after: $n = 10; $n -= 3; $n++; $n *= 2;
Given $n = "Amy";, which outputs Hi Amy?
mc.e: The dot joins strings; + does not.

mc.q: Which outputs exactly: Cost: $56.8
mc.e: Escape $ as \$ inside double quotes.

mc.q: What is output by: echo "Choose A\\B";
mc.e: \\ outputs one backslash.

mc.q: Why does echo "He said "Hi""; cause an error?
o: The inner quotation marks end the string early, so the string boundaries are unclear
mc.e: Inner " must be escaped as \".

mc.q: Given $name = "Emily";, which outputs Welcome Emily?
mc.e: Variable parsing needs double quotes and the $ inside braces.

mc.q: What does $n = "Ken"; echo 'Hi {$n}'; output?
mc.e: Single-quoted strings do not support variable parsing.

mc.q: Which comment will appear in the resulting HTML file?
mc.e: HTML comments are non-PHP code and are copied; PHP comments are ignored.
mc.ez: HTML comment 会被复制到输出。

mc.q: What is output by: $s = "22"; echo $s * 2;
mc.e: A numeric string is converted to a number in arithmetic.
mc.ez: Numeric string 自动转数字，得 44。

mc.e: The dot joins as strings: "5" . "3" = 53.

mc.q: Given $x = 13 and $y = -5, which expression is True?
mc.e: <> means not equal; 13 ≠ −5.

mc.q: Given $a = True; $b = False; which is True?
mc.e: $a && $b is False, its negation is True.

o: A semicolon is needed after the condition
= assigns instead of compares, so the condition is always true
Strings cannot be compared in PHP
mc.e: Use ==; PHP gives no error.
The first true branch (≥50) runs and the rest are skipped.
mc.ez: 第一个成立的 branch 执行后跳过其余。

mc.q: What does date('a', time()) return at 3:00 pm?
mc.e: 'a' gives lowercase am/pm.
The condition is false before the first iteration.
mc.ez: 一开始已是 False，0 次。

mc.q: In for($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++), when is $i++ executed?

mc.e: The afterthought runs after each body execution.
mc.ez: Afterthought 在每次 body 之后执行。

mc.q: In FizzBuzz, why must ($i % 3 == 0 and $i % 5 == 0) be tested first?

and must be at the top of a loop

mc.e: Only the first true branch runs.
mc.ez: 只有第一个成立的 branch 会执行。

mc.q: Which condition is true exactly when $n is a multiple of 7?
mc.e: Remainder 0 means divisible.
The values are swapped using $t.
do-while runs the body at least once.

mc.ez: 无 break 会 fall through，输出 BC。

mc.q: After $f = ["Summie","Cherrie","Angelina"]; $f[2] = "Kathy"; $f[] = "Ryan"; what are count($f) and $f[3]?
mc.e: Editing index 2 adds nothing; [] appends at index 3.
mc.ez: 改 index 2 不加元素；[] 加在 index 3。

mc.q: What is the index of the first element of a PHP array?
o: It depends on the first value
mc.e: Indexes start from 0.

mc.q: For an array $a with 6 elements, what is the index of the last element?
mc.e: Last index = count − 1.

mc.q: Which loop correctly outputs every element of $class?
mc.e: Syntax: foreach(array as loopVariable).

mc.q: Given $t["name"] = "Gloria"; $t["age"] = 24; which outputs: Gloria is 24
mc.e: Associative elements in strings need braces in a double-quoted string.
mc.ez: Associative 元素要 { } 加双引号 string。

mc.q: Which statement about an associative array is correct?

mc.e: It stores index-value pairs with string indexes.

mc.q: After $u["name"] = "Ken"; $u["age"] = 16; $u["name"] = "Ben"; what is count($u)?
mc.e: Assigning to an existing index edits it.
mc.ez: 同 index 再赋值是修改，仍 2 个。

mc.q: Which PHP structure is most similar to a Python dictionary?
mc.e: Index ≈ key.

mc.ez: $fields 决定次序：先 grade 后 name。

mc.q: What does str_contains("Galaxy Tab tablet", "tablet") return?
mc.e: The string contains the substring.
Outside variables are not visible inside a function without global.

mc.q: Which line uses parallel arrays correctly to print the captain of the team at index $i?

mc.q: Which is good programming practice in PHP?
o: Never indent since PHP ignores whitespace

mc.e: Parsing is easier to read and less error-prone.
