cards.en:
A client-side script is a script that runs in the client's browser. The developer places the script inside the HTML file. When the client requests the file, the server returns the HTML file containing the client-side script, and the browser executes it.

The dominant client-side scripting language is JavaScript. Note that Java and JavaScript are two different languages; only the names are similar.

Compare with server-side scripting (PHP, Chapter 4): a PHP script is executed on the server and only its output (HTML) is sent to the client, so the client never sees the PHP code. JavaScript code, in contrast, is sent to the client as it is and can be viewed in the browser. A typical web application uses both: PHP to process data and access the database on the server, and JavaScript to make the page interactive in the browser.
cards.zh:
Client-side script（客户端脚本）是在客户端浏览器 (client's browser) 中运行的脚本。开发者把脚本写进 HTML 文件；客户端请求该文件时，server 返回含有 client-side script 的 HTML 文件，再由浏览器执行。

最主流的客户端脚本语言是 JavaScript。注意 Java 和 JavaScript 是两种不同的语言，只是名字相似。

与第 4 章的 server-side scripting (PHP) 对比：PHP 在 server 执行，只把输出的 HTML 发给客户端，客户端看不到 PHP 代码；JavaScript 则原样发送到客户端，用户可在浏览器中查看。一般 web application 两者并用：PHP 在 server 处理数据、访问数据库；JavaScript 在浏览器令网页可交互。

ex.q: A user opens page.html that contains a <script> block. Describe where the script is stored, how it reaches the user and where it is executed.
ex.a:
1. The script is stored on the web server inside page.html.
2. The browser sends an HTTP request for page.html.
3. The server returns the HTML file including the client-side script (unchanged).
4. The browser on the client computer executes the JavaScript.
ex.az: 脚本存在 server 的 HTML 文件里；浏览器请求后，server 把含脚本的 HTML 原样返回；由客户端浏览器执行。

cards.t: When client-side vs server-side scripts run
cards.tz: 执行时机：客户端 vs 服务器端
cards.en:
Server-side (PHP)Client-side (JavaScript)
Whereon the serverin the client's browser
When executedwhen the server receives a requestwhen the page is first loaded, or when an event occurs (e.g. the user clicks a button or submits a form)
Code visible to user?No, only the outputYes
Key point: a client-side script is not necessarily executed when the page loads. Code inside a function only runs when the function is invoked, for example by a click. After running, a client-side script can change the content of the web page already displayed, without asking the server for a new page.
cards.zh:
Server-side (PHP)Client-side (JavaScript)
在哪运行serverclient's browser
何时执行server 收到 request 时页面初次加载时，或事件发生时（如用户 click button、submit form）
用户能否看到代码不能，只见输出能
重点：client-side script 不一定在页面加载时执行；放在 function 里的代码要等 function 被调用（例如点击按钮）才运行。执行后可以直接改变已显示网页的内容，不必向 server 要新页面。

ex.q: A page shows a quiz. When the user clicks Check, the score appears immediately without reloading. Another page saves the score to a database. Which part uses client-side and which uses server-side scripting? Explain.
ex.a:
Showing the score on click: client-side (JavaScript), executed in the browser when the click event occurs and changes the page without reload.
Saving to the database: server-side (PHP), executed on the server when it receives the request, because the database is on the server.
ex.az: 点击即显示分数＝客户端 JS（事件触发、无需重载）；写入数据库＝服务器端 PHP（数据库在 server）。

cards.en:
Two benefits to memorise:
  • Dynamic content: the web page can respond to user input and update its content without a full page reload. The user does not wait for a round trip to the server, so the page feels faster.
  • Rich user interfaces: JavaScript can manipulate the DOM (Document Object Model), so developers can build complex and interactive interfaces (menus, counters, live validation, games).
Extra points that follow from these: less load on the server (some processing such as simple validation happens in the browser) and less network traffic. But remember client-side validation does not replace server-side validation, because the user can view and change client code.
cards.zh:
两个要背的好处：
  • Dynamic content：网页可响应用户输入，无需整页重新加载 (without a full page reload) 就更新内容，用户不用等待 server 往返，感觉更快。
  • Rich user interfaces：JavaScript 能操作 DOM (Document Object Model)，可做复杂、交互式界面（菜单、计数器、即时验证、游戏）。
延伸：部分处理（如简单验证）在浏览器完成，减轻 server 负担和网络流量。但 client-side validation 不能取代 server-side validation，因为用户能看到并修改客户端代码。

ex.q: A school form checks that the phone number has 8 digits. Give one benefit of doing this check with JavaScript, and one reason the server should check again.
ex.a:
Benefit: the error is shown immediately without a full page reload, and invalid data is not sent to the server (less server load).
Server should check again: client-side code can be viewed, disabled or modified by the user, so invalid data could still reach the server.
ex.az: 好处：即时提示、无需重载、减轻 server 负担；但用户可改/关掉 JS，所以 server 也要验证。

cards.zh:
JavaScript 代码必须写在 <script> 与 </script> 之间，script 元素可放在 HTML 的任何位置（<head> 或 <body>）。

浏览器渲染 HTML 时按顺序 (sequentially) 执行 JS，所以位置有影响：立即执行的代码不能使用还未生成的元素。

现代网页通常把 JS 放在 <head>，目的是把 layout (HTML body) 与 functionality (JavaScript) 分开。交互部分写成 function，只在条件满足或事件发生时才执行，所以位置不再造成问题。

ex.a:
The script is executed sequentially while the page loads. When it runs, the <p id="t"> in the body has not been created yet, so getElementById returns null and an error occurs.
Fix: put the statement inside a function, e.g. function show(){...}, and call it from an event such as <button onclick="show()">; or move the script after the <p>.
ex.az: 脚本按顺序执行，运行时 <p> 还没生成，得到 null 报错。解决：放进 function 由事件调用，或把 script 移到 <p> 之后。

cards.en:
Each JavaScript statement ends with a semicolon (;). Some environments still run code without semicolons, but you are strongly advised to always write them.

Comments are ignored by the browser:
  • Single-line comment: // to the end of the line.
  • Multi-line comment: /* ... */, everything between is ignored.
JavaScript has no indentation requirement (unlike Python). Blocks are marked by curly brackets { }; indentation is only for readability, but good indentation makes code much easier to check in an exam.
cards.zh:
JavaScript 每条语句以分号 (;) 结束。部分环境省略分号也能运行，但强烈建议一定要写。

注释会被浏览器忽略：
  • 单行注释：// 到行末
  • 多行注释：/* ... */
JavaScript 没有缩进要求 (no indentation requirement)（与 Python 不同），代码块用花括号 { } 标示；缩进只为可读性，但考试时清楚的缩进更易检查。

ex.a: Line 1 runs (comment after // ignored). Lines 2–3 are inside /* */ so ignored. Line 4: a = 11. Output: 11.

cards.zh:
JavaScript 变量必须先用关键字 let 声明才能使用，并应同时赋初值（initialisation）。声明后再赋值不用再写 let；同一 scope 用 let 重复声明同名变量会出错。

Enrichment：var、let、const
  • var：旧写法，因 variable scoping 会出现混乱行为。
  • let：ES6 引入，行为可预测，MDN 推荐。
  • const：常量，声明后不能重新赋值 (cannot be reassigned)。
与 PHP 不同，JS 变量名不需要 $。

ex.a:
Line 3: total is declared again with let; should be total = rate * 3;.
Line 4: rate is a const, so it cannot be reassigned (TypeError).
ex.az: 第3行重复 let 声明；第4行 const 不能重新赋值。

cards.en:
A common mistake is to write AvgB = 0; without let. The code may still run, so the student thinks it is fine. But a variable assigned without var/let becomes a global variable, no matter which scope it is declared in. When you start writing functions, a variable inside one function can accidentally overwrite a variable with the same name elsewhere, causing bugs that are hard to find.

Rule for exams and practice: ALWAYS declare every variable with let (including loop counters: for (let i = 0; ...)). In strict mode, using an undeclared variable even throws a ReferenceError.
cards.zh:
常见错误是不写 let，例如 AvgB = 0;。代码可能照样运行，学生以为没问题。但没有用 var/let 声明的变量，无论在哪个 scope 赋值，都会成为 global variable。写 function 后，一个函数里的变量可能意外覆盖别处同名变量，造成难找的 bug。

规则：ALWAYS declare every variable with let（包括循环变量 for (let i = 0; ...)）。在 strict mode 下，使用未声明变量会直接报 ReferenceError。

ex.a: count is assigned without let inside f(), so it becomes a global variable. After f() runs, it is visible outside: output 5. If it had been let count = 5;, console.log(count) would throw ReferenceError because count would be local to f().
ex.az: 没写 let → count 变全局，输出 5；若写 let 则为局部，外面访问会报错。

cards.en:
A JavaScript variable name (identifier):
  • must start with a letter, an underscore (_) or a dollar sign ($);
  • may only contain letters, digits, _ and $;
  • cannot be a reserved word (e.g. let, var, const, if, for, function);
  • is case-sensitive: score and Score are different variables.
Valid: name, _count, id2, $year. Invalid: 1price (starts with a digit), address@HK (contains @), my name (space), let (reserved).
Because $ is allowed, you can keep PHP-style names like $year when converting PHP code to JavaScript.
cards.zh:
JavaScript 变量名：
  • 必须以字母、下划线 _ 或美元符 $ 开头；
  • 只能含字母、数字、_、$；
  • 不能是 reserved word（let、var、const、if、for、function 等）；
  • case-sensitive（区分大小写），score 与 Score 是不同变量。
合法：name、_count、id2、$year。非法：1price（数字开头）、address@HK（含 @）、my name（空格）、let（保留字）。
因为允许 $，把 PHP 代码改成 JS 时可保留 $year 这类名字。

ex.q: Which are valid? _total, 2ndPlace, $price, first-name, Class5A
ex.a:
Valid: _total, $price, Class5A.
Invalid: 2ndPlace (starts with digit), first-name (hyphen not allowed; it would be read as first minus name).
ex.az: 合法：_total、$price、Class5A；非法：2ndPlace（数字开头）、first-name（含 -）。

cards.en:
TypeExamplesKey points
Number0.0, 1.0, 2.5, -300.1JavaScript has no separate Integer type; all numbers are floating-point (so 7/2 = 3.5)
Booleantrue, falsemust be lower case; no quotes, otherwise it becomes a String ("true")
String"Hello World"a sequence of characters (letters, digits, symbols) in quotes
A variable can hold different types of data at different times (JavaScript is dynamically typed). typeof x shows the type.
Enrichment: BigInt represents whole numbers too large for Number; it cannot be used with methods of the Math object. Normally use Number.
cards.zh:
类型例子要点
Number0.0、2.5、-300.1JS 没有独立的 Integer 类型，所有数字都是 floating-point（所以 7/2 = 3.5）
Booleantrue、false必须小写，不加引号，否则变成 String "true"
String"Hello World"用引号括住的一串字符
同一变量可在不同时候存不同类型（动态类型），可用 typeof x 查看。
Enrichment：BigInt 表示 Number 装不下的大整数，不能用 Math 对象的方法；一般用 Number 即可。

ex.q: State the type and value of each: let a = 7 / 2; let b = "false"; let c = 10 > 3;
ex.a:
a: Number, 3.5 (no integer division).
b: String "false" (quotes make it a string).
c: Boolean, true.
ex.az: a 为 Number 3.5；b 为 String（有引号）；c 为 Boolean true。

cards.en:
A single equal sign = assigns a value to a variable (not comparison).
With x = 20.0, y = 5.0:
OperatorMeaningExampleResult
+Additionx + y25
-Subtractionx - y15
*Multiplicationx * y100
/Divisionx / y4
%Modulo (remainder)x % 62
**Exponentiationy ** 3125
Precedence: brackets first, then **, then * / %, then + -. Use % to test divisibility, e.g. n % 2 == 0 means n is even.
cards.zh:
单个等号 = 是赋值，不是比较。
设 x = 20.0, y = 5.0：+ 得 25，- 得 15，* 得 100，/ 得 4，% (Modulo，余数) x % 6 得 2，** (Exponentiation，乘方) y ** 3 得 125。

优先次序：括号 → ** → * / % → + -。
% 常用来判断整除，例如 n % 2 == 0 表示 n 是偶数；n % 10 取个位数。

ex.q: Evaluate let r = 2 + 3 ** 2 % 4 * 2;
ex.a: 3 ** 2 = 9 first. Then 9 % 4 = 1, 1 * 2 = 2 (left to right). Finally 2 + 2 = 4.

cards.en:
JavaScript has no floor-division operator (Python has //). A floor division returns the quotient rounded down to the nearest integer. In JavaScript use Math.floor(), which returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.
let c = Math.floor(9 / 4);   // 2
let d = Math.floor(-2.5);    // -3, not -2!
Be careful with negative numbers: rounding down goes towards negative infinity.
Typical use: converting minutes to hours and minutes: Math.floor(m / 60) hours and m % 60 minutes. Related (for random numbers): Math.random() gives a number in [0, 1).
cards.zh:
JavaScript 没有整除运算符（Python 有 //）。Floor division 返回向下取整的商。JS 用 Math.floor()：返回小于或等于该数的最大整数。
注意负数：Math.floor(-2.5) = -3（向负无穷方向取整），不是 -2。

常见用法：分钟换算成小时和分钟：Math.floor(m / 60) 小时、m % 60 分钟。相关：Math.random() 产生 [0, 1) 的随机数。

ex.q: Convert 135 minutes into hours and minutes with JavaScript.
ex.a:
let m = 135;
let h = Math.floor(m / 60);  // 2
let r = m % 60;              // 15
console.log(`${h} h ${r} min`); // 2 h 15 min

cards.tz: 复合赋值与自增运算符
cards.en:
OperatorExampleEquivalenta=9, b=4
+=a += b;a = a + b;13
-=a -= b;a = a - b;5
OperatorExampleEquivalentm=9
++m++;m = m + 1;10
--m--;m = m - 1;8
The increment operator is commonly used in a for loop (i++). Note += on a String concatenates: s += "!" appends an exclamation mark.
cards.zh:
a += b 等于 a = a + b；a -= b 等于 a = a - b（a=9, b=4 时分别得 13、5）。
m++ 等于 m = m + 1；m-- 等于 m = m - 1（m=9 时得 10、8）。

自增常用于 for loop（i++）。注意对 String 用 += 是连接：s += "!" 会在末尾加感叹号。

cards.t: console.log() and the browser's developer mode
cards.en:
console.log() outputs a value to the browser's console. Normal users do not see it; it is visible only in developer mode, so it is used for debugging and testing (like checking values with print in Python). To show something to the user, you must change the web page content (Section 5.3).

Lab 5.1: In Chrome press F12 to open developer mode:
  • Elements tab: the HTML code (with CSS/JS) of the current page;
  • Console tab: output of console.log() and error messages;
  • Network tab: the HTTP requests sent and responses received.
cards.zh:
console.log() 把值输出到浏览器 console。一般用户看不到，只在 developer mode 可见，用于 debugging/testing（类似 Python 用 print 查值）。要让用户看到，必须改变网页内容（见 5.3）。

Lab 5.1：Chrome 按 F12 进入开发者模式：
  • Elements：当前网页的 HTML（含 CSS/JS）
  • Console：console.log() 输出及错误信息
  • Network：发送的 HTTP requests 与收到的 responses

ex.q: A student's counter button does nothing. Which developer-mode tab should she check first, and why? Which tab would show whether a form was sent to the server?
ex.a:
Console tab: JavaScript errors (e.g. a misspelt function name) and console.log() values appear there.
Network tab: shows the HTTP request sent when the form is submitted and the response.
ex.az: 先看 Console（错误信息、log 值）；表单是否发送看 Network。

cards.zh:
对字符串用 + 把它们接成一个字符串（concatenation）。
String 与 Number 用 + 相接时，数字先转成字符串："Score: " + 5 得 "Score: 5"；"5" + 3 得 "53" 而不是 8。运算由左至右：1 + 2 + "3" 得 "33"，"1" + 2 + 3 得 "123"。

语言对比：Python 与 JavaScript 用 +；PHP 用点号 (.)。+ 不会自动加空格，要自己加 " "。

ex.a:
Line 2: "Total:" + 4 → "Total:4", then + 1 → Total:41.
Line 3: brackets first, 4 + 1 = 5 → Total:5.
ex.az: 由左到右：先变字符串再接 1 → Total:41；括号先算 → Total:5。

cards.zh:
Template literal 让你把变量（或表达式）直接插入字符串：整个字符串用 backtick (`) 包住，变量写成 ${变量}，例如 `Sum = ${2 + 3}` 得 Sum = 5。
单引号或双引号不行："Hi ${n}" 会原样输出 ${n}。

对比 PHP variable parsing：PHP 主字符串用双引号、变量写 {$name}；JS 主字符串用 backtick、变量写 ${name}。

ex.q: Rewrite with a template literal: console.log(name + " scored " + mark + " marks");
ex.a:
console.log(`${name} scored ${mark} marks`);
Spaces are typed inside the backtick string directly.
ex.az: 用 backtick 包整句，变量写成 ${name}、${mark}。

cards.zh:
Example 5.1 综合练习 5.1：let 声明、运算优先级、整除和输出。
考试要点：(1) 括号 → ** → * / % → + -；(2) 整除要用 Math.floor()；(3) 连接字符串时要准确检查输出中的空格；(4) 连接与 template literal 可得相同结果。

ex.q: Write code that stores x = 20, y = 4, computes z = (x ÷ y)² and outputs the floor of z ÷ 7.
ex.a:
let x = 20;
let y = 4;
let z = (x / y) ** 2;
console.log(Math.floor(z / 7));
z = 5² = 25; 25 / 7 = 3.57…; floor → 3.

cards.tz: 布尔表达式与关系运算符
cards.en:
A Boolean expression is formed with relational operators and can only evaluate to true or false. It is used in selection (if), while loops and for loops.
With x = 13, y = -5:
OperatorMeaningExampleResult
==equal tox == yfalse
!=not equal tox != ytrue
<less thanx < yfalse
>greater thanx > ytrue
<=less than or equalx <= yfalse
>=greater than or equalx >= ytrue
Do not confuse = (assignment) with == (comparison). Note: == converts types before comparing, so "5" == 5 is true (=== also checks type).
cards.zh:
Boolean expression 由 relational operators 组成，结果只会是 true 或 false，用于 if、while、for。
x = 13, y = -5：x == y 为 false；x != y 为 true；x < y 为 false；x > y 为 true；x <= y 为 false；x >= y 为 true。

不要混淆 =（赋值）和 ==（比较）。补充：== 会先转换类型，所以 "5" == 5 为 true（=== 还会检查类型）。

ex.q: With a = 7, b = "7", c = 10, evaluate: a == b, c % a != 3, a >= c.
ex.a:
a == b: "7" is converted to 7 → true.
c % a = 3, so 3 != 3 → false.
7 >= 10 → false.
ex.az: == 会转换类型 → true；10%7=3 → false；7>=10 → false。

cards.en:
Logical operators combine Boolean expressions:
OperatorNameTrue when
&&ANDboth sides are true
||ORat least one side is true
!NOTreverses true/false
PHP also accepts the words and/or, Python uses and/or/not, but in JavaScript write &&, ||, !.
Precedence: ! first, then &&, then ||. Use brackets to be clear.
Typical uses: range check score >= 0 && score <= 100; invalid check g <= lower || g >= upper.
cards.zh:
逻辑运算符组合多个布尔表达式：&& (AND) 两边都 true 才 true；|| (OR) 至少一边 true 就 true；! (NOT) 取反。
Python 用 and/or/not，JavaScript 必须写 &&、||、!。
优先次序：! → && → ||，建议加括号。
常见用法：范围检查 score >= 0 && score <= 100；无效输入 g <= lower || g >= upper。

ex.q: Write a condition that is true when age is between 12 and 18 inclusive, or the user is a member (member is Boolean).
ex.a:
(age >= 12 && age <= 18) || member
The bracket groups the range check; || adds the member case.
ex.az: 范围用 &&，再用 || 加会员条件。

cards.tz: 选择结构 if / else if / else
cards.en:
if (mark >= 80) {
  grade = "A";
} else if (mark >= 50) {
  grade = "B";
} else {
  grade = "F";
}
The condition must be in round brackets ( ) and each block in curly brackets { }. Only the first true branch runs; the rest are skipped, so order the conditions carefully (largest threshold first).
Difference from PHP: PHP allows elseif as one word; in JavaScript write else if as two words. Python uses elif and a colon. else is optional.
cards.zh:
条件写在圆括号 ( ) 内，代码块写在花括号 { } 内。只执行第一个为 true 的分支，其余跳过，所以条件次序要小心（大门槛放前面）。
与 PHP 的区别：PHP 可以写成一个字 elseif；JavaScript 必须写 else if（两个字）。Python 用 elif 和冒号。else 可省略。

ex.q:
What grade does mark = 85 get in this code, and why is it wrong?
if (mark >= 50) { g = "B"; }
else if (mark >= 80) { g = "A"; }
ex.a: 85 >= 50 is true, so g = "B" and the else if is skipped. The order is wrong: test mark >= 80 first.
ex.az: 第一个条件已成立，后面跳过 → 得 B；应先检查 ≥80。

cards.zh:
while loop 在条件为 true 时重复执行一组语句。每次循环之前检查条件，所以循环体可能一次都不执行。
循环内必须有语句改变条件，否则会形成 infinite loop，浏览器分页卡死。
当事先不知道重复次数时用 while（例如不断加倍直到超过某值）。例：num 从 17 开始每次加 17，num < 100 时输出 → 17、34、51、68、85。

ex.a: n: 1 → 3 → 9 → 27 → 81. After 81 the condition 81 <= 50 is false. Body ran 4 times; final n = 81.

cards.zh:
for loop 遍历一段数字。括号内三部分用分号分隔：
  1. initialisation（let i = 0）只执行一次；
  2. condition（i < 5）每次循环前检查；
  3. update（i++）每次循环后执行。
与 Python 的 range() 不同，条件要自己写。倒数：for (let i = 10; i > 0; i--)；步长 2：i += 2。遍历数组用 i < arr.length（索引 0 到 length - 1）。

ex.q: Write a for loop that adds the odd numbers from 1 to 99 into sum.
ex.a:
let sum = 0;
for (let i = 1; i <= 99; i += 2) {
  sum += i;
}
console.log(sum);   // 2500
ex.az: 从 1 开始每次加 2，到 99，和为 2500。

cards.en:
An array is a data structure that stores a series of data sequentially. JavaScript arrays are similar to arrays in PHP and lists in Python.
let staff = [];                       // empty array
let members = ["Thomas", "Sandra"];   // initialised
console.log(members[0]);              // Thomas
Create with square brackets [ ]; elements are comma-separated. Access an element with the square bracket operator and its index; indices start from 0, so the last element is at index length - 1. Reading an index that does not exist gives undefined (no error). Change an element by assigning: members[1] = "Cherrie";
cards.zh:
Array 是按顺序存放一系列数据的数据结构，类似 PHP 的 array 和 Python 的 list。
用方括号 [ ] 建立，元素以逗号分隔。用方括号加 index 访问元素；index 从 0 开始，最后一个元素在 length - 1。读取不存在的 index 得 undefined（不会报错）。直接赋值可修改元素：members[1] = "Cherrie";

ex.q:
let f = ["Thomas", "Sandra"];
f[1] = "Cherrie";
console.log(f[0] + "," + f[1] + "," + f[2]);
Output?
ex.a: f[1] is replaced by Cherrie. f[2] does not exist → undefined. Output: Thomas,Cherrie,undefined.
ex.az: f[1] 改为 Cherrie；f[2] 不存在得 undefined。

cards.en:
array.push(x) adds an element to the end (rightmost) of the array.
array.length is a property (no brackets) that returns the number of elements.
let friends = ["Thomas", "Cherrie"];
friends.push("Kelvin");     // [Thomas, Cherrie, Kelvin]
let count = friends.length;  // 3
let last = friends[friends.length - 1];  // Kelvin
Compare: PHP uses count($arr) and array_push / $arr[] =; Python uses len(lst) and lst.append(). A typical pattern: start with an empty array and push each new input, e.g. score.push(inputscore); then show score.length.
cards.zh:
array.push(x) 把元素加到数组末尾（最右边）。
array.length 是 property（不加括号），返回元素个数。最后一个元素：friends[friends.length - 1]。
对比：PHP 用 count($arr)；Python 用 len(lst)、lst.append()。常见模式：从空数组开始，每次输入就 push，例如 score.push(inputscore)，再显示 score.length。

ex.q: Write code to find the average of the array score = [70, 85, 90].
ex.a:
let score = [70, 85, 90];
let total = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < score.length; i++) {
  total += score[i];
}
let avg = total / score.length;   // 81.666...
ex.az: 用 length 控制循环累加，再除以 length。

cards.t: Example 5.2: marking quiz answers with arrays
cards.en:
Example 5.2 (online MC quiz): array attempt stores the student's choices and array key stores the correct answers, e.g. attempt = ["A","B","A","C","B"], key = ["A","C","A","C","E"]. Both arrays have the same number of elements.
Method:
  1. length = key.length (or attempt.length);
  2. loop i from 0 to length - 1;
  3. compare elements at the same index: attempt[i] == key[i];
  4. if equal, correct += 1; otherwise output the question number i + 1 (because the index starts from 0) and the correct answer.
The result for the sample: correct = 3, questions 2 and 5 are wrong.
cards.zh:
Example 5.2（网上 MC 测验）：数组 attempt 存学生选择，key 存正确答案，两者元素数相同。
方法：
  1. length = key.length；
  2. i 从 0 循环到 length - 1；
  3. 比较同一 index 的元素 attempt[i] == key[i]；
  4. 相同则 correct += 1；否则输出题号 i + 1（因为 index 从 0 开始）和正确答案。
例子结果：correct = 3，第 2、5 题错。

ex.a:
(a) key.length
(b) correct += 1;
(c) console.log(`Question ${i + 1} is wrong. Answer: ${key[i]}`);
ex.az: (a) key.length；(b) correct += 1；(c) 用 i + 1 作题号并输出 key[i]。

cards.t: Array techniques: random index, range, duplicates
cards.tz: 数组技巧：随机、范围、重复
cards.en:
Useful patterns that appear in the book's examples and exercises:
  • Random integer: Math.floor(Math.random() * n) gives 0 to n - 1, ideal for a random array index: arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]. A random integer from a to b inclusive: Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1)) + a (e.g. 25 to 75).
  • Range check of every element: loop and test arr[i] < low || arr[i] > high.
  • Duplicate check: nested loops comparing arr[i] with arr[j] for j > i, or arr.indexOf(x) != -1 to see if x is already present.
  • Max/min: start with arr[0] and update while looping.
cards.zh:
书中例题与练习常用技巧：
  • 随机整数：Math.floor(Math.random() * n) 得 0 至 n - 1，适合作随机 index：arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]。a 至 b（含两端）：Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1)) + a（如 25 至 75）。
  • 范围检查：循环检查 arr[i] < low || arr[i] > high。
  • 重复检查：双重循环比较 arr[i] 与 arr[j]（j > i），或用 arr.indexOf(x) != -1 看是否已存在。
  • 最大/最小：以 arr[0] 为起点，循环时更新。

ex.q: A quote array has 3 quotes. Write a statement that picks a random index, and state which value gives the second quote.
ex.a:
let quoteindex = Math.floor(Math.random() * quotearray.length);
Math.random() * 3 is in [0, 3), floor gives 0, 1 or 2. The second quote is at index 1.
ex.az: Math.random()*3 在 [0,3)，取整得 0、1、2；第二句 index 为 1。

cards.t: Identifying elements with the id attribute
cards.tz: 用 id 属性识别元素
cards.en:
To manipulate an HTML element with JavaScript, we first need a way to identify it. Give the element an id attribute:
<p id="name"></p>
<h1 id="greet">Welcome back!</h1>
An id must be unique within the page (no two elements share the same id), so JavaScript can find exactly one element. ids are case-sensitive and should not contain spaces ("hint_para" is fine, "hint para" is not a usable id). The section's running application ("Show Yourself"): a page with a <p> and a button; when the user clicks the button, the text in the <p> changes to the user's name.
cards.zh:
要用 JavaScript 操作 HTML 元素，先要能识别它：给元素加 id attribute，例如 <p id="name"></p>。
id 在整个网页内必须唯一 (unique)，JS 才能准确找到一个元素。id 区分大小写，不应含空格（"hint_para" 可以，"hint para" 不能用）。
本节的应用（Show Yourself）：页面有一个 <p> 和一个按钮，用户按按钮后 <p> 的文字变成用户名字。

ex.q: A page has <p id="msg"> twice. What problem does this cause?
ex.a: ids must be unique. getElementById("msg") returns only the first matching element, so the second paragraph can never be changed by that call; the HTML is also invalid.
ex.az: id 重复，getElementById 只返回第一个，第二个无法被修改。

cards.zh:
浏览器把网页表示成 DOM (Document Object Model)：一棵对象树，JavaScript 通过 DOM API 访问。对象 document 代表整个网页。
document.getElementById("id") 返回 id 相符的元素；找不到则返回 null。
注意拼写：getElementById，E、B、I 大写，d 小写；id 要写成带引号的字符串。

ex.q: Find two errors: document.getElementByID(name).innerText = "Hi"; where the element is <p id="name">.
ex.a:
1. getElementByID should be getElementById (lower-case d).
2. The id must be a string: "name"; without quotes it refers to a variable called name.
ex.az: ID 应为 Id；id 要加引号。

cards.en:
innerText is a property of an element that retrieves or changes the text inside it. Assigning to it replaces the text immediately on the page:
document.getElementById("name").innerText = "Hello Linda";
innerHTML retrieves or changes the HTML markup inside the element, so tags are interpreted.
Assigned valueinnerText showsinnerHTML shows
"Hi <b>Tom</b>"Hi <b>Tom</b> (tags shown as text)Hi Tom (bold)
Use innerText for plain text (safer, user input cannot inject HTML); use innerHTML when you need formatting or new elements.
cards.zh:
innerText 是元素的 property，可读取或改变元素内的文字，赋值后网页立即更新。
innerHTML 读取或改变元素内的 HTML 标记，标签会被解析。
例：赋值 "Hi <b>Tom</b>"：innerText 会把标签当文字显示；innerHTML 显示粗体 Tom。
纯文字用 innerText（较安全，用户输入不会插入 HTML）；需要格式或新元素时用 innerHTML。

ex.q: Write ONE statement to make <div id="out"> show a list item "Apple" inside a <ul>.
ex.a:
document.getElementById("out").innerHTML = "<ul><li>Apple</li></ul>";
innerHTML is needed because the value contains tags.
ex.az: 含标签，要用 innerHTML。

cards.t: When should the manipulation code run? Functions
cards.zh:
如果改变文字的语句直接写在 <script> 里，会在页面加载时立即执行（按顺序），而不是用户点击时。所以要把代码放进 function，只有被调用 (invoke) 时才执行。
语法：关键字 function、函数名、圆括号 ( )、花括号内为函数体。定义函数不会执行它。function 还能重用代码，并把功能放在 <head>，与 layout 分开。

ex.q: In Exercise-style welcome.html the function showrandomquote() is defined in <head>. Complete the script in <body> (after <p id="quote">) so a quote is shown when the page loads.
ex.a:
<script>
  showrandomquote();
</script>
It is placed after the <p>, so the element already exists when the function runs.
ex.az: 在 <p> 之后调用 showrandomquote()。

cards.tz: 带 parameter 与 return 的 function
cards.zh: function 可接收 parameter，并用 return 传回值。调用时传入的值（如 3、4）叫 argument，函数定义里的 a、b 叫 parameter。return 会立即结束函数并把值交回调用处；没有 return 的函数返回 undefined。函数内用 let 声明的变量是 local，外面不能用。参数让一个函数处理多种情况，如 update(k) 同时服务 +1 和 -1 按钮。

ex.q: Write a function grade(m) that returns "Pass" if m >= 50, otherwise "Fail". What is grade(49)?
ex.a:
function grade(m) {
  if (m >= 50) {
    return "Pass";
  }
  return "Fail";
}
grade(49) → "Fail".
ex.az: m≥50 返回 Pass，否则 Fail；49 得 Fail。

cards.en:
JavaScript makes a page interactive through two mechanisms: event and event handler. An event is a user interaction with the page, such as clicking, scrolling, typing. In web applications an event is always linked to an HTML element.
EventMeaningPossible handling
click on <button>user clicked the buttondisplay a welcome message
change on <input type="text">text in the field changedshow suggested search terms
copy on <p>user copied text from the paragraphremind the user not to plagiarise
focus on <input type="password">user focused on the password fieldshow "Forget Password" if nothing typed after 10 s
submit on <form>form being submittedclient-side validation; send data only if valid
cards.zh:
JavaScript 靠 event 与 event handler 两个机制实现交互。Event 是用户与网页的互动，如点击、滚动、打字；在 web application 中，event 总是与某个 HTML 元素相连。
常见：<button> 的 click（显示欢迎信息）；<input type="text"> 的 change（显示建议搜索词）；<p> 的 copy（提醒不要抄袭）；密码框的 focus（10 秒未输入显示 Forget Password）；<form> 的 submit（先做 client-side validation，无误才发 HTTP request 给 server）。

ex.q: Suggest a suitable event and element for: (i) checking an email address before data is sent; (ii) warning users who copy an article.
ex.a:
(i) submit event on the <form>: validate first, send to the server only if valid.
(ii) copy event on the <p> containing the article: show a reminder not to plagiarise.
ex.az: (i) form 的 submit；(ii) <p> 的 copy。

cards.t: Event handling: registering an event handler
cards.en:
Event handling is how the application reacts to an event. It is done by registering a function as the event handler for an event; the browser invokes the handler when the event occurs. In HTML, add an attribute on + event name to the element:
<button onclick="showName()">Show</button>
<input type="text" onchange="suggest()">
<form onsubmit="return check()">
Note the attribute value is a function call with brackets: onclick="showName()". Writing onclick="showName" does nothing. You do not call the handler yourself; the browser does it each time the event happens.
cards.zh:
Event handling 是应用对事件的反应方式：把一个 function 注册为该事件的 event handler，事件发生时由浏览器调用它。HTML 中给元素加 on + 事件名 attribute，例如 onclick="showName()"、onchange="suggest()"、onsubmit。
注意属性值要写成带括号的调用：onclick="showName()"；写 onclick="showName" 不会执行。handler 不用自己调用，每次事件发生浏览器都会调用。

ex.q: Complete the full Show Yourself page: clicking the button changes <p id="name"> to "I am Linda".
ex.a:
<head><script>
function showName() {
  document.getElementById("name").innerText = "I am Linda";
}
</script></head>
<body>
  <p id="name">Who am I?</p>
  <button onclick="showName()">Show yourself</button>
</body>
Steps: (1) id on the element; (2) getElementById + innerText inside a function; (3) register it with onclick.
ex.az: 三步：元素加 id；function 内 getElementById + innerText；用 onclick 注册。

cards.t: Reading text with innerText and Number()
cards.tz: 用 innerText 读取文字与 Number()
cards.en:
innerText can also retrieve the current text of an element:
let x = document.getElementById("counter").innerText;
The value retrieved is always a String, even if it looks like a number. If you then write x + 1, + concatenates: "4" + 1 = "41". Convert it first with Number():
x = Number(x) + 1;   // 5
Number(" 7 ") is 7 (spaces ignored); Number("abc") is NaN (Not a Number). Note that - * / convert strings automatically ("9" - 2 = 7), which is why bugs with + are easy to miss.
cards.zh:
innerText 也可以读取元素当前文字，但读到的一定是 String，即使看似数字。直接写 x + 1 时 + 会连接："4" + 1 = "41"。要先用 Number() 转换：x = Number(x) + 1 得 5。
Number(" 7 ") 得 7（忽略空格）；Number("abc") 得 NaN（Not a Number）。注意 - * / 会自动转换（"9" - 2 = 7），所以 + 的错误容易被忽略。

ex.q: <p id="counter">9</p>. What does the page show after each version runs once? (i) x = x + 1; (ii) x = x - 1; (iii) x = Number(x) + 1;
ex.a:
(i) 91 (string concatenation)
(ii) 8 (- converts to number)
(iii) 10

cards.t: The counter application: step by step
cards.zh:
5.4 节设计 counter：<p id="counter">0</p> 加上加/减按钮。handler 每次都做三步：
  1. 读取现值（innerText）；
  2. 处理：Number(x) + 1；
  3. 更新网页：把 x 赋回 innerText。
按钮写 onclick="add()"。状态直接存在元素文字里，不需要发送任何东西到 server。

ex.q: Write subtract() for the counter so the value never goes below 0.
ex.a:
function subtract() {
  let x = Number(document.getElementById("counter").innerText);
  if (x > 0) {
    x = x - 1;
  }
  document.getElementById("counter").innerText = x;
}
ex.az: 先读取并转为数字，x > 0 才减 1，再写回。

cards.t: Passing arguments when invoking from an event
cards.zh:
不用分别写 add() 与 subtract()，而是写一个带 parameter 的 function，在每个 onclick 传不同 argument：update(1)、update(-1)。
好处：减少重复代码；容易维护（改一次即可）。同样方法可让一个函数更新多个计数器，例如 update("c2", 1)，第一个参数是计数器的 id。

ex.q: Write update(id, k) and the button for adding 5 to the counter with id "p3".
ex.a:
function update(id, k) {
  let x = Number(document.getElementById(id).innerText);
  document.getElementById(id).innerText = x + k;
}
<button onclick="update('p3', 5)">+5</button> (single quotes inside the double-quoted attribute).
ex.az: id 作参数，不加引号使用变量；HTML 中用单引号包 'p3'。

cards.zh:
<input> 中用户输入的内容在 value property，不是 innerText。
.value 也是 String（即使 type="number"），计算前要 Number()。赋值 "" 可在按钮按下后清空输入框。
典型流程：读取输入 → validate（例如 0 至 100）→ 处理（push 入数组）→ 更新网页。

ex.q: Write addscore(): read <input id="input">; if the score is 0 to 100, push it into array score, clear the box and show "No. of scores: n" in <p id="counting">.
ex.a:
function addscore() {
  let s = Number(document.getElementById("input").value);
  if (s >= 0 && s <= 100) {
    score.push(s);
    document.getElementById("input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("counting").innerText = "No. of scores: " + score.length;
  }
}
ex.az: Number 转换 → 范围检查 → push → 清空 → 显示 length。

cards.en:
A guessing page keeps a secret number (e.g. 67) and shows the current upper and lower limits in <td id="upper"> and <td id="lower">. When the user clicks Guess:
  1. read guess with .value and limits with innerText, all converted with Number();
  2. invalid if g <= lower || g >= upper: show a message;
  3. if g == secret: show "Correct!";
  4. else if g > secret: the new upper limit is g; otherwise the new lower limit is g.
This combines everything in the chapter: reading input, Boolean and logical operators, if/else if/else, and updating elements.
cards.zh:
猜数字页面：秘密数字（如 67），当前上限和下限显示在 <td id="upper">、<td id="lower">。按 Guess 时：
  1. 用 .value 读猜测、innerText 读上下限，全部 Number()；
  2. g <= lower || g >= upper 为无效，显示提示；
  3. g == secret 显示 Correct!；
  4. 否则 g > secret 则新上限为 g，否则新下限为 g。
综合本章：读取输入、布尔与逻辑运算、if/else、更新元素。

ex.q: Limits are lower 40, upper 90, secret 67. The user enters 75, then 30. What happens each time?
ex.a:
75: valid (40 < 75 < 90), 75 > 67 → upper becomes 75.
30: 30 <= 40 → invalid, limits unchanged.
ex.az: 75 有效且大于 67 → 上限变 75；30 ≤ 40 无效。

cards.t: Final challenge: PHP + JavaScript four-player counter
cards.tz: 最终挑战：PHP + JS 四人计数器
cards.en: The final challenge combines Chapter 4 and 5: setup.html has a form where the user enters four player names; the form data is sent to four_counter.php. The PHP script (server-side) reads $_POST and generates an HTML page containing a table of four names, each with a points cell starting at 0 and Add/Subtract buttons, plus the JavaScript (client-side) that updates the points. Key ideas: PHP runs once on the server to build the page; after that, every click is handled in the browser by JavaScript with no request to the server. Give each points cell a unique id (e.g. p1 to p4) and use one function update(id, k).
cards.zh: 最终挑战结合第 4、5 章：setup.html 表单输入四个玩家名字，数据发送到 four_counter.php。PHP（server-side）读取 $_POST，生成一个 HTML 页面：四个名字的表格，每行分数由 0 开始，有 Add/Subtract 按钮，并附上更新分数的 JavaScript（client-side）。重点：PHP 在 server 只执行一次来生成页面；之后每次点击都由浏览器中的 JS 处理，不再向 server 发请求。每个分数格要有唯一 id（如 p1 至 p4），并用一个 update(id, k) 函数。

ex.q: Write the PHP line that outputs the row for player 1 (name in input p1).
ex.a:
echo "<tr><td>{$_POST['p1']}</td><td id='s1'>0</td>
  <td><button onclick=\"update('s1',1)\">Add</button></td>
  <td><button onclick=\"update('s1',-1)\">Subtract</button></td></tr>";
The PHP output becomes HTML whose buttons call the JavaScript update() in the browser.
ex.az: PHP 输出含 onclick 的 HTML，按钮之后由浏览器的 JS 处理。

cards.en:
For pages with many elements, writing a function and getElementById call for every event becomes cumbersome. Since 2006 the library jQuery became very popular: long calls such as document.getElementById() are shortened to a hash (#), e.g. $("#counter"). As of Aug 2022 jQuery was used by about 77% of the 10 million most popular websites.
Today most web applications are built with a front-end framework, which abstracts state management and makes building interfaces faster: React, Angular, Vue (Vue is recommended for beginners).
Why still learn JavaScript? All front-end frameworks require proficiency in JavaScript and HTML; manipulating a page with plain JavaScript is elementary for any web developer.
cards.zh:
页面元素多时，每个事件都写 function 和 getElementById 很繁琐。2006 年起 jQuery 流行：document.getElementById() 可简写成 #，如 $("#counter")；2022 年 8 月约 77% 的千万热门网站使用 jQuery。
现在多数 web application 用 front-end framework 开发，它抽象化 state management，令界面开发更快：React、Angular、Vue（初学者推荐 Vue）。
为何仍要学 JavaScript？所有框架都要求熟练 JavaScript 和 HTML；用纯 JS 操作网页是 web developer 的基础。
