cards.t: Chapter overview and the Network Engineer
cards.tz: 本章概览与网络工程师
cards.en:
This chapter builds on Core C (TCP/IP, DNS, routers, switches, access points) and shows how a network that hosts a web application is actually put together.
  • 6.1 how a network address and a port number together identify a service.
  • 6.2 common network services: web server, database server, file server, DHCP server, domain controller and proxy server.
  • 6.3 sharing resources within a network: hardware (printers), files and the Internet connection.
  • 6.4 a basic network implementation: a simple home network with wired and wireless parts.
Career box: a Network Engineer designs, implements and maintains network infrastructure, choosing hardware, configuring routers/switches/servers, troubleshooting faults and working with system administrators and security analysts. For each service in this chapter, learn its function, its advantages and disadvantages compared with alternatives, and how it benefits users.
cards.zh:
本章建立在 Core C（TCP/IP、DNS、router、switch、access point）之上，讲一个承载 web application 的网络实际如何组成：
  • 6.1 network address 与 port number 如何一起定位一个服务；
  • 6.2 常见 network services：web server、database server、file server、DHCP server、domain controller、proxy server；
  • 6.3 网络内 共享资源：硬件（打印机）、文件、Internet connection；
  • 6.4 basic network implementation：有线加无线的简单家庭网络。
职业栏：Network Engineer designs, implements and maintains network infrastructure，包括选硬件、设定 router/switch/server、排除故障，并与 system administrator、security analyst 合作。温习每种服务时要能答出三点：function（作用/机制）、相对其他方案的 advantages / disadvantages、对用户有什么好处。DSE 结构题常以“某学校/公司要建网络”为情境，把这几节混在一起考。

ex.q: A school wants to host its own course website and share files. Name THREE network services from this chapter it may need and state one purpose of each.
ex.a:
• Web server: delivers web pages to students' browsers.
  • Database server: stores course data queried by server-side scripts.
  • File server: central shared storage for teaching files.
(DHCP server, domain controller or proxy server are also acceptable with a correct purpose.)
ex.az: 例如 web server 送网页，database server 存数据，file server 集中存文件；答 DHCP/domain controller/proxy 并写对用途亦可。

cards.en: An IP address only identifies a device. One computer may run many networked programs at once (a browser, an email client, an OS updater), so incoming data must also say which program it is for. A port number is a numerical identifier used to identify different services or applications running on the same network address. Port numbers are defined by TCP; a valid port is an unsigned 16-bit number, from 0 to 65535. Each networked application is assigned its own port. When data arrives, the computer checks the port number specified on the incoming data and directs the data to the application running on that port. A port is written after the address, separated by a colon, e.g. 192.168.0.10:443 or mysite.net:8080. The same idea applies to servers: a web server, a database server and a file server can share one network address, each listening on its own designated port.
cards.zh: IP address 只能找到哪一部机器；一部电脑同时有很多联网程序（browser、email client、系统更新），所以数据还要标明是给哪一个程序。A port number is a numerical identifier used to identify different services or applications running on the same network address. Port number 由 TCP 定义，有效值是 unsigned 16-bit number (0 to 65535)。每个联网应用占用自己的 port；收到数据时，电脑 checks the port number on the incoming data and directs the data to the application running on that port。写法：地址后加冒号再写端口，如 192.168.0.10:443、mysite.net:8080。Server 也一样：web server、database server、file server 可共用一个 IP，各自监听自己的 designated port。比喻：IP 是大厦地址，port 是房间号。

ex.q: Is 65536 a valid port number? Explain.
ex.a: No. A port number is an unsigned 16-bit integer. 16 bits give 216 = 65536 values, numbered 0 to 65535, so the largest valid port is 65535 and 65536 is out of range.

ex.q: A server at 10.0.0.5 runs a web server on port 80 and MySQL on port 3306. Data arrives addressed to 10.0.0.5:3306. Which program receives it?
ex.a: The IP 10.0.0.5 delivers the data to the server; the OS then reads port 3306 and passes the data to the application on that port, i.e. the MySQL database server.
ex.az: IP 先找到机器，再按 port 3306 交给 MySQL。

cards.en:
Port numbers are also used by UDP (User Datagram Protocol). Both TCP and UDP are transport layer protocols, sitting above IP.
TCPUDP
Reliabilityconnection-based, with error checking and retransmission; data arrives complete and in orderno mandatory error checking; lost packets are not resent
Speedmore overheadlower latency
Typical useweb browsing (HTTP/HTTPS), email (SMTP), file transferVoIP, DNS look-ups, real-time online gaming, live streaming
Key reasoning: choose TCP when every byte must be correct (a web page, a file), and UDP when speed matters more than occasional loss (a voice call can skip a lost packet rather than wait for it).
cards.zh:
UDP (User Datagram Protocol) 也使用 port number。TCP 和 UDP 都是 transport layer protocol，在 IP 之上。
TCPUDP
可靠性有 error checking、会重传，数据完整且按序无强制 error checking，丢包不重传
速度开销较大lower latency
用途浏览网页 HTTP/HTTPS、email SMTP、传文件VoIP、DNS、实时网络游戏、直播
答题逻辑：每个 byte 都必须正确（网页、文件）用 TCP；速度比偶尔丢失更重要（语音通话宁可跳过一个包也不要等）用 UDP。

ex.q: An online multiplayer game sends the player's position 30 times per second. Suggest TCP or UDP and justify.
ex.a: UDP. It has lower latency because there is no mandatory error checking/retransmission. If one position update is lost, a newer one arrives 1/30 s later, so resending the old one would only add delay.
ex.az: 用 UDP：延迟低；丢一个位置包，下一个很快就到，重传旧数据反而更慢。

cards.t: System ports and common port numbers
cards.en:
TCP reserves ports 0 to 1023 as system ports (well-known ports) for system processes that provide widely used network services. Many ports from 1024 to 65535 are unassigned on a typical computer and can be given to other applications. Ports in the book's table:
PortService
20, 21FTP (File Transfer Protocol)
22SSH (Secure Shell)
25SMTP (sending email to other domains)
53DNS
80HTTP
110POP3
143IMAP
443HTTPS
1194OpenVPN
3074XBOX game
3306MySQL
3389Microsoft Remote Desktop
5432PostgreSQL
Must memorise: 20/21, 22, 25, 53, 80, 110, 143, 443, 3306.
cards.zh:
TCP 把 port 0 to 1023 保留为 system ports（well-known ports），给提供常用网络服务的 system processes 使用；1024–65535 中很多在一般电脑上未被分配，可给其他应用用。书中端口表：
PortService
20, 21FTP
22SSH
25SMTP（发信到其他 domain）
53DNS
80HTTP
110POP3（收信）
143IMAP（收信）
443HTTPS
1194OpenVPN
3074XBOX
3306MySQL
3389Remote Desktop
5432PostgreSQL
必背：20/21、22、25、53、80、110、143、443、3306。记法：发信 SMTP 25，收信 POP3 110 / IMAP 143。

ex.q: A mail client sends an email and later downloads new mail using IMAP. Which destination ports are used?
ex.a: Sending to another domain uses SMTP, port 25. Retrieving mail with IMAP uses port 143. (If POP3 were used instead, port 110.)
ex.az: 发信 SMTP 25，用 IMAP 收信 143（POP3 则 110）。

cards.t: Assigning ports and default ports in URLs
cards.tz: 指定端口与 URL 默认端口
cards.en: Any application can be assigned a free port through the operating system. For example, the main web server of mysite.net listens on ports 80/443, while a developer runs a second web server for internal testing on port 8080 of the same domain: https://mysite.net:8080/notice.html. When the default port of a protocol is used, the port can be omitted from the URL: an HTTP request for https://www.mysite.net is automatically sent to port 443 of the destination. If the service runs on a non-default port, the port must be written after the domain with a colon, e.g. https://www.mysite.net:8080. Defaults to know: http:// → 80, https:// → 443, ftp:// → 21. Note the port comes before the path: scheme://host:port/path.
cards.zh: 任何应用都可经 operating system 分配一个空闲 port。例：mysite.net 主 web server 用 80/443，开发者在同一 domain 的 port 8080 另开 web server 作 internal testing：https://mysite.net:8080/notice.html。使用协议的 default port 时 URL 可省略端口：https://www.mysite.net 的请求自动送到目标的 443。服务在 non-default port 时，必须在 domain 后用冒号写出端口，如 https://www.mysite.net:8080。默认值：http:// 80、https:// 443、ftp:// 21。格式：scheme://host:port/path，端口在路径之前。

ex.q: Write the full destination (host and port) for each URL: (i) http://abc.org/a.html (ii) https://abc.org:8443/b (iii) https://abc.org/c
ex.a:
(i) abc.org, port 80 (HTTP default)
(ii) abc.org, port 8443 (written explicitly)
(iii) abc.org, port 443 (HTTPS default)
ex.az: (i) 80；(ii) 写明 8443；(iii) HTTPS 默认 443。

cards.t: Reasons for using a non-default port
cards.tz: 使用非默认端口的原因
cards.en:
The book gives four reasons why a service may be hosted on a non-default port:
  • Port conflict: the default port is already used by another application of the same protocol on that machine.
  • Security considerations: a non-default port can obfuscate the service, making it harder for attackers who scan default ports to find and access it.
  • Multiple instances: two instances of the same service on one domain (e.g. a primary and an internal-testing web server) cannot share a port, so the second uses another one.
  • Firewall restrictions: the network firewall blocks certain ports, so the service must use a port that is allowed.
Exam tip: if asked “why does the URL become xxx.com:8080?”, state a reason and explain it in the context. Note that changing the port does not make the server faster or increase bandwidth.
cards.zh:
书中列出服务改用非默认端口的四个原因：
  • Port conflict：默认端口已被同协议的另一应用占用。
  • Security considerations：非默认端口可 obfuscate 服务，只扫描默认端口的攻击者较难发现、存取。
  • Multiple instances：同一 domain 运行同一服务的两个 instance（如正式与测试 web server），不能共用端口，第二个须用别的。
  • Firewall restrictions：firewall 封锁某些 port，服务须改用被允许的端口。
考试技巧：问“为何 URL 变成 xxx.com:8080”，要写原因并结合情境解释。注意：改端口不会令 server 更快或增加 bandwidth。

ex.q: A teacher already runs Apache on port 80 of a lab PC and installs NGINX on the same PC. Why must NGINX use another port, and what URL would a student type if NGINX uses 8081?
ex.a: Two applications cannot listen on the same port at the same address; port 80 is taken by Apache, a port conflict. NGINX is therefore assigned e.g. 8081, reached with http://<PC address>:8081, since 8081 is not HTTP's default and must be written.
ex.az: 80 已被 Apache 占用（port conflict），NGINX 用 8081，URL 要写 :8081。

cards.en:
A simple web application relies on several network services working together; the first is the web server. A web server is an application that delivers web content (web pages, images, videos, files) when clients request them. It handles HTTP requests and produces HTTP responses. Besides returning static files directly from a directory, it can run server-side scripts (e.g. PHP) to generate responses dynamically, for example building a page from database results. Popular web server software: NGINX and Apache.
Flow:
  • The client sends an HTTP request containing the Request URL and Request Method (e.g. GET).
  • The server fetches the file from its directory or executes the script.
  • It returns an HTTP response with a status code (e.g. 200 OK), a content type (e.g. text/html) and the response body (the HTML).
cards.zh:
简单 web application 背后有多种 network services 协作，首先是 web server。A web server is an application that delivers web content (web pages, images, videos, files) when clients request them. 它 handles HTTP requests and produces HTTP responses。除了直接从 directory 回传 static 文件，还能执行 server-side scripts（如 PHP）dynamically 生成回应，例如用数据库结果拼出网页。常用软件：NGINX、Apache。
流程：
  • Client 发 HTTP request，含 Request URL 和 Request Method（如 GET）。
  • Server 从目录取文件，或执行 script。
  • 回传 HTTP response：status code（如 200 OK）、content type（如 text/html）、response body（HTML 内容）。

ex.q: A browser requests https://mysite.net/list.php. Describe what the web server does and what the response contains.
ex.a: The request (method GET, URL /list.php) arrives at port 443. Because list.php is a server-side script, the web server executes it (it may query a database) to generate HTML dynamically. It returns an HTTP response with status code 200 OK, content type text/html and the generated HTML as the response body.
ex.az: 请求到 443；.php 是 server-side script，server 执行它动态生成 HTML；回应含 200 OK、text/html 及 HTML 内容。

cards.en:
A database server uses a database management system (DBMS) to manage multiple databases, each with its own set of tables (together with their constraints and data). End-users rarely interact with it directly. Usually a server-side script on the web server sends a query to the database server; the database server executes it and returns the query result to the source, and the script turns the result into a web page. MySQL listens on port 3306 by default. Security:
  • User authentication: each account (e.g. root, web_server_01) has a username and password; only authenticated accounts can execute queries or modify data.
  • User access control: different accounts get different privileges, e.g. the web application's account may only SELECT/INSERT on one database, while root has full control.
cards.zh:
A database server uses a DBMS to manage multiple databases, each with its own set of tables（及 constraints、data）。终端用户很少直接接触它；通常是 web server 上的 server-side script 发 query，database server 执行后把 query result 回传，script 再把结果做成网页。MySQL 默认 port 3306。保安：
  • User authentication：每个帐户（如 root、web_server_01）有 username + password，只有通过认证的帐户可 execute queries 或修改数据。
  • User access control：不同帐户不同 privilege，例如网站帐户只可在某数据库 SELECT/INSERT，root 有全部权限。

ex.q: Trace what happens when a user searches for “printer” on an online shop built with PHP and MySQL.
ex.a:
1. Browser sends an HTTP request to the web server.
2. The PHP script logs in to the database server (port 3306) with its own account (authentication) and sends e.g. SELECT * FROM product WHERE name LIKE '%printer%'.
3. The DBMS executes the query and returns the query result to the script.
4. The script builds HTML from the result and the web server sends it back in the HTTP response. The user never talks to the database server directly.
ex.az: 浏览器→web server→PHP 以自己帐户登入 DB server 发 query→结果回传 script→生成 HTML 回传。用户不直接接触数据库。

cards.en:
A file server provides a centralised location for shared file access within a network. Like a local hard disk it organises data in a directory-based hierarchy of folders and sub-folders, and computers on the same network can access its folders and files. Because many users access it concurrently, it needs:
  • User authentication: users log in with username and password.
  • User access control: each user/group is given specific permissions on each folder and file.
Permissions on files:
PermissionMeaning on a file
Readread (open) the file's content
Writeedit the file's content
Executerun an executable file (.exe, .py, .php ...)
Benefits: one central copy (no scattered versions), easier backup and controlled sharing.
cards.zh:
A file server provides a centralised location for shared file access within a network. 与本机硬盘一样用 directory-based hierarchy（folders、sub-folders）；同网络电脑可存取其中文件。因多人 concurrently 存取，需要：
  • User authentication：用 username + password 登入。
  • User access control：对每个 folder、file 给每个用户/组别特定 permissions。
文件权限：
Permission对文件的意义
Read读取（打开）内容
Write编辑内容
Execute执行可执行文件（.exe、.py、.php…）
好处：集中一份（不会版本散乱）、易备份、受控共享。

ex.q: A student has Read but not Write permission on the file notes.docx. What can and cannot she do with it?
ex.a: She can open and read notes.docx (and could save a copy elsewhere if allowed), but she cannot edit/save changes to the file on the server, because editing content needs Write permission on the file.
ex.az: 可打开阅读，不能修改保存，因为改内容要 Write。

cards.t: Folder permissions and the school example
cards.tz: 文件夹权限与学校例子
cards.en:
The same permission names mean different things on a folder:
PermissionMeaning on a folder
Readlist the names of files and sub-folders inside (to read a file's content you also need Read on that file)
Writecreate new files, delete or rename existing files in the folder
Book example (school file server):
  • admin (chris_kim): full permissions on everything.
  • teacher (tiffanychan): Public read only (cannot delete/change by mistake); ICT and Exam_Result read + write (add, delete, edit files); no Execute, so unauthorised programs cannot run on the server.
  • student (billy_kwok): Public read only; ICT read only (cannot add/delete files); no Read on 2026_PastPaper.pdf (sees the name, cannot open it); no rights on Exam_Result (cannot even see the folder).
Principle: give each user only the permissions they need (least privilege).
cards.zh:
同名权限放在 folder 上意义不同：
Permission对 folder 的意义
Read列出里面文件/子文件夹的名字（要读文件内容还需该文件的 Read）
Write在该文件夹 create new files, delete or rename
书中学校例子：
  • admin（chris_kim）：全部权限。
  • teacher（tiffanychan）：Public 只读（防误删误改）；ICT、Exam_Result 读写（增删改）；没有 Execute，防止未授权程序在 server 执行。
  • student（billy_kwok）：Public、ICT 只读（不能增删）；对 2026_PastPaper.pdf 没有 Read（看到名字但打不开）；对 Exam_Result 无任何权限（连文件夹都看不到）。
原则：只给需要的权限（least privilege）。

ex.q: Billy has Read on folder ICT but no Read on ICT/2026_PastPaper.pdf. Describe what he sees when he opens folder ICT, and what happens when he double-clicks the PDF.
ex.a: Folder Read lets him list the names, so he sees “2026_PastPaper.pdf” in the listing. When he tries to open it, access is denied because reading a file's content requires Read permission on the file itself, which he lacks.
ex.az: 文件夹 Read 让他看到文件名；打开时被拒，因为读内容要文件本身的 Read。

cards.tz: File server 与云端储存比较
cards.en:
Cloud storage (e.g. OneDrive, Google Drive) is the main alternative to running your own file server.
AspectFile serverCloud storage
Setup cost and timehigher (buy hardware, install, configure)easy and quick to start
Cost per storage unithigh initial hardware cost but cheaper per unit in the long runmonthly/yearly subscription fee, more expensive long term
Scalabilitycan be expanded but needs technical expertiseeasy to scale up, but limited by the provider's maximum plan
Access speedfaster (inside the same LAN)slower (data travels over the Internet)
Ease of accessmay need technical knowledge to connect, usually only from the networkaccess anywhere with Internet via browser or app
Choose a file server for large, frequently used data inside one site; cloud storage for small teams, remote users or quick start.
cards.zh:
云端储存（如 OneDrive、Google Drive）是自建 file server 的主要替代。
方面File serverCloud storage
Setup cost & time较高（买硬件、安装、设定）easy and quick
Cost per storage unit初期硬件贵，但长期每单位较便宜要付 monthly/yearly subscription fee，长期较贵
Scalability可扩充但需 technical expertise容易扩充，但受 provider 最大容量限制
Access speed较快（同一 LAN）较慢（经 Internet）
Ease of access可能需技术知识，通常只在网内有 Internet 便可随处存取（browser/app）
选择：一个地点内大量、常用数据→file server；小团队、遥距用户、想快速开始→cloud storage。

ex.q: A video production company stores 40 TB of footage edited daily by staff in one office. Recommend file server or cloud storage with two reasons.
ex.a: File server. (1) Editors work inside the same LAN, so access speed is much faster than downloading huge video files over the Internet. (2) With 40 TB the long-term cost per storage unit is lower than paying a cloud subscription for that capacity (and large plans may hit the provider's limit).
ex.az: 选 file server：LAN 内速度快；40 TB 长期每单位成本较低。

cards.en:
Every device on a network needs a unique IP address. Typing them in by hand is slow and error-prone, so a Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) server assigns IP addresses to devices on a network dynamically.
  • The administrator first defines the range of IP addresses that may be given out, called the scope (e.g. 192.168.0.96 to 192.168.0.200).
  • When a new device connects, it sends a DHCP request, and the server assigns an unused IP from the scope.
  • Each assigned IP has a fixed lease duration (e.g. 24 hours). When the lease expires, a device still online must request again.
  • Because the scope holds a limited number of IPs, the server can reclaim addresses that are no longer used or whose lease has expired after a device disconnects, so many devices can share a limited pool over time.
Besides the IP, DHCP also gives other settings: subnet mask, default gateway, DNS server address.
cards.zh:
网络上每部设备都需要唯一 IP。人手输入慢又易出错，所以 a DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) server assigns IP addresses to devices on a network dynamically.
  • 管理员先定义可分配的 IP 范围，称为 scope（如 192.168.0.96–192.168.0.200）。
  • 新设备连上网络时发 DHCP request，server 从 scope 中给一个未用的 IP。
  • 每个 IP 有固定 lease duration（如 24 小时），到期后仍在线的设备须再请求。
  • scope 中 IP 有限，server 可 reclaim 不再使用或断线后 lease 到期的 IP，令多部设备轮流共用有限 IP。
除 IP 外，DHCP 还提供 subnet mask、default gateway、DNS server address。

ex.q: A DHCP scope is 192.168.0.96 to 192.168.0.200. How many devices can hold an address at the same time? A café has 150 customers' phones over a day but at most 60 at once; is the scope enough?
ex.a: Number of addresses = 200 − 96 + 1 = 105. At most 60 phones are online at once, so 105 is enough: with a lease (e.g. 2 hours), addresses of phones that have left are reclaimed after the lease expires and given to new customers, so 150 phones over the day can share 105 addresses.
ex.az: 200−96+1=105 个；同时最多 60 部，lease 到期后 IP 被回收再分配，足够。

cards.en:
A brand-new computer does not yet know the DHCP server's IP address, so how can it ask for one?
  1. DHCP discovery: the computer broadcasts a DHCP message to all devices on the network.
  2. Only the DHCP server replies, with a DHCP offer containing the server's IP address and other network configuration: an offered IP, subnet mask, default gateway and DNS server address.
  3. The computer sends a DHCP request asking for the offered address.
  4. The server confirms and the IP is assigned to the computer for the lease duration.
(These four steps are often remembered as DORA: Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge.) Note: the offer contains network settings only, never user passwords.
cards.zh:
新电脑还不知道 DHCP server 的 IP，怎样请求？
  1. DHCP discovery：电脑向网络上所有设备 broadcast DHCP message。
  2. 只有 DHCP server 回应 DHCP offer，内含 server 的 IP 和其他 network configuration：提供的 IP、subnet mask、default gateway、DNS server address。
  3. 电脑再发 DHCP request 要求该 IP。
  4. Server 确认，IP 在 lease 期内分配给该电脑。
俗称 DORA：Discover、Offer、Request、Acknowledge。注意：offer 只含网络设定，不含用户密码。

ex.q: Why must the first DHCP message be a broadcast?
ex.a: The new computer has no IP configuration and does not know the DHCP server's address, so it cannot send to it directly. Broadcasting reaches every device; only the DHCP server responds (with a DHCP offer), which tells the computer the server's IP.
ex.az: 新电脑不知道 DHCP server 的地址，只能广播；只有 DHCP server 回应。

cards.en:
Advantages (compared with manually setting static IPs on every device):
  • Automatic IP address assignment: reduces IP address conflicts (two devices with the same IP) and human errors from manual configuration.
  • Centralised network management: parameters such as subnet mask, default gateway and DNS are managed in one place, so they are easy to maintain and update for every device.
  • Faster network setup: users can get online without configuring anything.
Disadvantage:
  • Single point of failure: if the DHCP server fails, new devices cannot obtain an IP, and existing devices lose connectivity when their lease expires.
Mitigation (beyond the book): a backup DHCP server, or giving key servers/printers static IPs.
cards.zh:
优点（相对每部机手动设 static IP）：
  • Automatic IP address assignment：减少 IP address conflicts（两机同 IP）及手动设定的 human errors。
  • Centralised network management：subnet mask、default gateway、DNS 等参数集中管理，所有设备易维护更新。
  • Faster network setup：用户不需设定即可上网。
缺点：
  • Single point of failure：DHCP server 坏了，新设备拿不到 IP，已连线设备在 lease 到期后也会断线。
补救（书外）：后备 DHCP server，或给重要 server/打印机 static IP。

ex.q: The school DHCP server crashes at 8:00 a.m. Leases are 4 hours. Describe the effect at 8:05 a.m. and at 1:00 p.m.
ex.a: 8:05: computers already holding valid leases keep working, but newly switched-on devices cannot get an IP and cannot use the network. By 1:00 p.m. (more than 4 hours later) the existing leases have expired and cannot be renewed, so almost all DHCP clients lose connectivity, showing DHCP is a single point of failure.
ex.az: 8:05 新设备拿不到 IP；1:00 旧 lease 已过期无法续，几乎全部断线：single point of failure。

cards.en:
A domain controller implements login authentication and user rights control for a network.
  • Login authentication: it stores the user accounts (username and password). Anyone using any computer in the network must authenticate with their own account before accessing the network, so one account works on every computer.
  • User rights control: each domain-bound resource (file server, network printer ...) can have access rights set per user, e.g. only some users may use the file server.
Advantages:
  • Centralised user and resource management: accounts and security policies managed in one place, ideal for many users/devices.
  • Improved security: handles authentication and authorisation, verifying identity and enforcing access control rules so users only use resources they are authorised for.
  • Group Policy management: Group Policies apply system settings, security policies and software installations consistently across the whole network.
cards.zh:
A domain controller implements login authentication and user rights control for a network.
  • Login authentication：保存 user accounts（username + password）；任何人在网内任何电脑使用网络前都须以自己帐户认证，一个帐户可在所有电脑登入。
  • User rights control：每个 domain-bound resource（file server、network printer…）可按用户设定 access right，如只有部分用户可用 file server。
优点：
  • Centralised user and resource management：帐户与 security policies 集中管理，适合大量用户和设备。
  • Improved security：负责 authentication and authorisation，验证身份、执行 access control rules，用户只能用获授权资源。
  • Group Policy management：用 Group Policies 把 system settings、security policies、software installations 一致地套用到全网。

ex.q: A school with 1,200 students and 300 computers changes its password rules. Explain how a domain controller makes this easier than managing each computer separately.
ex.a: All accounts are stored on the domain controller, so the administrator updates the password policy once (e.g. via Group Policy) and it is enforced at every login on all 300 computers. Without it, accounts and settings would exist on each computer and would have to be changed one by one, which is slow and inconsistent.
ex.az: 帐户集中在 domain controller，用 Group Policy 改一次即全网生效；否则要逐部电脑改。

cards.en:
A proxy server is an intermediary between a network and the Internet. Its two main benefits are content caching and content filtering. Content caching:
  1. A computer in the network requests an Internet resource, e.g. GET https://mysite.net/application.html.
  2. The proxy intercepts the request and sends an identical request using its own IP address.
  3. When the response arrives, the proxy forwards it to the original computer and saves a copy locally (caches it).
  4. Later, when another computer requests the same resource, the proxy recognises it has a cached response and returns it directly, with no need to go to the Internet or the web server.
Result: faster load times and reduced bandwidth consumption on the Internet link.
cards.zh:
A proxy server is an intermediary between a network and the Internet. 两大好处：content caching 与 content filtering。Content caching：
  1. 网内电脑请求 Internet 资源，如 GET https://mysite.net/application.html。
  2. Proxy intercepts 请求，并以自己的 IP address 发出一个 identical request。
  3. 收到 response 后转发给原电脑，同时 saves a copy locally（缓存）。
  4. 之后另一电脑请求相同资源，proxy 认出已有 cached response，直接回传，不用再上 Internet、不用找 web server。
结果：faster load times、reduced bandwidth consumption。

ex.q: 30 students open the same 2 MB page through a caching proxy. How much data crosses the school's Internet link, compared with no proxy?
ex.a: Without a proxy: 30 × 2 MB = 60 MB. With caching: only the first request goes out to the Internet (2 MB); the other 29 are served from the proxy's cache inside the LAN. So about 2 MB, a large bandwidth saving, and the 29 later students get faster load times.
ex.az: 无 proxy 60 MB；有缓存只需第一次 2 MB，其余 29 次由 cache 回传。

cards.t: Content filtering and proxy vs firewall
cards.tz: Content filtering 及 proxy 与 firewall
cards.en:
Because all requests pass through the proxy, it can intercept requests to certain domains so that the computer never receives a response from them. Schools and companies use this to block violent or indecent websites or time-wasting sites. Proxy filtering is not a firewall.
Proxy serverFirewall
Main purposecaching; blocking access to certain websites; hiding client IPsprotecting the network from security threats by allowing/blocking traffic by rules (e.g. ports, addresses)
Directionmostly outgoing web requests from usersincoming and outgoing traffic
So one cannot replace the other: a network with a proxy still needs a firewall.
cards.zh:
因为所有请求都经过 proxy，它可 intercept requests to certain domains，令电脑永远收不到该网站的回应。学校、公司用来 block violent or indecent websites 或浪费时间的网站。Proxy filtering 不等于 firewall：
Proxy serverFirewall
主要目的缓存；阻止浏览某些网站；隐藏 client IP保护网络免受 security threats，按规则（port、地址）放行/封锁流量
方向主要是用户发出的网页请求进出流量
所以两者不能互相取代：有 proxy 仍需 firewall。

ex.q: A principal says: “We installed a proxy that blocks gaming sites, so we can remove the firewall.” Evaluate this.
ex.a: Incorrect. The proxy only filters web requests to listed domains (and caches). It does not inspect or block other incoming traffic, e.g. attackers probing open ports or malware connections. A firewall protects the network from security threats by rule-based filtering of all traffic, so it is still needed.
ex.az: 不对：proxy 只过滤指定网站的请求；firewall 防御进出的保安威胁，仍需保留。

cards.t: Advantages and disadvantages of a proxy server
cards.en:
Advantages
  • Anonymity and privacy: requests reach the destination with the proxy's IP, so it masks the client's IP address and websites cannot track users by IP.
  • Improved performance: caching frequently accessed content gives faster load times and reduced bandwidth consumption.
Disadvantages
  • Latency: each request and response passes through an extra hop; worse if the proxy is geographically far away (or for uncached content).
  • Potential security risks: a poorly protected proxy can be exploited to intercept or tamper with traffic; an untrusted proxy brings risks of man-in-the-middle attacks and data theft.
  • Complexity and maintenance: configuring, updating and securing it takes time and expertise.
cards.zh:
优点
  • Anonymity and privacy：请求以 proxy 的 IP 到达目的地，masks the client's IP address，网站不能用 IP 追踪用户。
  • Improved performance：缓存常用内容 → faster load times、reduced bandwidth consumption。
缺点
  • Latency：请求与回应多经一站；proxy 地理上很远或内容未缓存时更慢。
  • Potential security risks：保护不足的 proxy 可被利用来截取或篡改流量；不可信的 proxy 有 man-in-the-middle attack、data theft 风险。
  • Complexity and maintenance：配置、更新、保安费时又需专业知识。

ex.q: A student uses a free public proxy found online to log in to his bank. Identify one benefit and one risk.
ex.a: Benefit: the bank's site sees the proxy's IP, so the student's IP is masked (anonymity). Risk: the proxy is untrusted; it sits between him and the bank, so it could carry out a man-in-the-middle attack and steal his login data. (Extra latency is another drawback.)
ex.az: 好处：隐藏自己 IP；风险：不可信 proxy 可做 man-in-the-middle 偷登入资料。

cards.t: Misconception: proxies always serve outdated content
cards.tz: 误解：proxy 一定给过时内容
cards.en:
Misconception: “With a caching proxy, clients will always receive outdated content.” Correction: the web server controls caching through HTTP response headers.
  • The server adds a last-modified header and an expiry header, which tell the proxy how long it may cache the response. After that time the proxy must fetch a fresh version from the server.
  • For time-sensitive or request-specific resources (e.g. live scores, a user's own shopping cart), the server adds a no-cache header, so the proxy does not cache it and every request goes to the server.
So caching is only applied where the content can safely be reused.
cards.zh:
误解：“用了缓存 proxy，client 一定收到过时内容。” 更正：web server 通过 HTTP response headers 控制缓存。
  • Server 加 last-modified 与 expiry header，告诉 proxy 可以缓存多久；过期后 proxy 须向 server 取新版本。
  • 对 time-sensitive 或 request-specific 资源（如即时比分、用户自己的购物车），server 加 no-cache header，proxy 不缓存，每次都向 server 取。
所以只有可安全重用的内容才会被缓存。

ex.q: A news site's breaking-news page changes every minute, but its logo never changes. How should the server set headers for each?
ex.a: Logo: a long expiry (with last-modified), so proxies can cache it and save bandwidth. Breaking-news page: a no-cache header (or a very short expiry), so the proxy always fetches the latest version and readers never get stale news.
ex.az: Logo 设长 expiry 可缓存；新闻页加 no-cache（或很短 expiry）。

cards.tz: 共享资源的好处与硬件共享
cards.en:
Joining a network lets devices communicate and also share resources, which saves cost (buy one printer or one Internet line for many users) and simplifies management (one place to maintain). The book groups shared resources into hardware, files and Internet connection.
Network printer: a printer connected directly to a network (wired or wireless). It has its own IP address and a built-in network interface (Ethernet port or Wi-Fi module), and users send print jobs straight to it. Pros: easy to set up and maintain, suitable for homes or small workgroups. Cons: when printing demand is high and there are many network printers, each operates independently, so they are hard to manage.
cards.zh:
接入网络除了通讯，还可 share resources：save cost（多人共用一部打印机、一条上网线）及 simplify management（集中维护）。书中分三类：hardware、files、Internet connection。
Network printer：a printer connected directly to a network (wired or wireless)，有自己的 IP address 和内置网络接口（Ethernet port 或 Wi-Fi module），用户直接把 print job 送给它。优点：易安装、易维护，适合家庭或小 workgroup。缺点：打印需求大、打印机多时，每部各自独立运作，难以管理。

ex.q: A family of four each has a laptop. Give two benefits of sharing one network printer instead of buying a USB printer for each person.
ex.a: (1) Saves cost: one printer (and its maintenance/ink) instead of four. (2) Simplifies management: only one device to set up and maintain, and anyone on the home network can send jobs to it from any room via its IP.
ex.az: 省钱（一部代替四部）；易管理（只维护一部，任何人都可经网络打印）。

cards.en:
A print server is a device or software on a network that manages multiple printers. All print jobs are first sent to the print server, which dispatches each job to one of the available printers. Printers can connect to it by Ethernet, USB or another serial bus, and it can monitor the printers' status (paper, toner, errors). Benefits: centralised printer management, and it allows sharing printers without built-in networking.
Network printerPrint server
Connectioneach printer directly on the network with its own IPprinters attached to the print server (USB/Ethernet)
Managementindependent, hard to manage when manycentralised dispatching and status monitoring
Suitshome, small workgrouporganisations with heavy printing
cards.zh:
A print server is a device or software on a network that manages multiple printers. 所有 print job 先送到 print server，再 dispatch 给其中一部可用打印机。打印机可用 Ethernet、USB 或其他 serial bus 连接，并可 monitor printers' status（纸、碳粉、故障）。好处：centralised printer management；可共享没有内置网络功能的打印机。
Network printerPrint server
连接每部直接上网，各有 IP打印机接到 print server（USB/Ethernet）
管理独立运作，多时难管集中分派、监察状态
适合家庭、小组打印量大的机构

ex.q: A school library has 6 printers, 3 of them old USB-only models, and long queues at one printer while others are idle. Recommend a solution.
ex.a: Use a print server. The 3 USB-only printers can be attached to it by USB and shared even though they have no built-in networking. Students send jobs to the print server, which dispatches each job to an available printer, balancing the queues, and staff can monitor all printers' status centrally.
ex.az: 用 print server：USB 打印机也能共享；自动分派到空闲打印机；集中监察状态。

cards.tz: 共享文件与 Internet 连线
cards.en:
Data on a file server and a database server can be shared across the network. Considerations when sharing files:
  • Security: apply access controls and user authentication; regularly update the OS and file server software to fix vulnerabilities and resist malware.
  • Permissions and access control: grant only the necessary permissions (read, write, modify, delete) to prevent unauthorised modification or deletion and keep data integrity.
  • Backup and recovery: protect against hardware failure, accidental deletion and ransomware with regular backups to a separate device or offsite location, and test the recovery process.
Sharing an Internet connection: all devices in a network can share one connection, so only one Internet subscription from the ISP is needed, which saves cost.
cards.zh:
File server 和 database server 的数据都可在网内共享。共享文件的考虑：
  • Security：实施 access controls 与 user authentication；定期 更新 OS 及 file server software，修补 vulnerabilities、防 malware。
  • Permissions and access control：只给必要权限（read、write、modify、delete），防止未授权修改/删除，保持 data integrity。
  • Backup and recovery：防 hardware failure、accidental deletion、ransomware；定期备份到 separate device 或 offsite，并 测试 recovery process。
共享 Internet connection：网内所有设备共用一条连线，只需向 ISP 订一个 subscription，节省成本。

ex.q: Ransomware encrypts every file on a company's file server, including a backup folder stored on the same server. Explain what went wrong and how it should be done.
ex.a: The backup was on the same device, so the ransomware encrypted it too. Backups should be made regularly to a separate device or offsite location (not permanently connected), and the recovery process should be tested so files can actually be restored.
ex.az: 备份放在同一部机，一起被加密；应定期备份到另一设备或 offsite，并测试还原。

cards.t: Network scale and a simple home network
cards.tz: 网络规模与简单家庭网络
cards.en:
Networks range from a small home network (a few computers, phones and a printer, wired and wireless) to a large university network with hundreds of workstations plus a print server, file server, domain controller and DHCP server. A simple home network:
Internet → ISP → modem → router → switch → wired devices (PC, network printer)
                                    └→ access point → Wi-Fi devices (laptops, phones)
  • Modem: connects to the ISP line.
  • Router: connects the home LAN to the Internet and forwards traffic.
  • Switch: connects wired devices in the LAN with Ethernet cables; homes commonly use CAT 5 because it is reliable and cost effective.
  • Access point: connects wireless devices by Wi-Fi (radio waves).
cards.zh:
网络可小至家庭网络（几部电脑、手机、一部打印机，有线加无线），大至大学网络（数百 workstation，加 print server、file server、domain controller、DHCP server）。简单家庭网络：
Internet → ISP → modem → router → switch → 有线设备（PC、network printer）
                                    └→ access point → Wi-Fi 设备（手提电脑、手机）
  • Modem：接 ISP 线路。
  • Router：把家中 LAN 接上 Internet，转发流量。
  • Switch：用 Ethernet cable 连接有线设备；家用常见 CAT 5（reliable、cost effective）。
  • Access point：以 Wi-Fi（radio waves）连接无线设备。

ex.q: A PC in the study and a phone in the bedroom both browse the web. Trace the path of the phone's request to the Internet.
ex.a: Phone → (Wi-Fi radio waves) → access point → switch → router → modem → ISP → Internet. The PC's path is the same except it joins at the switch through an Ethernet cable.
ex.az: 手机→access point→switch→router→modem→ISP→Internet；PC 用 Ethernet 接 switch。

cards.t: Connecting to the ISP with PPPoE
cards.en:
Most home subscribers connect to their ISP with PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet):
  1. The ISP gives each subscriber a username and password, which are entered into the router's Internet configuration.
  2. When the router connects, the ISP authenticates the credentials.
  3. If valid, the ISP assigns an IP address to the subscriber (the router's public address).
  4. Devices in the home network then access the Internet through the router.
The authentication step lets the ISP make sure only paying subscribers use the service. If the password in the router is wrong (e.g. after the ISP resets it), the router cannot get an IP and the whole home loses Internet access even though the Wi-Fi still works.
cards.zh:
大部分家庭用户用 PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet) 连接 ISP：
  1. ISP 给每个订户 username 和 password，输入到 router 的 Internet configuration。
  2. Router 连线时，ISP authenticates the credentials。
  3. 正确的话，ISP assigns an IP address 给订户（router 的公共地址）。
  4. 家中设备再 经 router 上网。
认证令 ISP 确保只有付费订户能用。若 router 内密码错误（如 ISP 重设了密码），router 拿不到 IP，全家无法上网，但 Wi-Fi 本身仍然连得上。

ex.q: After moving house, a family's devices connect to Wi-Fi but cannot load any website. The router log shows “PPPoE authentication failed”. Explain and fix.
ex.a: The LAN (Wi-Fi, switch) works, but the router failed PPPoE authentication with the ISP, so it was not assigned an IP and cannot reach the Internet. Enter the correct username and password given by the ISP into the router's Internet configuration (or ask the ISP to reset them).
ex.az: LAN 正常，但 PPPoE 认证失败，ISP 不分配 IP；在 router 输入 ISP 提供的正确帐户密码。

cards.t: IP addresses at home and static IP
cards.tz: 家中的 IP 分配与 static IP
cards.en: Every device in the home network needs a unique IP address. Home networks usually use DHCP (built into the router) to assign them automatically, so phones and laptops just join. Some devices should instead get a static IP address, which does not change: e.g. a network printer. Other computers send print jobs to the printer's IP; if DHCP gave it a different IP after a restart, the computers could no longer find it. A static IP can be set in the router configuration (reserving an address for the printer) or on the device itself, ideally outside the DHCP scope to avoid conflicts. Rule of thumb: clients → DHCP; things others must find (printers, servers) → static.
cards.zh: 家庭网络内每部设备都需唯一 IP。一般由 router 内置的 DHCP 自动分配，手机、手提电脑连上即可。有些设备应使用不会改变的 static IP address，例如 network printer：其他电脑按打印机 IP 送 print job，若重启后 DHCP 给了另一个 IP，电脑就找不到它。Static IP 可在 router configuration 设定（为打印机保留地址）或在设备上设定，最好在 DHCP scope 之外以免冲突。口诀：普通 client 用 DHCP；别人要找的设备（打印机、server）用 static。

ex.q: A home router's DHCP scope is 192.168.1.100–192.168.1.199. Suggest a static IP for the printer and explain your choice.
ex.a: e.g. 192.168.1.50: it is in the same network (192.168.1.x) but outside the DHCP scope, so DHCP will never give it to another device (no IP conflict), and it never changes, so computers can always find the printer.
ex.az: 如 192.168.1.50：同一网段、在 scope 外，不会冲突且固定不变。

cards.en:
Ethernet is the most common wired standard for LANs. Cables come in categories with different maximum throughput and length:
CategoryMax throughputMax length
Cat 5100 Mbps100 m
Cat 5E1 Gbps100 m
Cat 61 Gbps / 10 Gbps100 m (1 Gbps) / 55 m (10 Gbps)
How to choose: find the speed needed and the cable length, then pick the cheapest category meeting both. Remember the whole link is limited by its slowest part: a 1 Gbps router port with a Cat 5 cable only gives 100 Mbps.
cards.zh:
Ethernet 是 LAN 最常用的有线标准。线缆分类别，最高速度与长度不同：
CategoryMax throughputMax length
Cat 5100 Mbps100 m
Cat 5E1 Gbps100 m
Cat 61 Gbps / 10 Gbps100 m（1 Gbps）/ 55 m（10 Gbps）
选择方法：先看需要的速度和线长，选同时符合的最便宜类别。记住整条连线受最慢部分限制：1 Gbps 端口配 Cat 5 线只有 100 Mbps。

ex.q: Choose a cable for: (i) 1 Gbps over 80 m; (ii) 10 Gbps over 70 m; (iii) 10 Gbps over 30 m.
ex.a: (i) Cat 5E (1 Gbps, up to 100 m; Cat 6 also works). (ii) None of the three: Cat 6 supports 10 Gbps only up to 55 m. (iii) Cat 6 (10 Gbps within 55 m).
ex.az: (i) Cat 5E；(ii) 三种都不行，Cat 6 10 Gbps 只到 55 m；(iii) Cat 6。

cards.en:
Wi-Fi is the most common wireless standard for LANs, provided by an access point. Factors to consider:
  • Access point placement: put it in a central location, away from thick walls, metal objects, microwave ovens and cordless phones that cause interference.
  • Wireless standard: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) gives higher speed and wider coverage; Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) may still be enough for a small flat.
  • SSID and password: set a custom SSID (Service Set Identifier) rather than the manufacturer's default name, and a strong, unique password to prevent unauthorised access.
  • Dual-band / tri-band: use both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands (tri-band adds a second 5 GHz band) to reduce congestion and interference.
cards.zh:
Wi-Fi 是 LAN 最常用的无线标准，由 access point 提供。考虑因素：
  • Access point placement：放在中央位置，远离厚墙、金属、微波炉、无线电话等 interference 来源。
  • Wireless standard：Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) 更快、覆盖更广；Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) 小单位可能已够。
  • SSID and password：自订 SSID (Service Set Identifier)，不用厂商默认名；设 strong, unique password 防未授权使用。
  • Dual-band / tri-band：同时用 2.4 GHz 与 5 GHz（tri-band 多一个 5 GHz），减少 congestion 与 interference。

ex.q: In a flat, the router sits in a metal cabinet beside the microwave in the kitchen corner, and the bedrooms get weak Wi-Fi. Give two improvements.
ex.a: (1) Move the access point to a central location of the flat, out of the metal cabinet and away from the microwave, which cause interference. (2) Use a dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router so devices can use 5 GHz to reduce congestion and get better speed/coverage.
ex.az: 移到中央、离开金属柜和微波炉；改用 dual-band Wi-Fi 6。

cards.en: Most home “routers” are really several devices in one box: they integrate a router, a switch and an access point. The modem connecting to the ISP is usually separate (or supplied by the ISP). Benefits: reduces cost (one device instead of three) and easier setup. It is configured through a web interface (typing the router's IP, e.g. 192.168.1.1, in a browser) or a mobile app, where you set the PPPoE login, Wi-Fi SSID/password, DHCP scope and static IP reservations. Limitation: the built-in switch has few ports and the single access point may not cover a large home, so extra switches or access points may be added.
cards.zh: 大部分家用“router”其实是多合一：integrate a router, a switch and an access point；接 ISP 的 modem 通常另外一部（或由 ISP 提供）。好处：reduces cost（一部代替三部）、easier setup。可经 web interface（在 browser 输入 router IP，如 192.168.1.1）或 mobile app 设定：PPPoE 登入、Wi-Fi SSID/密码、DHCP scope、static IP 保留。限制：内置 switch 端口少，一个 access point 未必覆盖大屋，可加 switch 或 access point。

ex.q: List the settings you would change in a new integrated home router's web interface, matching each to the device function it belongs to.
ex.a: Router: PPPoE username/password from the ISP; DHCP scope and a static IP reservation for the printer. Access point: custom SSID, strong Wi-Fi password, enable 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. Switch: nothing usually, just plug wired devices into the LAN ports.
ex.az: Router：PPPoE、DHCP、static IP；Access point：SSID、密码、双频；Switch：通常不用设定。

mc.q: Which of the following is a valid port number?
mc.e: A port is an unsigned 16-bit number, 0 to 65535.
mc.ez: Port 是 16 位无符号数，0–65535。

mc.q: A user enters https://shop.com in a browser. Which destination port receives the HTTP request?
mc.e: No port written, so the HTTPS default 443 is used.
mc.ez: 未写端口即用 HTTPS 默认 443。

mc.q: Which pair is correctly matched?
mc.e: 22 SSH, 110 POP3, 3306 MySQL; 53 is DNS.

mc.q: A company hosts its public website on port 443 and a testing web server on port 8080 of the same domain. Which URL reaches the testing server?
mc.e: A non-default port is written after the domain with a colon.
mc.ez: 非默认端口用冒号写在 domain 后。

mc.q: Which is NOT a reason given for hosting a service on a non-default port?
o: Increasing the bandwidth of the server
mc.e: Changing port does not increase bandwidth.

mc.q: Which range of ports is reserved by TCP as system ports?
mc.e: System (well-known) ports are 0–1023.

mc.q: What is the main purpose of a port number?
o: To identify a device on the Internet
To identify a service/application on a network address
To encrypt data between client and server
To translate domain names into IP addresses
mc.e: IP identifies the device; port identifies the application on it.
mc.ez: IP 找机器，port 找机器上的程序。

mc.q: Which URL sends its request to port 80?
mc.e: HTTP default port is 80.

mc.q: Which protocol uses port 22?
mc.e: Port 22 is SSH (Secure Shell).

mc.q: An email client retrieves mail with POP3. Which port does the mail server listen on?
mc.e: POP3 uses 110 (IMAP 143, SMTP 25).

mc.q: Which statement about UDP is correct?
o: It is an application layer protocol
It has lower latency than TCP
It does not use port numbers
mc.e: UDP is a transport layer protocol with lower latency and no mandatory error checking; it uses ports.
mc.ez: UDP 属 transport layer，延迟低，无强制 error checking，也用 port。

mc.q: Which application is most suitable for UDP?
mc.e: Real-time voice prefers low latency over retransmission.

mc.q: A web server and MySQL run on the same machine 192.168.0.10. Which address reaches MySQL?
mc.e: Same IP, different port; MySQL is 3306.

mc.q: Which allocates a free port to an application on a computer?
mc.e: The book: any application can be assigned a free port through the operating system.
mc.ez: 由 operating system 分配空闲 port。

mc.q: A school firewall blocks port 3389. A staff member's remote desktop service is moved to port 50000. This is mainly due to
mc.e: The default port is blocked by the firewall, so an allowed port is used.
mc.ez: 默认端口被 firewall 封锁。

mc.q: Which is a function of a web server?
o: Handling HTTP requests and producing HTTP responses
mc.e: Definition of a web server.
mc.ez: Web server 处理 HTTP request/response。

mc.q: Which is an example of web server software?
mc.e: NGINX and Apache are web servers; MySQL/PostgreSQL are DBMSs.

mc.q: Which part of an HTTP response indicates whether the request succeeded?
mc.e: e.g. 200 OK is a status code.

mc.q: A web server can generate pages dynamically by
o: running server-side scripts such as PHP
mc.e: Server-side scripts generate dynamic responses.
mc.ez: 执行 server-side script 动态生成。

mc.q: Who usually sends queries to a database server in a web application?
o: The end-user typing SQL in a browser
A server-side script on the web server
mc.e: End-users rarely interact directly; scripts send queries.
mc.ez: 通常由 web server 上的 script 发 query。

mc.q: A database server gives the account web_server_01 permission to SELECT but not DROP tables. This is an example of
mc.e: Different privileges for different accounts = access control.
mc.ez: 不同帐户不同 privilege 属 access control。

mc.q: On a file server, a user has Read permission on a folder but no Read permission on a file inside it. The user can
o: not see the folder at all
mc.e: Folder Read lists names; reading content needs file Read.
mc.ez: 文件夹 Read 只列名字。

mc.q: Write permission on a folder allows a user to
o: edit the content of every file in it
create, delete or rename files in it
mc.e: Folder Write = create/delete/rename files.
mc.ez: Folder Write 可新增、删除、改名。

mc.q: Which permission on a file allows a .php file to be run?
mc.e: Execute runs executable files.

mc.q: Why are teachers not given Execute permission on the school file server?
o: To stop them reading exam papers
To prevent unauthorised programs running on the server
Because execute is needed only by students
mc.e: Book reason: prevent unauthorised programs.
mc.ez: 防止未授权程序在 server 执行。

mc.q: A student has no permissions at all on folder Exam_Result. What happens?
o: He can list the files but not open them
He can open files but not edit them
He cannot even see the folder
mc.e: With no rights the folder is not visible.
mc.ez: 无权限则看不到该文件夹。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a file server over cloud storage?
o: Faster access speed within the LAN
mc.e: Within the LAN access is faster; others are cloud advantages.
mc.ez: LAN 内较快；其余是 cloud 优点。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of cloud storage over a file server?
o: Lower cost per storage unit in the long run
mc.e: Cloud storage is easy and quick to set up.

mc.q: The range of IP addresses that a DHCP server can assign is called the
mc.e: The administrator-defined range is the scope.

mc.q: A DHCP scope is 10.0.0.20 to 10.0.0.69. How many addresses can it assign?
What happens when a DHCP lease expires and the device is still online?
o: The device keeps the IP forever
The device must request an IP again
The device switches to a static IP automatically
mc.e: It must request again; unused expired IPs can be reclaimed.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of using a DHCP server?
o: It is a single point of failure
Settings must be configured on every device
mc.e: If it fails, devices cannot get IPs.
mc.ez: DHCP server 故障则拿不到 IP。

mc.q: Which information is NOT normally contained in a DHCP offer?
mc.e: Offers carry network configuration only.

mc.q: In DHCP discovery, the new computer first
o: sends a unicast to the DHCP server's IP
broadcasts a DHCP message to all devices
asks the DNS server for the DHCP address
mc.e: It does not know the server's IP, so it broadcasts.
mc.ez: 不知道 server IP，只能 broadcast。

mc.q:
Which TWO are functions of a domain controller?
(1) Login authentication (2) Content caching (3) User rights control (4) IP address assignment
mc.e: Caching is proxy; IP assignment is DHCP.
mc.ez: Caching 属 proxy，分配 IP 属 DHCP。

mc.q: A school applies the same screen-lock setting to all 300 computers at once. Which feature is used?
o: Group Policy of a domain controller
mc.e: Group Policies apply settings across the network.

mc.q: Students in a lab repeatedly download the same large files from one website. Which device best reduces waiting time and bandwidth use?
mc.e: Proxy content caching.

mc.q: When a proxy forwards a client's request to a website, the website sees
mc.e: The proxy sends an identical request using its own IP.
mc.ez: Proxy 用自己的 IP 发请求。

mc.q: Which HTTP header can stop a proxy server from caching a time-sensitive response?
mc.e: no-cache prevents caching.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of a proxy server?
o: It hides the client's IP address
mc.e: The others are advantages/functions.

mc.q: Which statement about a proxy server and a firewall is correct?
o: A proxy can fully replace a firewall
A proxy mainly blocks access to certain websites while a firewall protects against security threats
mc.e: They have different purposes and cannot replace each other.
mc.ez: 两者目的不同，不能互相取代。

mc.q: Using an untrusted public proxy mainly risks
mc.e: An untrusted proxy can intercept/tamper with traffic.
mc.ez: 不可信 proxy 可截取篡改流量。

mc.q: Which statement about a print server is correct?
o: Each printer must have a built-in Wi-Fi module
Print jobs are sent directly to each printer
It allows sharing printers without built-in networking
mc.e: Printers can attach by USB etc.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of using many network printers in a large office?
o: They need a print server to work
They operate independently and are hard to manage
mc.e: Many independent network printers are hard to manage.

mc.q: Sharing one Internet connection in a home network mainly
o: saves cost since only one ISP subscription is needed
removes the need for a router
mc.e: One subscription for all devices.
mc.ez: 只需一个 ISP 订阅。

mc.q: To protect shared files against ransomware, backups should be stored
o: in the same folder as the files
on a separate device or offsite
mc.e: Separate/offsite backups and tested recovery.
mc.ez: 备份放另一设备或 offsite。

mc.q: A home user needs 10 Gbps over a 40 m cable. Which Ethernet category is suitable?
mc.e: Cat 6 supports 10 Gbps up to 55 m.
mc.ez: Cat 6 在 55 m 内有 10 Gbps。

mc.q: What is the maximum throughput of a Cat 5 cable?
mc.e: Cat 5: 100 Mbps, 100 m.

mc.q: Most home subscribers connect to their ISP using
mc.e: ISP authenticates username/password and assigns an IP.

mc.q: In PPPoE, the username and password provided by the ISP are entered into
mc.e: They go into the router configuration.
mc.ez: 输入 router 的 Internet configuration。

mc.q: Why should a network printer be given a static IP address?
o: So its address does not change and computers can always find it
Because DHCP cannot assign IP to printers
mc.e: Static IP does not change.

mc.q: An integrated home router usually combines
mc.e: Book: router + switch + access point.

mc.q: Which is the best place for a home access point?
o: A central location away from thick walls
In the corner furthest from the bedrooms
mc.e: Central and away from interference.

mc.q: SSID stands for
mc.e: Service Set Identifier is the Wi-Fi network name.

mc.q: A dual-band router uses
mc.e: Dual-band = 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz.

mc.q: Which Wi-Fi standard is Wi-Fi 6?
In a simple home network, which device connects wired PCs inside the LAN?
mc.e: The switch connects wired devices via Ethernet.

sq.q: A school hosts its website at https://school.edu. A teacher later sets up a second web server for testing that is reached at https://school.edu:8443.

parts.q: What does 8443 represent?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer:
The port number of the (testing) web server / application.

parts.q: Explain why the original URL does not need a number.
parts.ms: HTTPS uses default port 443; when no port is specified the request is sent to the protocol's default port.

parts.q: Give TWO reasons, other than testing, why a service may run on a non-default port.
parts.ms:
Any two, with explanation:
Port conflict: default port occupied by another application.
Security: obfuscates the service from attackers.
Firewall restrictions block the default port.
Multiple instances of the same service.

sq.q: A school file server has folders Public, ICT and Exam_Result.

parts.q: Distinguish between Read permission on a file and Read permission on a folder.
parts.ms:
File Read: can open/read the content of the file.
Folder Read: can only list the names of files/sub-folders; reading a file's content also needs Read on that file.

parts.q: Suggest suitable rights for a student on Exam_Result and a teacher on ICT, with reasons.
parts.ms:
Student: no rights on Exam_Result, so cannot see the folder / results of others.
Teacher: Read and Write on ICT, so can add, delete and edit teaching files.

parts.q: Why should Execute permission not be granted to teachers and students?
parts.ms: To prevent unauthorised programs/scripts from running on the file server.

sq.q: A co-working office uses a DHCP server and a domain controller.

parts.q: Describe how a new laptop obtains an IP address from the DHCP server, including the term lease.
parts.ms:
Laptop broadcasts a DHCP discovery message.
DHCP server replies with a DHCP offer (IP, subnet mask, gateway, DNS); laptop sends DHCP request and is assigned an unused IP from the scope.
The IP is leased for a fixed duration; must request again / reclaimed after expiry.

parts.q: State one advantage and one disadvantage of DHCP.
parts.ms:
Advantage: automatic assignment avoids IP conflicts / human error; centralised management; faster setup.
Disadvantage: single point of failure.

parts.q: State two advantages of using a domain controller.
parts.ms: Any two: centralised user and resource management; improved security via authentication and authorisation; Group Policy management.

sq.q: A media classroom installs a proxy server.

parts.q: Explain how content caching shortens the loading time when 30 students open the same web page.
parts.ms:
First request is intercepted; proxy sends an identical request with its own IP.
Response forwarded to the student and a copy cached locally.
Later identical requests answered directly from the cache without going to the Internet/web server.

parts.q: A teacher says the proxy may serve outdated pages. Explain how this is handled.
parts.ms:
Web server adds last-modified / expiry headers stating how long the proxy may cache.
Time-sensitive responses carry a no-cache header so they are not cached.

parts.q: Is a firewall still needed? Explain.
parts.ms:
Yes.
A firewall protects the network from security threats, while a proxy mainly caches and blocks certain websites; they cannot replace each other.

sq.q: A family sets up a home network.

parts.q: Explain how the router connects to the ISP using PPPoE.
parts.ms:
ISP gives username and password, entered into the router's Internet configuration.
ISP authenticates the credentials and assigns an IP address; devices access the Internet through the router.

parts.q: Suggest two factors to consider when setting up the Wi-Fi.
parts.ms: Any two: central access point placement away from walls/metal/microwaves; newer standard e.g. Wi-Fi 6; custom SSID and strong password; dual-band 2.4/5 GHz.

parts.q: Compare using a network printer with using a print server for this home.
parts.ms:
Network printer connects directly with its own IP, easy to set up/maintain, suitable for a home.
Print server centrally manages multiple printers; unnecessary for one printer and adds cost.

sq.q: Mr Lee runs an online tuck-shop ordering system. Students visit https://tuck.school.hk, and a PHP script reads and writes orders in a MySQL database on another machine.

parts.q: State the port numbers used by (i) the students' browsers to reach the web server and (ii) the PHP script to reach MySQL.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer:
(i) 443 (HTTPS)
(ii) 3306 (MySQL)

parts.q: Describe the role of the web server when a student views her order history.
parts.ms:
Receives/handles the HTTP request; runs the server-side (PHP) script to generate the page dynamically.
Returns an HTTP response with status code, content type and HTML body.

parts.q: Suggest TWO security measures for the database server.
parts.ms:
User authentication: the script's account needs username/password.
User access control: give the script's account only the privileges it needs (e.g. no DROP).

sq.q: A small design studio of 8 staff must choose between a file server in the office and cloud storage for its shared files.

parts.q: Give TWO advantages of cloud storage for the studio.
parts.ms:
Easy and quick to set up / low initial cost.
Access from anywhere with Internet (e.g. staff working from home).
Easy to scale up.

parts.q: Give TWO advantages of a file server.
parts.ms:
Faster access within the LAN (large design files).
Lower cost per storage unit in the long run / no subscription fee.

parts.q: Whichever is used, state two considerations to protect the shared files.
parts.ms: Any two: user authentication and access control (least permissions); keep OS/software updated; regular backups to separate device/offsite with tested recovery (e.g. against ransomware).

sq.q: A school library network has 120 computers. It currently uses static IP addresses typed in by technicians, and 4 printers (2 are USB-only) each connected to one computer.

parts.q: Suggest a network service to replace manually typed IP addresses and give two benefits.
parts.ms:
DHCP server.
Automatic assignment reduces IP conflicts / human error.
Centralised management of subnet mask, gateway, DNS / faster setup.

parts.q: Which devices should still keep static IP addresses? Explain.
parts.ms: Servers/network printers (shared devices), so their address does not change and other computers can always find them.

parts.q: Recommend how to share the 4 printers and justify.
parts.ms:
Use a print server: USB-only printers without built-in networking can be shared.
Jobs are dispatched to available printers and status is monitored centrally.

parts.q: The DHCP scope is 172.16.0.11 to 172.16.0.130. Is it large enough? Show working.
parts.ms:
130 − 11 + 1 = 120 addresses.
Exactly 120: enough only if every computer is online at once with nothing else; it leaves no spare addresses, so a larger scope is advisable.

pr.t: Find the destination port of a URL
pr.tz: 找出 URL 的目的端口
pr.task: Write a function dest_port(url) that returns the destination port (an int) of a URL of the form scheme://host[:port][/path]. If a port is written after the host, return it. Otherwise return the default port: http → 80, https → 443, ftp → 21.
pr.taskz: 写函数 dest_port(url)，返回 URL 的目的端口（int）。host 后写了端口就返回它，否则按协议返回默认端口：http 80、https 443、ftp 21。

pr.tz: 计算 DHCP scope 大小
pr.task: A DHCP scope is given by its first and last IPv4 address (same network, e.g. '192.168.0.96' to '192.168.0.200'). Write scope_size(first, last) that returns how many addresses the scope contains (inclusive). Your function must also work when the scope crosses a third-octet boundary, e.g. 10.0.0.250 to 10.0.1.5.
pr.taskz: 写 scope_size(first, last)，返回 DHCP scope 包含多少个地址（首尾都计）。要能处理跨第三段的情况，如 10.0.0.250 到 10.0.1.5。

pr.task: Using the book's table (Cat 5: 100 Mbps up to 100 m; Cat 5E: 1 Gbps up to 100 m; Cat 6: 1 Gbps up to 100 m, 10 Gbps up to 55 m), write choose_cable(mbps, metres) returning the lowest category string that meets both the speed and the length: 'Cat 5', 'Cat 5E', 'Cat 6', or 'None' if none can.
pr.taskz: 根据书中表格，写 choose_cable(mbps, metres)，返回同时满足速度和长度的最低类别：'Cat 5'、'Cat 5E'、'Cat 6'，都不行则 'None'。
